An out-of-plane magnetic field tunes one magnon sector into resonance with a degenerate phonon doublet, yet only the pseudoangular-momentum-matched phonon develops a pronounced avoided crossing while the other remains nearly unmixed. Field reversal switches the selected rotation sector and reverses the rotational polarization of the hybridized phonon component without changing the hybrid-mode energies. Our results reveal pseudoangular-momentum matching as a general framework for understanding and controlling mode-selective spin-lattice hybridization.
summary:
磁振子-声子杂化提供了耦合自旋和晶格激发的强大途径，但控制模式选择性的对称原理仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明晶体赝角动量为非共线多亚晶格磁系统中的选择性磁振子-声子杂化提供了一般标准。与赝角动量相关的旋转特征值编码极化变换、亚晶格排列和布洛赫相位，需要属于同一旋转扇区的模式之间的磁弹性耦合。我们在具有非共线自旋顺序的堆叠戈薇模型中说明了这一原理。面外磁场将一个磁振子扇区调谐到与简并声子双峰共振，但只有赝角动量匹配的声子产生明显的避免交叉，而另一个磁振子扇区几乎保持未混合。场反转切换选定的旋转扇区并反转混合声子分量的旋转极化，而不改变混合模式能量。

我们的结果揭示了伪角动量匹配作为理解和控制模式选择性自旋晶格杂交的通用框架。

title: Inverse origami inspired by insect morphogenesis: geometric design of wrinkle structures for curved surface formation
abstract: Insect exoskeletons abruptly acquire complex three-dimensional forms during metamorphosis from larva to pupa. This transformation occurs through the unfolding of preformed wrinkle structures inside the larval body under internal pressure. Inspired by this process, we investigate an inverse-origami strategy for fabricating curved surfaces. Whereas conventional origami produces three-dimensional objects by folding a flat sheet, this strategy produces curved surfaces by unfolding preformed wrinkle structures. The central design problem is to derive a wrinkle structure from a prescribed target surface. Our key idea is to regard a wrinkle structure as a unidirectional stretching field, which specifies at each point the stretch produced when the structure unfolds. We first derive such a field from the target surface geometry and then translate it into spatially varying wrinkle directions and spacing, so that the wrinkle structure unfolds into the target. The resulting numerical designs approximate the intrinsic metric of the target surface. We demonstrate the method on multiple target surfaces through numerical construction, mechanical unfolding simulations, and 3D-printed prototypes. This work provides a biologically inspired geometric design principle for encoding prescribed surface shapes in wrinkle structures, as well as a framework for designing and fabricating deployable curved surfaces.
summary:
昆虫的外骨骼在从幼虫到蛹的变态过程中突然获得复杂的三维形状。这种转变是通过幼虫体内预先形成的皱纹结构在内部压力下展开而发生的。受这个过程的启发，我们研究了一种用于制造曲面的逆折纸策略。传统的折纸通过折叠平板来产生三维物体，而这种策略通过展开预先形成的皱纹结构来产生弯曲的表面。中心设计问题是从指定的目标表面导出皱纹结构。我们的关键思想是将皱纹结构视为单向拉伸场，它指定了结构展开时在每个点产生的拉伸。我们首先从目标表面几何形状中导出这样的场，然后将其转换为空间上变化的皱纹方向和间距，以便皱纹结构展开到目标中。由此产生的数值设计近似于目标表面的内在度量。我们通过数值构造、机械展开模拟和 3D 打印原型在多个目标表面上演示了该方法。

这项工作提供了一种受生物学启发的几何设计原理，用于编码皱纹结构中规定的表面形状，以及设计和制造可展开曲面的框架。

title: Dynamic helimagnetism via charged spin current
abstract: We present a theoretical and numerical study of classical, localized spins coupled to conduction electrons that carry both charge and spin currents, deriving the effective equations of motion from the s-d exchange Hamiltonian. Applied to a periodically arranged one-dimensional spin chain, these equations yield two current-driven helical phases: a static helix stabilized by a pure spin current alone, and a coherently precessing helix that appears once a small charge-current component is added. For a given helical wavenumber, the precession angular frequency $\omega$ and the canting ratio $\Delta$ toward the hard axis follow analytically from the equations of motion, while the wavenumber $q_{\rm helix}$ of the precessing helix is selected by a heuristically constructed effective Lagrangian. Direct numerical integration of the same equations of motion reproduces all three observables wherever it yields a coherent helix. The helix chirality is set by a long-range, current-generated Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM)-type coupling rather than an intrinsic DM interaction, so materials without bulk or interfacial DM interactions could also host current-controlled helical order. Because the helical pitch, precession frequency, and canting ratio are all continuously tunable by the current amplitudes, these helices could serve as probes of spin currents.
summary:
我们提出了对与携带电荷和自旋电流的传导电子耦合的经典局部自旋的理论和数值研究，从 s-d 交换哈密顿量导出有效的运动方程。应用于周期性排列的一维自旋链，这些方程产生两个电流驱动的螺旋相：仅由纯自旋电流稳定的静态螺旋，以及一旦添加小电荷电流分量就会出现的相干进动螺旋。对于给定的螺旋波数，进动角频率 $\omega$ 和朝向难轴的倾斜比 $\Delta$ 通过运动方程分析得出，而进动螺旋的波数 $q_{\rm helix}$ 通过启发式构造的有效拉格朗日函数来选择。相同运动方程的直接数值积分会再现所有三个可观测量，无论它产生相干螺旋。螺旋手性是由长程、电流产生的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 型耦合而不是内在的 DM 相互作用决定的，因此没有体相或界面 DM 相互作用的材料也可以具有电流控制的螺旋顺序。

由于螺旋螺距、进动频率和倾斜比均可通过电流幅度连续调节，因此这些螺旋可以用作自旋电流的探针。

title: Trajectory Functionals in the Thermodynamics of Radiation-Induced Damage in Structural Materials
abstract: This paper delivers a novel self-consistent non-local kinetic framework based on dose-dependent semi-Markov renewal transport and the generalized Doob's h-transform to evaluate the structural degradation of WWER-1000/1200 fuel claddings. By leveraging the Feynman-Kac formalism, we map the continuous microscopic defect path trajectories generated by the Liouville operator directly onto the evolution of the macroscopically integrated damage potential. The framework accounts for long-range memory effects in the degradation kinetics via a non-vanishing structural commutator of the path Liouville operator and Zwanzig-Mori projection operators, which mathematically links the spatial restrictions of microscopic sinks to energetic path penalties. Spatial profiling of the cladding's mean lifetime, demonstrates a distinct sigmoidal, S-shaped degradation trajectory encompassing distinct incubation, linear growth, and avalanche breakdown stages. The numerical results reveal an abrupt, localized reduction in the operational lifespan near the cladding boundaries. This marginal vulnerability is shown to be a direct physical consequence of boundary stress field singularities at the fuel cladding interface and localized embrittlement. The developed path integral architecture provides a strict thermodynamic link between non-equilibrium fluctuations and the global Griffiths macro-barrier, offering a robust predictive tool for high-burnup nuclear fuel safety assessments.
summary:
本文提出了一种基于剂量依赖性半马尔可夫更新输运和广义 Doob's h 变换的新型自洽非局部动力学框架，以评估 WWER-1000/1200 燃料包壳的结构退化。通过利用 Feynman-Kac 形式，我们将 Liouville 算子生成的连续微观缺陷路径轨迹直接映射到宏观综合损伤潜力的演化上。该框架通过路径Liouville算子和Zwanzig-Mori投影算子的非消失结构换向器解释了退化动力学中的长程记忆效应，这在数学上将微观汇的空间限制与能量路径惩罚联系起来。包层平均寿命的空间分析显示出明显的 S 形、S 形退化轨迹，包括不同的孵化、线性生长和雪崩击穿阶段。数值结果表明，包层边界附近的使用寿命突然局部缩短。

这种边际脆弱性被证明是燃料包壳界面处的边界应力场奇点和局部脆化的直接物理结果。开发的路径积分架构在非平衡波动和全局格里菲斯宏观势垒之间提供了严格的热力学联系，为高燃耗核燃料安全评估提供了强大的预测工具。

title: Interaction dependence of the critical correlation length amplitude ratio in anisotropic scalar lattice $ϕ^4$ theory
abstract: We investigate critical correlations in the weakly anisotropic two-dimensional scalar lattice $\phi^4$ theory and demonstrate that a previously reported independence of the correlation length amplitude ratio from the local interaction strength does not hold. Monte Carlo simulations instead reveal a pronounced dependence of this ratio on the interaction strength. As the coupling is increased, the amplitude ratio interpolates between the continuum and Ising limits, highlighting a nontrivial interplay between lattice effects and local interactions. These findings call for a revised theoretical description of anisotropy effects at finite coupling in this prototypical lattice field theory.
summary: 我们研究了弱各向异性二维标量晶格 $\phi^4$ 理论中的关键相关性，并证明先前报道的相关长度振幅比与局部相互作用强度的独立性并不成立。相反，蒙特卡罗模拟揭示了该比率对相互作用强度的明显依赖性。随着耦合的增加，振幅比在连续谱和伊辛极限之间进行插值，突出了晶格效应和局部相互作用之间的重要相互作用。这些发现需要对这种原型晶格场理论中有限耦合下的各向异性效应进行修订的理论描述。

title: Nonlocal Einstein Relation in Confined Phonon Hydrodynamics
abstract: Einstein relations connect carrier mobility to macroscopic transport coefficients and constitute a fundamental link between microscopic dynamics and transport. In phonon hydrodynamics, this connection is conventionally local: the drift-induced thermal conductivity is proportional to the local drift mobility. Here we show that this relation becomes intrinsically nonlocal under spatial confinement. We derive a nonlocal Einstein relation, $\kappa_H(y) = \int P(y-y')\mu(y'),dy'$, in which hydrodynamic thermal conductivity $\kappa_H(y)$ at one position depends on collective drift mobility $\mu(y')$ across the entire cross-section of the channel. In the small-Knudsen-number limit, our nonlocal theory recovers the viscous heat equation and the local Einstein relation. At finite Knudsen number, nonlocality produces intrinsic boundary slip and distinct size-scaling behavior of the drift mobility $\mu$ and hydrodynamic thermal conductivity $\kappa_H(y)$. First-principles calculations for graphite show that nonlocality broadens the channel-size window over which thermal conductivity exhibits superlinear size dependence. Temperature-dependent simulations further show that the nonlocal theory captures the emergence of a hydrodynamic peak in thermal conductivity normalized by ballistic conductance, whereas the local theory fails to accurately predict its magnitude. Our results establish a microscopic connection between collective phonon mobility and heat conduction beyond local hydrodynamics.
summary:
爱因斯坦关系将载流子迁移率与宏观输运系数联系起来，并构成了微观动力学与输运之间的基本联系。在声子流体动力学中，这种联系通常是局部的：漂移引起的热导率与局部漂移迁移率成正比。在这里，我们表明这种关系在空间限制下本质上变得非局部的。我们推导出一个非局域爱因斯坦关系 $\kappa_H(y) = \int P(y-y')\mu(y'),dy'$，其中某一位置的流体动力热导率 $\kappa_H(y)$ 取决于整个通道横截面的集体漂移迁移率 $\mu(y')$。在小克努森数极限下，我们的非局域理论恢复了粘性热方程和局域爱因斯坦关系。在有限的克努森数下，非局域性会产生固有的边界滑移以及漂移迁移率 $\mu$ 和流体动力热导率 $\kappa_H(y)$ 的独特尺寸缩放行为。石墨的第一性原理计算表明，非局域性拓宽了通道尺寸窗口，在该窗口上热导率表现出超线性尺寸依赖性。

与温度相关的模拟进一步表明，非局域理论捕获了由弹道电导归一化的热导率中流体动力峰值的出现，而局域理论无法准确预测其大小。我们的结果在集体声子迁移率和热传导之间建立了超越局部流体动力学的微观联系。

title: Flexural Altermagnetism
abstract: We establish flexural deformation as a versatile route for engineering altermagnetism in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets. By tailoring the flexure, we selectively break different symmetries to realize altermagnetic states with distinct wave symmetries and reverse their spin splitting. A tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for monolayer MnPS3 demonstrate d- and i-wave states and a switchable transverse spin current in the d-wave state.
summary: 我们将弯曲变形作为二维共线反铁磁体中工程交变磁性的通用途径。通过定制弯曲，我们有选择地打破不同的对称性，以实现具有不同波对称性的交磁态并逆转它们的自旋分裂。单层 MnPS3 的紧束缚模型和第一原理计算证明了 d 波和 i 波状态以及 d 波状态下的可切换横向自旋电流。

title: Synchronization-controlled transport near an absorbing transition: Effective Enskog kinetic theory of a driven granular monolayer
abstract: Synchronization with vibrating boundaries can qualitatively alter the dynamics of confined granular fluids and control the collision-induced transfer of energy to horizontal motion. We develop an Enskog kinetic theory for the active phase of a driven granular monolayer within the framework of the $\Delta$-model, which accounts for the transfer of energy from the vertical to the horizontal degrees of freedom of grains. Synchronization effects are incorporated through a state-dependent effective collision rule governed by the interplay between the local collision frequency and a characteristic synchronization time. A viscous drag force is also included to account for energy dissipation arising from interactions with the confining plates. Within this framework, we characterize the homogeneous active state and use it as the reference state for a Chapman--Enskog expansion. The solution of the Enskog equation to Navier--Stokes order then yields explicit expressions for the shear and bulk viscosities, the thermal conductivity, the diffusive heat coefficient, and the first-order contribution to the cooling rate, consistently accounting for inelasticity, damping, finite-density effects, and synchronization. Event-driven molecular-dynamics simulations show that the theory accurately describes the steady temperature and shear and bulk viscosities over a broad region of the active phase. Close to the discontinuous synchronization-controlled absorbing transition, deviations are mainly attributed to the mean-field coarse-graining of the microscopic synchronization dynamics: fluctuations of the collision-dependent injection amplitude and correlations between synchronization and pre-collisional velocities become increasingly important. These results provide a kinetic description of synchronization-controlled transport and delineate its range of validity near the absorbing transition.
summary:
与振动边界同步可以定性地改变受限颗粒流体的动力学，并控制碰撞引起的能量向水平运动的传递。我们在 $\Delta$ 模型的框架内开发了一种用于驱动颗粒单层活性相的 Enskog 动力学理论，该理论解释了能量从颗粒的垂直自由度到水平自由度的转移。同步效应通过依赖于状态的有效冲突规则来合并，该规则由本地冲突频率和特征同步时间之间的相互作用控制。还包括粘性阻力，以考虑与限制板相互作用产生的能量耗散。在此框架内，我们描述了同质活动状态并将其用作 Chapman-Enskog 展开的参考状态。

Enskog 方程对纳维-斯托克斯阶的解可得出剪切粘度和体积粘度、导热系数、扩散热系数以及对冷却速率的一阶贡献的显式表达式，一致地考虑了非弹性、阻尼、有限密度效应和同步。事件驱动的分子动力学模拟表明，该理论准确地描述了活性相广泛区域内的稳定温度、剪切和体积粘度。接近不连续同步控制的吸收转变，偏差主要归因于微观同步动力学的平均场粗粒度：碰撞相关的注入幅度的波动以及同步和预碰撞速度之间的相关性变得越来越重要。这些结果提供了同步控制传输的动力学描述，并描绘了其在吸收转变附近的有效性范围。

title: Anomalous Mobility Enhancement in Restricted Geometries
abstract: We investigate the effect of geometrical confinement on driven transport in anomalous media within the framework of the quenched trap model. The particle performs a biased random walk on a lattice, where quenched disorder introduces power-law distributed trapping times. We consider channels that are infinite along one direction and have a finite cross-section in the remaining $d-1$ directions. In the glassy regime, where $\alpha=T/T_g<1$, we derive an analytical expression for the mean longitudinal displacement in the long-time and weak-force limits. We find the scaling $\langle x_\parallel(t)\rangle \propto F_\parallel^\alpha t^\alpha \Omega^{-(1-\alpha)}$, where $F_\parallel>0$ is the effective longitudinal force and $\Omega$ is the number of sites in a transverse cross-section. Thus, the anomalous mobility is enhanced for narrower channels. Our analytical result applies to general Bravais lattices in $d$ dimensions with periodic transverse boundary conditions. Numerical simulations confirm the analytical predictions for different lattice geometries and show quantitative agreement even for channels with reflecting boundary conditions.
summary: 我们在淬火陷阱模型的框架内研究了几何约束对异常介质中驱动输运的影响。粒子在晶格上执行有偏随机游走，其中淬灭无序引入幂律分布捕获时间。我们考虑沿一个方向无限的通道，并在其余 $d-1$ 方向上具有有限的横截面。在玻璃状态下，$\alpha=T/T_g<1$，我们推导出长时弱力极限下平均纵向位移的解析表达式。我们找到缩放比例 $\langle x_\parallel(t)\rangle \propto F_\parallel^\alpha t^\alpha \Omega^{-(1-\alpha)}$，其中 $F_\parallel>0$ 是有效纵向力，$\Omega$ 是横向横截面中的站点数量。因此，对于较窄的通道，异常迁移率得到增强。我们的分析结果适用于具有周期性横向边界条件的 $d$ 维度的一般布拉维晶格。数值模拟证实了对不同晶格几何形状的分析预测，并且即使对于具有反射边界条件的通道也显示出定量一致性。

title: Simultaneous suppression and temperature-driven crossover of particle-like and wave-like thermal transport in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$
abstract: The simultaneous suppression of particle-like ($\kappa_p$ ) and wave-like ($\kappa_c$) thermal transport channels in crystalline materials remains a challenging problem, as reducing one channel can enhance the other. Here, we investigate the thermal transport in trigonal $P\Bar{3}m1$ CsAg$_3$S$_2$ using self-consistent phonon theory with cubic and quartic anharmonicity and the unified theory of thermal transport. Our calculations predict an ultralow lattice thermal conductivity of 0.222 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ at 300 K, featuring simultaneously low $\kappa_p$ and $\kappa_c$ with a weak temperature dependence of $\sim$T$^{-0.42}$, which deviates significantly from the conventional $\sim$T$^{-1}$ behavior. This simultaneous suppression arises from localized Cs modes, which enhance anharmonic scattering, and the softer Ag-S framework, which reduces phonon group velocities, together suppressing $\kappa_p$, in conjunction with sparse, well-separated high-frequency S-derived optical modes that suppress $\kappa_c$ by limiting the coherent coupling between the phonon modes. Furthermore, the dominant transport channel exhibits a temperature-dependent crossover, with $\kappa_p$ contributing $\sim$74 \% of total lattice thermal conductivity at 300~K and $\kappa_c$ contributing $\sim$63 \% at 700~K. Combining the ultralow thermal conductivity with electrical transport calculated within the momentum relaxation time approximation (MRTA), we obtain a $ZT$ of 1.28 for $n$-type doping at 700 K. The present work not only clarifies the microscopic mechanism of ultralow thermal conductivity in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$ but also identifies the covalent M-Ch framework modification within the AM$_3$Ch$_2$ family of ternary chalcogenides as an additional tuning parameter for further reducing $\kappa_p$ within the bonding-hierarchy design principle.
summary:
同时抑制晶体材料中的粒子状（$\kappa_p$）和波状（$\kappa_c$）热传输通道仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为减少一个通道可以增强另一个通道。在这里，我们使用具有三次和四次非调和性的自洽声子理论以及热传输统一理论研究三角 $P\Bar{3}m1$ CsAg$_3$S$_2$ 中的热传输。我们的计算预测在 300 K 时超低晶格热导率为 0.222 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$，同时具有较低的 $\kappa_p$ 和 $\kappa_c$ 以及较弱的温度依赖性 $\sim$T$^{-0.42}$，这与传统的 $\sim$T$^{-1}$ 行为显着偏离。这种同时抑制源于局部 Cs 模式（增强非谐波散射）和较软的 Ag-S 框架（降低声子群速度），共同抑制 $\kappa_p$，同时结合稀疏、分离良好的高频 S 衍生光学模式，通过限制声子模式之间的相干耦合来抑制 $\kappa_c$。

此外，主要传输通道表现出与温度相关的交叉，$\kappa_p$ 在 300~K 时贡献 $\sim$74 \% 的总晶格热导率，而 $\kappa_c$ 在 700~K 时贡献 $\sim$63 \%。将超低热导率与动量弛豫时间近似 (MRTA) 中计算的电输运相结合，我们在 700 K 下获得 $n$ 型掺杂的 $ZT$ 为 1.28。目前的工作不仅阐明了三角 CsAg$_3$S$_2$ 中超低热导率的微观机制，而且还确定了三元 AM$_3$Ch$_2$ 家族中的共价 M-Ch 骨架修饰硫族化物作为额外的调整参数，用于进一步减少键合层次设计原则中的$\kappa_p$。

title: Rigid Particle-Induced Anomalous Softening in Elastomer Composites
abstract: Particle-filled soft composites generally stiffen as particle loading increases, imposing a trade-off between functionality and compliance. Here, we show that this trade-off can be overcome by designing particles to actively direct gelation rather than act as passive fillers. In a sol-rich elastomer matrix, sol-phase kinetics redirect network formation towards particle-mediated assembly, yielding anomalous softening despite increasing particle content. This response is governed by topological reconfiguration of the load-bearing network during gelation rather than by filler loading alone. A structure-based model captures the composition-dependent onset of this behaviour, and the same response is reproduced across distinct particle systems. The resulting materials combine functionality with softness, energy dissipation, and recoverability under large deformation. These findings establish topology-guided gelation as a general strategy for engineering compliant functional composites for soft robotic actuation, conformal interfaces, and other systems that require both deformability and embedded material functionality.
summary: 颗粒填充的软复合材料通常会随着颗粒负载的增加而变硬，从而在功能性和合规性之间进行权衡。在这里，我们表明，可以通过设计颗粒来主动引导凝胶化而不是充当被动填料来克服这种权衡。在富含溶胶的弹性体基质中，溶胶相动力学将网络形成重定向到颗粒介导的组装，尽管颗粒含量增加，但仍产生异常软化。这种响应是由凝胶化过程中承载网络的拓扑重构决定的，而不是单独由填料负载决定。基于结构的模型捕获了这种行为的依赖于成分的开始，并且在不同的粒子系统中再现了相同的响应。所得材料将功能性与柔软性、能量耗散性和大变形下的可恢复性结合在一起。这些发现将拓扑引导凝胶化作为工程顺应性功能复合材料的通用策略，用于软机器人驱动、共形界面和其他需要变形性和嵌入材料功能的系统。

title: Momentum-resolved thermodynamics and barrier-free order-parameter collapse in spin-orbit-coupled superconductors under a Zeeman field
abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can enhance the critical Zeeman field of clean superconductors beyond the Pauli limit. We develop a momentum decomposition of the zero-temperature free energy to investigate spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductors with general time-reversal-symmetric SOC. The SOC component perpendicular to the Zeeman field enhances the critical field and suppresses first-order features, whereas the parallel component favors Pauli-limited thermodynamic behavior. Applying this framework to Rashba superconductors and Ising superconductors with weak Rashba SOC, we identify the origin of the abrupt collapse of the superconducting order parameter at the critical field. Competing angular contributions produce a nearly flat free-energy landscape, allowing a barrier-free order-parameter collapse distinct from the conventional Pauli-limited first-order transition.
summary: 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）可以增强清洁超导体的临界塞曼场，使其超出泡利极限。我们开发了零温度自由能的动量分解，以研究具有一般时间反转对称 SOC 的自旋单线 $s$ 波超导体。垂直于塞曼场的 SOC 分量增强了临界场并抑制一阶特征，而平行分量则有利于泡利极限热力学行为。将该框架应用于 Rashba 超导体和具有弱 Rashba SOC 的 Ising 超导体，我们确定了临界场处超导有序参数突然崩溃的根源。竞争的角度贡献产生了几乎平坦的自由能景观，允许与传统的泡利有限一阶跃迁不同的无障碍有序参数崩溃。

title: Zeeman-field-induced three-spin interactions and relativistic coupling to the scalar spin chirality
abstract: Magnetic fields are commonly incorporated in atomistic spin models through the Zeeman energy of individual magnetic moments. Starting from a microscopic electronic Hamiltonian, we show that the Zeeman coupling of conduction electrons also generates field-linear three-spin interactions, the lowest-order corrections allowed by time-reversal symmetry. Using a Green-function expansion of the grand potential, we identify two classes of interactions. Isotropic terms of the form $(\mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j)(\mathbf S_k\cdot\mathbf B)$ exist without spin-orbit coupling, and their total strength obeys a sum rule involving the three-site electronic loop at the Fermi energy. Relativistic terms require spin-orbit coupling and include $\mathbf K_{ijk}\cdot\mathbf B,\chi_{ijk}$, where $\chi_{ijk}=\mathbf S_i\cdot(\mathbf S_j\times\mathbf S_k)$ is the scalar spin chirality. We show that this coupling is forbidden in the spin channel without spin-orbit coupling, whereas the orbital channel recovers the orbital-flux mechanism of Mott insulators. Exact diagonalization of the Hubbard trimer confirms the independence and additivity of both channels. For magnetic trimers in Rashba electron gases, we derive analytical expressions showing that $\mathbf K_{ijk}$ lies in-plane at first order in spin-orbit coupling but vanishes for $C_{3v}$-symmetric trimers, where an out-of-plane component emerges at second order. These interactions can shift magnetization-step fields and modify field-induced noncoplanarity. In the continuum limit, the chirality coupling splits skyrmions from antiskyrmions, while the relativistic terms generate a field-dependent Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.
summary:
磁场通常通过单个磁矩的塞曼能量纳入原子自旋模型中。从微观电子哈密顿量开始，我们证明传导电子的塞曼耦合也会产生场线性三自旋相互作用，这是时间反转对称性允许的最低阶校正。使用大势的格林函数展开，我们确定了两类相互作用。 $(\mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j)(\mathbf S_k\cdot\mathbf B)$ 形式的各向同性项在没有自旋轨道耦合的情况下存在，并且它们的总强度遵循涉及费米能量处的三位点电子环路的总和规则。相对论项需要自旋轨道耦合，包括 $\mathbf K_{ijk}\cdot\mathbf B,\chi_{ijk}$，其中 $\chi_{ijk}=\mathbf S_i\cdot(\mathbf S_j\times\mathbf S_k)$ 是标量自旋手性。我们证明，这种耦合在没有自旋轨道耦合的自旋通道中是被禁止的，而轨道通道则恢复了莫特绝缘体的轨道通量机制。哈伯德三聚体的精确对角化证实了两个通道的独立性和可加性。

对于 Rashba 电子气中的磁性三聚体，我们推导出解析表达式，表明 $\mathbf K_{ijk}$ 在自旋轨道耦合中一阶位于平面内，但对于 $C_{3v}$ 对称三聚体消失，其中平面外分量在二阶出现。这些相互作用可以改变磁化阶跃场并改变场引起的非共面性。在连续极限中，手性耦合将斯格明子与反斯格明子分开，而相对论项则产生依赖于场的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用。

title: Microscopic Derivation of Stochastic Thin-Film Equation and Extensions to Two-Layer and Evaporating Films
abstract: While classical thin-film hydrodynamics models widely govern macroscopic fluid layers, they fail to capture the molecular-level thermal fluctuations that dictate nanoscale interfacial dynamics. Standard stochastic extensions rely on the long-wave approximation of the continuum fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations; however, this top-down paradigm lacks a formal connection to microscopic particle trajectories and cannot readily accommodate complex, non-equilibrium boundary mechanisms. We resolve this limitation by deriving the stochastic thin-film equation directly from the exact underlying N-particle Hamiltonian dynamics. This is achieved via a systematic, bottom-up coarse-graining framework based on a generalized fluctuating dynamic density-functional theory. Crucially, this first principles formulation offers unparalleled flexibility, enabling the seamless integration of multi-layered interfaces and non-conserved dynamics such as evaporation. For these complex configurations, our framework rigorously yields entirely novel stochastic thin-film equations featuring emergent noise terms that encapsulate microscopic fluctuations missing from classical top-down models.
summary: 虽然经典薄膜流体动力学模型广泛控制宏观流体层，但它们无法捕获决定纳米级界面动力学的分子级热波动。标准随机扩展依赖于连续波动纳维-斯托克斯方程的长波近似；然而，这种自上而下的范式缺乏与微观粒子轨迹的正式联系，并且不能轻易适应复杂的非平衡边界机制。我们通过直接从精确的底层 N 粒子哈密顿动力学推导出随机薄膜方程来解决这一限制。这是通过基于广义波动动态密度泛函理论的系统的、自下而上的粗粒度框架来实现的。至关重要的是，这一第一原理公式提供了无与伦比的灵活性，能够无缝集成多层界面和蒸发等非守恒动力学。对于这些复杂的配置，我们的框架严格地产生了全新的随机薄膜方程，其特征在于出现的噪声项封装了经典自上而下模型中缺失的微观波动。

title: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization reveals HiPIMS deposition rates exceeding direct current sputtering
abstract: Pulsed sputter processes are essential for a wide range of applications from hard coatings to microelectronics. High power impulse magnetron sputtering (HiPIMS) offers unique possibilities for process design due to its high ionized flux fraction. Because of the high peak-current densities involved, correspondingly high plasma densities generate many ions. This enables tuning of kinetic energies by applying accelerating bias potentials. However, some HiPIMS processes have low deposition rates due to the back-attraction these ions experience with the negatively charged sputter target. Recent work in HiPIMS has targeted this problem, exploring complex pulsing schemes such as bipolar, multi-pulse, or chopped HiPIMS. These pulsing schemes introduce another problem: process complexity. As such, the process space, even with coarse intervals quickly blows up to 1E5-1E20 possible process combinations. This calls for efficient and intelligent sampling, which can be enabled by machine-learning algorithms such as Bayesian optimization. In this work we use multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) to efficiently sample the process space of pulse-packets, targeting high ionization flux fractions and deposition rates. Over 2,000 distinct processes were sampled during this exploration. Surprisingly, we found that many HiPIMS processes, including single pulse, can achieve deposition rates higher than DC references. In fact, at a working pressure of 1.0 Pa and moderate ionization rates of 5-20% we found that ms-scale pulses were ideal. We hypothesize these processes maximize gas rarefaction, creating a low-collision channel between the target and the substrate. These results showcase previously unreported behavior of pulsed sputter processes and challenge a long-held trade-off between film quality and speed in thin-film manufacturing.
summary:
脉冲溅射工艺对于从硬涂层到微电子的广泛应用至关重要。高功率脉冲磁控溅射 (HiPIMS) 由于其高电离通量分数，为工艺设计提供了独特的可能性。由于涉及高峰值电流密度，相应地高等离子体密度会产生许多离子。这使得能够通过施加加速偏置电势来调节动能。然而，一些 HiPIMS 工艺的沉积速率较低，因为这些离子与带负电的溅射靶材受到反向吸引力。 HiPIMS 最近的工作针对这个问题，探索复杂的脉冲方案，例如双极、多脉冲或斩波 HiPIMS。这些脉冲方案引入了另一个问题：工艺复杂性。因此，即使间隔较粗，进程空间也很快会增加到 1E5-1E20 个可能的进程组合。这就需要高效、智能的采样，这可以通过贝叶斯优化等机器学习算法来实现。

在这项工作中，我们使用多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）来有效地对脉冲包的过程空间进行采样，以高电离通量分数和沉积速率为目标。在这次探索过程中，我们对 2,000 多个不同的过程进行了采样。令人惊讶的是，我们发现许多 HiPIMS 工艺（包括单脉冲）可以实现高于 DC 参考的沉积速率。事实上，在 1.0 Pa 的工作压力和 5-20% 的中等电离率下，我们发现毫秒级脉冲是理想的。我们假设这些过程最大化了气体稀疏，在目标和基底之间创建了低碰撞通道。这些结果展示了以前未报道的脉冲溅射工艺的行为，并挑战了薄膜制造中薄膜质量和速度之间长期存在的权衡。

title: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
abstract: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.
summary:
针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性调整预先训练的机器学习原子间势需要在不降低近平衡弹性和振动响应的情况下提高缺陷精度。在这里，我们通过集成条件读数不确定性、迭代全参数更新和协议兼容的相对能量锚定来实现铝 MACE 势 QP17 的平衡。超过 144 个线性读出权重的灵敏度指导采集，并具有批内协方差更新和不断发展的神经表示。经过四轮主动学习（32 次获取配置和 400 次梯度更新）后，力不确定性获取将平均开发力误差从 22.43 减少到 21.52 meV/Angstrom，在相同更新预算下优于随机采样 (22.70)、几何多样性选择 (22.46) 和所有 104 个候选标签 (22.71) 的统一训练。所有三个力不确定度运行都满足体机械保留标准：历史相对能量误差从 0.375 meV/atom 减少到 0.207 meV/atom，而谐波声子均方根漂移保持在 0.05 THz 以下。

匹配的客观消融表明相对能量锚定抑制谐波漂移。跨平面断层、孪晶界和晶界的样本外评估表明，即使从未拟合维里应力，缺陷能量和偏应力也可转移。闭环分子动力学和密度泛函理论 (MD-DFT) 试验证实，自动接受门控会拦截违反历史弹性群能量或振动容差的更新。这些组件共同建立了一个保留约束的微调协议，用于改善塑性变形可观测值，同时保留测试的整体机械响应。

title: Information-thermodynamic principles unveil the response of complex networks to perturbations
abstract: Understanding how complex networks respond to perturbations is key to uncovering their functional organization. We show that, for a maximum-entropy perturbation prior, standard diffusion cannot increase response entropy, a measure of the diversity of the system's response. To overcome this limitation, we develop a density-matrix-based information thermodynamics of perturbation responses along arbitrary dynamical trajectories. We show that this framework is grounded in an information-theoretic principle of least dissipation and introduces a generalized free energy that quantifies deviations from an instantaneous diffusive reference. We then illustrate the formalism using nonlinear complex networks, revealing regimes of enhanced response diversity that cannot be captured by standard diffusive descriptions.
summary: 了解复杂网络如何响应扰动是揭示其功能组织的关键。我们表明，对于最大熵扰动先验，标准扩散不能增加响应熵（系统响应多样性的度量）。为了克服这一限制，我们开发了一种基于密度矩阵的沿任意动态轨迹的微扰响应的信息热力学。我们证明该框架基于最小耗散的信息论原理，并引入了广义自由能来量化与瞬时扩散参考的偏差。然后，我们使用非线性复杂网络来说明形式主义，揭示标准扩散描述无法捕获的增强响应多样性的机制。

title: Wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets and its dependency on topological defects
abstract: We investigate the wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets under uniaxial compression using a Surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich (SPFCH) model, which captures the coupling between crystalline order, out-of-plane deformations, and topological defects. In particular, the model allows us to track and characterize two distinct classes of defects, namely those forming in the underlying hexagonal crystal lattice, such as dislocations and grain boundaries, and defects in the wrinkling patterns, known as wrinklons. By resolving the evolution and interactions of these defects, we investigate how the interplay between in-plane and out-of-plane relaxation mechanisms influences wrinkling onset and the coarsening regime. Our results indicate that crystalline defects do not affect coarsening scaling, but they quantitatively affect the onset of wrinkling and the emerging wrinkling wavelength, promote more irregular wrinkle patterns with a higher density of wrinklons, and modify long-timescale morphological evolution.
summary: 我们使用表面相场晶体赫尔弗里希 (SPFCH) 模型研究了单轴压缩下薄晶体片的起皱动力学，该模型捕获了晶体有序、面外变形和拓扑缺陷之间的耦合。特别是，该模型使我们能够跟踪和表征两类不同的缺陷，即在底层六方晶格中形成的缺陷，例如位错和晶界，以及皱纹图案中的缺陷（称为皱纹）。通过解决这些缺陷的演变和相互作用，我们研究了面内和面外松弛机制之间的相互作用如何影响起皱的开始和粗化状态。我们的结果表明，晶体缺陷不影响粗化结垢，但它们定量地影响皱纹的出现和出现的皱纹波长，促进具有更高密度的皱纹的更不规则的皱纹图案，并改变长期尺度的形态演化。

title: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
abstract: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the $D_5$ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.
summary:
我们将先前基于群论的准晶体（QC）共线磁性分类推广到一般磁态。以彭罗斯晶格为例，我们发现$D_5$点群的所有属于二维不可约表示（IRRP）的磁态，包括共线态和共面态，都对应于交变磁性（AM）。与传统的共线 AM 不同，其中零磁性受到保护，例如旋转或镜面反射会全局翻转磁性图案中的自旋，这些 2D-IRRP 状态中的零磁性反而受到特殊群论正交定理的保护，该定理属于不同 IRRP 的基函数始终相互正交。以单轨道彭罗斯-哈伯德为例，我们基于线性响应理论的计算表明，参数空间的最大部分被这些2D-IRRP态占据，并且我们进一步基于Ginzburg-Landau理论的分析表明，2D IRRP中两个基本磁态的极化方向可以是平行或垂直的，从而导致共线或共面磁态。

特殊的群论正交性补偿机制和PT对称性的缺失最终导致AM态，这将通过自旋相关角分辨光电子能谱中的自旋分裂和自旋电导来验证。这些有趣的共线和共面 AM 也可以出现在其他 QC 中。

title: One ring to rule them all: syzygy maximization for Argyres-Douglas
abstract: We propose a uniform construction of affine schemes encoding the Higgs branches and Macdonald indices of the Argyres--Douglas theories $\mathcal{D}_p(ADE)$, with $\gcd(p,h^\vee)=1$. The construction captures conjectural OPE decoupling relations via the Jacobian ring of a single invariant polynomial potential, obtained from a polynomial twisted period of the corresponding Coxeter orbit space. We show that these potentials are ``syzygy-maximizing'' in the first jet schemes and recover the Higgs branches as their reduced critical loci. We obtain closed determinant expressions for the classical types and explicit potentials for $E_6$, $E_7$, and $E_8$. Powers of the nilradical define an intrinsic filtration on the resulting Jacobian rings, from which we compute candidate Macdonald indices with the correct Schur and Hall--Littlewood limits, in the examples studied. Restricting the potentials to Slodowy slices extends the prescription to nilpotently Higgsed theories. We further conjecture that these Jacobian rings are isomorphic to Zhu's $C_2$-algebras of simple affine VOAs at boundary admissible levels and their quantum Drinfeld--Sokolov reductions.
summary: 我们提出了仿射方案的统一构造，编码阿盖尔-道格拉斯理论 $\mathcal{D}_p(ADE)$ 的希格斯分支和麦克唐纳指数，其中 $\gcd(p,h^\vee)=1$。该结构通过单个不变多项式势的雅可比环捕获推测的 OPE 解耦关系，该雅可比环是从相应 Coxeter 轨道空间的多项式扭曲周期获得的。我们证明这些势在第一个喷射方案中是“syzygy-maximizing”，并恢复希格斯分支作为其减少的关键位点。我们获得了经典类型的闭合行列式表达式以及 $E_6$、$E_7$ 和 $E_8$ 的显式势。在所研究的示例中，零自由基的幂定义了对所得雅可比环的内在过滤，从中我们可以使用正确的 Schur 和 Hall-Littlewood 极限计算候选麦克唐纳指数。将势限制为 Slodowy 切片将处方扩展到幂零 Higgsed 理论。我们进一步推测这些雅可比环与朱的$C_2$-边界允许水平上的简单仿射VOA代数及其量子Drinfeld-Sokolov约同构。

title: Construction of holomorphic SCFTs with minimal index
abstract: It has been an open question whether there exist holomorphic VOAs with N=1 supersymmetry and Witten index 1 for any positive central charge c. The existence of such a theory with c=288 is closely related to the 576-periodicity of the TMF spectrum via the Segal-Stolz-Teichner conjecture. Here we report the construction of thousands of such theories by extending the approach initiated by Gaiotto and Johnson-Freyd via ternary codes. In addition, for every positive integer k, we also construct holomorphic N=1 VOAs of central charge c=12k with index 24/gcd(24,k) -- conjectured to be the minimum -- in a computer-aided search carried out by AI coding agents. We overcome the exponential-time barrier by using chains of smaller cells to build ternary codes, whose indices can then be evaluated via a transfer-matrix technique, and we use a symmetric orbifold construction to reduce the problem of k=12 and 24 to that of k=6. Along the way, we also establish several results on ternary codes and their indices. Using an observation relating codes and Landau-Ginzburg orbifold models, we argue that the non-chiral doubles of the ternary code VOAs can always be gapped supersymmetrically.
summary: 对于任何正中心电荷 c 是否存在具有 N=1 超对称性和威滕指数 1 的全纯 VOA 一直是一个悬而未决的问题。这种 c=288 理论的存在与通过 Segal-Stolz-Teichner 猜想得到的 TMF 谱的 576 周期性密切相关。在这里，我们通过三元代码扩展 Gaiotto 和 Johnson-Freyd 发起的方法，报告了数千个此类理论的构建。此外，对于每个正整数 k，我们还在人工智能编码代理执行的计算机辅助搜索中构造了中心电荷 c=12k 的全纯 N=1 VOA，索引为 24/gcd(24,k)（推测为最小值）。我们通过使用更小的单元链构建三进制代码来克服指数时间障碍，然后可以通过转移矩阵技术评估其索引，并且我们使用对称轨道结构将 k=12 和 24 的问题减少到 k=6 的问题。在此过程中，我们还建立了关于三进制代码及其索引的一些结果。使用有关代码和 Landau-Ginzburg 轨道模型的观察，我们认为三元代码 VOA 的非手性双打总是可以超对称地间隙。

title: The Free Scalar as a Thermal Envelope for Three-Dimensional CFTs
abstract: We conjecture that every unitary three-dimensional conformal field theory obeys $c_S/C_T\leq16\pi\zeta(3)$, where $s=c_ST^2$ is the thermal entropy density and $C_T$ the stress-tensor two-point coefficient, with equality for free scalars. We embed this in a stronger conjecture: on $S^1\times H^2$, the $C_T$-normalized hyperbolic heat capacity is bounded above by that of the free scalar for all $T\geq(2\pi R)^{-1}$. Near the conformal temperature, for theories smooth from the high-temperature side and without boundary terms in the modular Hamiltonian, the heat-capacity bound follows from conformal-collider positivity. We test the conjectures in free, interacting large-$N$, and holographic theories. Monte Carlo data for the three-dimensional Ising and $O(N)$ models also obey the flat-space bound.
summary: 我们推测每个酉三维共形场论都遵循 $c_S/C_T\leq16\pi\zeta(3)$，其中 $s=c_ST^2$ 是热熵密度，$C_T$ 是应力张量两点系数，对于自由标量来说是相等的。我们将其嵌入到一个更强的猜想中：在 $S^1\times H^2$ 上，$C_T$ 归一化双曲热容受所有 $T\geq(2\pi R)^{-1}$ 的自由标量的限制。在共形温度附近，对于从高温侧平滑的理论并且在模哈密顿量中没有边界项，热容界限由共形对撞机正性得出。我们用自由的、相互作用的大$N$和全息理论来测试这些猜想。三维 Ising 和 $O(N)$ 模型的蒙特卡洛数据也遵循平坦空间界限。

title: Spin-Induced Coordinate Noncommutativity of the Covariant Centroid
abstract:
The Tulczyjew-Dixon centroid of a massive spinning particle, built as a composite of canonical Poincaré variables, carries the exact coordinate algebra $\{X^\mu,X^
u\}=-S^{\mu
u}/p^2$, whose noncommutativity bivector is the transverse spin tensor of the particle itself rather than an external background. That bracket and its Compton-scale magnitude are already known, and we recover them here as the starting point of the analysis, not as a result. What the composite realization settles is the domain on which the algebra may be used. Closure of the Jacobi identity requires $p^{-2}$ to remain operator valued, and the exactness domain is the convex timelike interior $\Omega_\mu$, on which states supported on a single mass shell are distributional. We show that freezing $p^2$ to its shell value inside the centroid leaves every two-operator commutator unchanged on shell, so that the projected position dictionary, the Berry cancellation and the endpoint transversality identity are untouched, while the same substitution fails from three insertions onward, with residue the truncated Jacobiator $2\epsilon^{\mu
uho\sigma}W_\sigma/(p^2)^2$. This two-versus-three criterion replaces the qualitative restriction to shell-preserving matrix elements and states which constructions built on a fixed-shell bivector $\Theta_m$ remain valid. We then follow the algebra through positive-energy projection, packet-conditioned Moyal fibers, Compton routing holonomy and projected nonassociative products, recording for each layer whether it falls on the safe side of the criterion. No prediction beyond QED follows. In the geometric branch the physical amplitude reduces to the QED amplitude, and the transverse matching coefficients remain uncomputed.
summary:
巨大自旋粒子的 Tulczyjew-Dixon 质心由规范庞加莱变量组成，带有精确的坐标代数 $\{X^\mu,X^
u\}=-S^{\mu
u}/p^2$，其非交换性双向量是粒子本身的横向自旋张量，而不是外部背景。该括号及其康普顿尺度星等是已知的，我们在这里恢复它们作为分析的起点，而不是作为结果。复合实现解决的是代数可以使用的领域。雅可比恒等式的闭合要求 $p^{-2}$ 保持算子值，并且精确性域是凸仿时内部 $\Omega_\mu$，在该内部单个质量壳上支持的状态是分布的。我们表明，将 $p^2$ 冻结到质心内的壳值会使壳上的每个二算子换向器保持不变，因此投影位置字典、贝里取消和端点横向恒等式不会受到影响，而相同的替换从三个插入开始失败，并残留截断的雅可比算子 $2\epsilon^{\mu
uho\sigma}W_\sigma/(p^2)^2$。

这种二对三标准取代了对保留壳矩阵元素的定性限制，并说明了基于固定壳双向量 $\Theta_m$ 构建的哪些结构仍然有效。然后，我们通过正能量投影、包条件 Moyal 纤维、康普顿路由完整和投影非关联积来跟踪代数，记录每一层是否落在标准的安全范围内。没有超出 QED 的预测。在几何分支中，物理幅度减小为 QED 幅度，并且横向匹配系数保持未计算。

title: Berends-Giele currents for higher derivative gauge theories
abstract: We derive Berends-Giele (BG) currents for higher derivative scalar QED (HDQED) and Yang-Mills (HDYM). In HDQED, we first compute the propagators and the vertices from the higher derivative Lagrangian and discuss the pole structures of the photon and the scalar. We then compute the BG currents using the Feynman diagram setup and prove the Ward identities for these currents at two and three points. Next, we used the perturbiner formalism to re-compute these currents and show that they are consistent with the Feynman diagram approach. In a similar fashion, we derive the BG currents in higher derivative Yang-Mills and find that remarkably, these currents are equal to pure Yang-Mills currents when all external on-shell legs are massless gluons. We prove this in all generality using the BG recursion and explicitly show this at lower points. However, the genuine higher derivative structure enters when one or many on-shell states are the so called massive Merlin modes. Using the multi-particle currents, we reproduce the result that all tree level amplitudes with one Merlin particle vanishes and the three and four Merlin amplitudes match the previously computed result. The future prospects of BG recursion for higher derivative gravity and off-shell colour- kinematics duality is also discussed.
summary:
我们推导了高导数标量 QED (HDQED) 和 Yang-Mills (HDYM) 的 Berends-Giele (BG) 电流。在 HDQED 中，我们首先根据高阶导数拉格朗日计算传播子和顶点，并讨论光子和标量的极结构。然后，我们使用费曼图设置计算 BG 电流，并证明这些电流在两点和三点处的沃德恒等式。接下来，我们使用扰动器形式重新计算这些电流，并表明它们与费曼图方法一致。以类似的方式，我们推导了高导数杨米尔斯电流，并发现，当所有外部壳腿都是无质量胶子时，这些电流等于纯杨米尔斯电流。我们使用 BG 递归证明了这一点的普遍性，并在较低的点明确地表明了这一点。然而，当一个或多个壳上态是所谓的大质量梅林模式时，就会进入真正的高阶导数结构。使用多粒子流，我们重现了一个结果，即具有一个 Merlin 粒子的所有树级振幅消失，并且三个和四个 Merlin 振幅与先前计算的结果相匹配。

还讨论了 BG 递归在更高导数重力和离壳颜色运动学对偶性方面的未来前景。

title: Fixed Points of the Yang-Mills Gradient Flow in the Vortex Sector
abstract: We study the Yang-Mills gradient flow of center vortices in SU(2) gauge theory. For axially symmetric vortices the flow reduces exactly to a linear diffusion equation for the radial profile: a Gaussian core keeps its shape while its width grows as $\sqrt{R^2+4t}$, the flux is exactly conserved, and the thin vortex is the unique bounded fixed point, though not an attractor. Off-diagonal perturbations are governed by a pair of radial Schrödinger operators, and a variational computation shows that, frozen at any instant, the Abelian core has a tachyonic mode for every winding $n\geq 1$. Since the core spreads while the mode grows, we pass to self-similar variables, where the unstable modes are known in closed form, with growth exponents $\mu_{n,m}=n-1+m$. Multiply wound vortices are therefore unstable, while the fundamental vortex is exactly marginal and stays Abelian. A scaling argument rules out any static vortex in the transverse plane, and the instability acquires a simple geometric meaning that shortens the path traced in SU(2) by the holonomy of a growing loop, lowering the winding by two. The flow thus drives every vortex toward the Abelian core of winding $n \bmod 2$, with non-Abelian structure appearing only as the transient through which multiply wound cores unwind.
summary:
我们研究了SU(2)规范理论中中心涡的Yang-Mills梯度流。对于轴对称涡流，流动精确地简化为径向轮廓的线性扩散方程：高斯核心保持其形状，而其宽度增长为 $\sqrt{R^2+4t}$，通量完全守恒，并且薄涡流是唯一有界固定点，尽管不是吸引子。非对角线扰动由一对径向薛定谔算子控制，变分计算表明，在任何时刻冻结，阿贝尔核心对于每个绕组 $n\geq 1$ 都有一个快子模式。由于核心随着模式的增长而扩展，我们传递给自相似变量，其中不稳定模式以封闭形式已知，增长指数为 $\mu_{n,m}=n-1+m$。因此，多重缠绕涡旋是不稳定的，而基本涡旋恰好是边缘的并且保持阿贝尔涡旋。缩放参数排除了横向平面中的任何静态涡流，并且不稳定性获得了简单的几何意义，即通过增长环的完整性缩短了 SU(2) 中追踪的路径，从而将绕组降低了两倍。

因此，流动将每个涡流驱动到绕组 $n \bmod 2$ 的阿贝尔核心，非阿贝尔结构仅作为多绕组核心展开的瞬态出现。

title: Exact Stress Tensor Flows in Causal Electrodynamics: Courant-Hilbert Approach
abstract: It has been shown that for theories whose Courant-Hilbert function depends on a single dimensionful coupling, the energy-momentum tensor is controlled by the two combinations $\tau\dot{\ell}$ and $\ell-\tau\dot{\ell}$, so that the quadratic invariants $X=T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$ and $Y=(T^\mu{}_\mu)^2$ depend on a single auxiliary variable. Eliminating this variable in favour of $Y/X$ yields the exact autonomous flow $\partial_\lambda\mathcal L=X\,\mathcal F(Y/X)$, with no explicit dependence on the coupling, the electromagnetic invariants or the CH parameter, on every branch where the map is invertible. The expansion of $\mathcal F$ in powers of $\sqrt{Y/X}$ shows which flows are built from integer powers of $X$ and $Y$ and which require half-integer powers. In this paper, we work out four examples in closed form, each with its analytic structure and physical interpretation: the generalized Born-Infeld theory, whose flow is quadratic in the stress tensor; the $q$-deformed family, in which the odd coefficients of the expansion vanish at $q=1/2$ and are nonzero otherwise; the no-$\tau$-maximum theory; and the causal Russo-Townsend logarithmic theory, whose flow involves the lower real branch of the Lambert $W$ function and reproduces the known perturbative result. The singular points of $\mathcal{F}$ are related to the critical fields, energy conditions, and strong-field behavior of each theory.
summary:
已经证明，对于 Courant-Hilbert 函数依赖于单维耦合的理论，能量动量张量由 $\tau\dot{\ell}$ 和 $\ell-\tau\dot{\ell}$ 两个组合控制，因此二次不变量 $X=T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$ 和 $Y=(T^\mu{}_\mu)^2$ 取决于单个辅助变量。消除此变量以支持 $Y/X$ 会产生精确的自主流 $\partial_\lambda\mathcal L=X\,\mathcal F(Y/X)$，在映射可逆的每个分支上，不明确依赖于耦合、电磁不变量或 CH 参数。 $\mathcal F$ 以 $\sqrt{Y/X}$ 的幂展开表示哪些流是由 $X$ 和 $Y$ 的整数幂构建的，哪些流需要半整数幂。

在本文中，我们以封闭形式给出了四个例子，每个例子都有其解析结构和物理解释：广义的Born-Infeld理论，其流动在应力张量中是二次的； $q$ 变形族，其中展开的奇数系数在 $q=1/2$ 时消失，否则不为零；无-$\tau$-最大值理论；因果 Russo-Townsend 对数理论，其流程涉及兰伯特 $W$ 函数的下实数分支并再现已知的微扰结果。 $\mathcal{F}$ 的奇点与每个理论的临界场、能量条件和强场行为有关。

title: Holographic entropy inequalities & typical states
abstract: As a consequence of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula, static semiclassical states in AdS quantum gravity share a set of special properties expressible as linear inequalities on their entanglement entropies. How general are these properties? Do they still hold when we move away from the regime of validity of RT, i.e. static states in classical Einstein gravity? Do they perhaps hold even for some class of non-holographic states? We will motivate these questions and review what's known about the answers.
summary: 根据 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式，AdS 量子引力中的静态半经典态共享一组特殊性质，可表示为纠缠熵的线性不等式。这些属性有多普遍？当我们远离 RT 的有效性体系（即经典爱因斯坦引力中的静态）时，它们是否仍然成立？即使对于某些类别的非全息状态，它们也可能成立吗？我们将提出这些问题并回顾已知的答案。

title: Revisiting monodromy defects in $\text{O}(N)$ conformal field theories
abstract: Monodromy defects are fundamental objects in extended quantum systems with global symmetries. We study such defects in $\text{O}(N)$ conformal field theories (CFT), which describe the universality class of $\text{O}(N)$ spontaneous symmetry breaking transitions. In particular, we consider partial-monodromy defects, whose corresponding symmetry transformations only act on a subset of the fundamental $\text{O}(N)$ vector field. We develop an analytical theory of the defect phases, using both renormalization group and large $N$ expansion. In general (spacetime) dimensions $3\leq d<4$, multiple defect CFTs are identified, which are described by appropriate boundary conditions for the vector field near the defect. Near $d=3$, we show that in the large $N$ limit, a stable defect CFT always exists, characterized by the so-called ("standard") "alternate" boundary conditions for the (twisted) untwisted fields, whose defect correlations are (suppressed) enhanced. We then perform large-scale classical Monte Carlo simulations of monodromy defects in the O(3) CFT in an improved lattice model and numerically extract the defect scaling dimensions. The numerical results are in qualitative agreement with the stable defect CFT identified in the field theory.
summary:
单峰缺陷是具有全局对称性的扩展量子系统中的基本对象。我们在 $\text{O}(N)$ 共形场论 (CFT) 中研究此类缺陷，该理论描述了 $\text{O}(N)$ 自发对称破缺跃迁的普遍性类。特别是，我们考虑部分单性缺陷，其相应的对称变换仅作用于基本 $\text{O}(N)$ 向量场的子集。我们使用重正化群和大的 $N$ 展开来开发缺陷相的分析理论。在一般（时空）维度 $3\leq d<4$ 中，识别出多个缺陷 CFT，这些缺陷通过缺陷附近矢量场的适当边界条件进行描述。 Near $d=3$, we show that in the large $N$ limit, a stable defect CFT always exists, characterized by the so-called ("standard") "alternate" boundary conditions for the (twisted) untwisted fields, whose defect correlations are (suppressed) enhanced.然后，我们在改进的晶格模型中对 O(3) CFT 中的单峰缺陷进行大规模经典蒙特卡罗模拟，并以数值方式提取缺陷尺度尺寸。

数值结果与场论中确定的稳定缺陷 CFT 定性一致。

title: Lifshitz Phase of Quantum Gravity: The Infrared Fixed Point of the (2+1)D Unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons Model
abstract: We consider a nonrelativistic gravity theory in (2+1) dimensions with $w_\infty$ gauge symmetry that we call unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity. The theory has three dimensionless couplings, one of which is the Chern-Simons level $\kappa$. At large $|\kappa|$, the theory flows from an asymptotically free UV fixed point to an IR fixed point with anisotropic scale invariance characterized by a dynamical critical exponent $z=2-\tfrac32|\kappa|^{-1}$. We speculate that unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity undergoes a phase transition from this scale-invariant phase to a confining phase when $\kappa$ drops below a critical value.
summary: 我们考虑具有 $w_\infty$ 规范对称性的 (2+1) 维度中的非相对论引力理论，我们将其称为单模 Hořava-Chern-Simons 引力。该理论具有三个无量纲耦合，其中之一是 Chern-Simons 能级 $\kappa$。在大 $|\kappa|$ 下，理论从渐近自由 UV 固定点流向具有各向异性尺度不变性的 IR 固定点，其特征在于动态临界指数 $z=2-\tfrac32|\kappa|^{-1}$。我们推测，当 $\kappa$ 降至临界值以下时，单模 Hořava-Chern-Simons 引力会经历从尺度不变相到限制相的相变。

title: Perturbative Holonomy Potentials and Vacua in Chiral Supersymmetric Gauge Theories
abstract: We establish global control of perturbative D-term data governing semiclassical vacuum sectors in chiral supersymmetric gauge theories on $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$. A closed-form, one-loop-exact D-term coefficient, including 4d Fayet--Iliopoulos (FI) parameters, gives a uniformly controlled leading potential away from massless thresholds and fixes local FI and Chern--Simons couplings near them. This allows lifting the 3d Intriligator--Seiberg classification of semiclassical vacua to $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$ across the compact holonomy space. The framework is showcased by finding a remarkably rich set of vacuum sectors in a simple abelian model and reproducing on flat space the R-twisted reduction of an $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ Maruyoshi--Song theory to the Gang--Yamazaki theory, first found on $S^3\times S^1$. The examples demonstrate the stakes of global matching: true vacua may lie at nontrivial holonomy even with nonzero threshold values of the Coulomb-slice D-coefficient, and despite vanishing D-coefficient at trivial holonomy.
summary: 我们在 $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$ 上建立了手性超对称规范理论中控制半经典真空扇区的微扰 D 项数据的全局控制。闭式、单环精确 D 项系数，包括 4d Fayet-Iliopoulos (FI) 参数，给出了远离无质量阈值的统一控制的超前势，并修复了它们附近的局部 FI 和 Chern-Simons 耦合。这允许将半经典真空的 3d Intriligator-Seiberg 分类提升到紧凑完整空间中的 $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$。该框架通过在简单的阿贝尔模型中找到一组非常丰富的真空扇区并在平面空间上再现 $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ Maruyoshi-Song 理论到 Gang--Yamazaki 理论的 R 扭曲约简来展示，该理论首先在 $S^3\times S^1$ 上发现。这些例子证明了全局匹配的风险：即使库仑切片 D 系数的阈值非零，并且尽管 D 系数在平凡完整性中消失，真正的真空也可能存在于非平凡完整性中。

title: All-plus Yang--Mills and gravity wavefunctions in de Sitter space
abstract: We present sewing representations for tree-level all-plus wavefunctions in four-dimensional de Sitter space. For Yang--Mills theory, the arbitrary-multiplicity formula is a sum over noncrossing polygon dissections, with each cell carrying energy differences of a full lower-point wavefunction. The absence of a generic total-energy pole is manifest, while partial-energy residues are determined by the lower-point factors. We derive this representation from self-dual Yang--Mills solutions. For Einstein gravity, we propose an arbitrary-multiplicity formula consisting of an alternating sum over labelled sewing trees plus a local gravitational Chern--Simons term. This local term arises from the self-dual Einstein action and supplies boundary data not fixed by internal-energy cuts. We derive a generating formula for it from the boundary connection and give explicit expressions through seven points.
summary: 我们提出了四维德西特空间中树级全波函数的缝合表示。对于杨-米尔斯理论，任意重数公式是非交叉多边形剖分的总和，每个单元携带完整低点波函数的能量差。显然不存在通用的总能量极点，而部分能量剩余则由较低点因素决定。我们从自对偶杨-米尔斯解中推导出这种表示。对于爱因斯坦引力，我们提出了一个任意重数公式，该公式由标记缝纫树上的交替和加上局部引力 Chern-Simons 项组成。该局部项源自自对偶爱因斯坦作用，并提供未通过内能切割固定的边界数据。我们从边界连接推导出它的生成公式，并通过七个点给出了明确的表达式。

title: Exact lattice bosonization of the double-scaled $c=1$ matrix model
abstract: In a recent paper by two of us, it has been shown that entanglement entropy (EE) of matrix quantum mechanics (or, equivalently, of a non-relativistic fermion model) has a natural interpretation in terms of an exact bosonization of the fermion theory in terms of a lattice boson with lattice spacing $\sim 1/N$ (where $N$ is the rank of the matrix, equal to the number of fermions). The theory of this lattice boson is distinct from a latticized version of the "collective variable'' theory which is formulated in terms of the fermion density $\rho(\lambda)$ ("collective variable''); it is, in fact, more closely related to the Wigner distribution of the fermions. In this paper, we develop this connection further for the $c=1$ double scaled matrix model. Even though $N$ becomes infinite, the double scaled theory is described by a boson on a finite and non-uniform lattice spacing, of order $\sim g_s(x) l_s$ (where $g_s(x) \equiv g_s {\rm cosech}^2(x/l_s)$ is a position dependent string coupling). We explicitly derive the $c=1$ EE, as well as the one and two-point functions of fermion density from the lattice boson. The results are explicitly finite, unlike the collective variable theory which is shown to yield divergent answers. Our results suggest that while local observables such as the EE and $\langle \rho(\lambda) \rangle$, are characterized by a unique short distance scale $g_s(x) l_s$, the asymptotic observables such as the S-matrix at every genus are characterized by a short distance scale $l_s$. We show how this arises and discuss a possible interpretation in terms of D0 brane physics.
summary:
我们两个人最近发表的一篇论文表明，矩阵量子力学（或者等效地，非相对论费米子模型）的纠缠熵（EE）对于费米子理论的精确玻色化有一个自然的解释，即用晶格间距为 $\sim 1/N$ 的晶格玻色子（其中 $N$ 是矩阵的秩，等于费米子的数量）。这种晶格玻色子的理论不同于“集体变量”理论的格子化版本，后者是根据费米子密度$\rho(\lambda)$（“集体变量”）来表述的；事实上，它与费米子的维格纳分布更为密切相关。在本文中，我们针对 $c=1$ 双尺度矩阵模型进一步开发了这种联系。即使$N$变得无限，双尺度理论是由有限且非均匀晶格间距上的玻色子描述的，阶数为$\sim g_s(x) l_s$（其中$g_s(x) \equiv g_s {\rm cosech}^2(x/l_s)$是位置相关的弦耦合）。我们明确地从晶格玻色子中推导出 $c=1$ EE 以及费米子密度的一点和两点函数。

与集体变量理论不同，结果是明确有限的，集体变量理论会产生不同的答案。我们的结果表明，虽然 EE 和 $\langle \rho(\lambda) \rangle$ 等局部可观测量具有独特的短距离尺度 $g_s(x) l_s$ 的特征，但每个属的渐近可观测量（例如 S 矩阵）都具有短距离尺度 $l_s$ 的特征。我们展示了这是如何产生的，并讨论了 D0 膜物理学的可能解释。

title: Spiralling into Dark Energy: Axio-Dilaton Attractors in Light of Current Data
abstract: In string compactifications, dilaton-like moduli always come paired with axions, and the two fields interact through a curved field-space metric. We study the cosmology of such an axio-dilaton system, in which the dilaton rolls down an exponential potential corrected by a polynomial prefactor and couples to a massless axion through the kinetic function $W=e^{-\xi\phi_1/M_p}$. A dynamical systems analysis shows that the late-time attractor follows a non-geodesic trajectory in field space with equation of state $\omega_\phi=(\lambda-2\xi)/(\lambda+2\xi)$, so accelerated expansion is possible for steep potentials provided $\xi\gg\lambda$. No physical fixed point is phantom. A Bayesian analysis with DESI DR2 BAO, binned Pantheon supernovae and Planck 2018 distance priors gives $\lambda\gtrsim7$--$9$ and $\log_{10}\xi\gtrsim2.5$ at 95% confidence, together with a degeneracy between the two parameters. The model is slightly favoured over $\Lambda$CDM by current data, while the different polynomial corrections cannot yet be distinguished. This contribution is based on arXiv:2609.22539 .
summary: 在弦紧化中，类膨胀模总是与轴子配对，并且两个场通过弯曲的场空间度量相互作用。我们研究了这种轴膨胀系统的宇宙学，其中膨胀滚动下降由多项式前因子校正的指数势，并通过动力学函数 $W=e^{-\xi\phi_1/M_p}$ 耦合到无质量轴子。动力系统分析表明，后期吸引子在场空间中遵循非测地线轨迹，其状态方程为 $\omega_\phi=(\lambda-2\xi)/(\lambda+2\xi)$，因此在 $\xi\gg\lambda$ 的情况下，陡峭势的加速膨胀是可能的。没有物理固定点是幻影的。使用 DESI DR2 BAO、分箱万神殿超新星和 Planck 2018 距离先验进行贝叶斯分析，给出 $\lambda\gtrsim7$--$9$ 和 $\log_{10}\xi\gtrsim2.5$ 的置信度为 95%，以及两个参数之间的简并性。从当前数据来看，该模型略优于 $\Lambda$CDM，但尚无法区分不同的多项式修正。此贡献基于 arXiv:2609.22539 。

title: Nonlinear Higher-Spin Theory in $O(4,1)$ de Sitter Space
abstract: Four versions of the higher-spin gauge theory compatible with $O(4,1)$ de Sitter geometry in presence of fermions are proposed. Two of them exhibit the structure of $\mathbb{Z}_2\times \mathbb{Z}_2$ Lie superalgebra proposed originally by one of the authors for the description of de Sitter supergravity \cite{Vasiliev:1985vtv}. Two of the proposed models are unitary in the bosonic sectors in analogy with the recent proposal by Lang and Neiman \cite{Lang:2026inn} and admit a pseudo involution in presence of fermions suggesting possible (anti)unitarity associated either with the time reversal in $dS_4$ or with the space-time doubling.
summary: 提出了在费米子存在的情况下与 $O(4,1)$ 德西特几何兼容的高自旋规范理论的四个版本。其中两个展示了 $\mathbb{Z}_2\times \mathbb{Z}_2$ 李超代数的结构，最初由一位作者为描述德西特超引力而提出\cite{Vasiliev:1985vtv}。两个提出的模型在玻色子扇区中是幺正的，类似于 Lang 和 Neiman \cite{Lang:2026inn} 最近的提议，并承认在费米子存在的情况下存在伪对合，这表明可能与 $dS_4$ 中的时间反转或时空倍增相关的（反）幺正性。

title: Two-node Dualities from Elementary Dualities in 3d and 4d
abstract: A new 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ two-node Seiberg-like duality, analogous to the 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Intriligator--Leigh--Strassler~(ILS) duality, is proposed. As strong evidence, we check the agreement between the 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ ellipsoid partition functions for numerous cases using s-confinement method. Surprisingly, our derivation assumes only two elementary 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ dualities: Aharony and Benini--Benvenuti--Pasquetti, which reinforces the idea dualities from dualities. We also revisit the original ILS duality and provide a derivation based on nodewise dualities. In particular, we apply a sequence of Seiberg and Kutasov--Schwimmer dualities to individual gauge nodes, with Higgsing at an intermediate step, and subsequently integrate out the massive fields.
summary: 提出了一种新的 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ 双节点类 Seiberg 对偶性，类似于 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Intriligator--Leigh--Strassler~(ILS) 对偶性。作为强有力的证据，我们使用 s 限制方法检查了许多情况下 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ 椭球配分函数之间的一致性。令人惊讶的是，我们的推导仅假设两个基本的 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ 对偶：Aharony 和 Benini--Benvenuti--Pasquetti，这从对偶中强化了对偶的思想。我们还重新审视了原始的 ILS 对偶性，并提供了基于节点对偶性的推导。特别是，我们将一系列 Seiberg 和 Kutasov-Schwimmer 对偶性应用于各个规范节点，中间步骤是 Higgsing，然后整合出巨大的场。

title: Reparametrisation invariance, anomalies and pseudoscalar states in massless quantum electrodynamics
abstract: In electrodynamics, and more generally in gauge theories, quantisation introduces an ambiguity whereby the vector current, the axial current, or both may acquire an anomalous divergence. These anomalies can be classified as relevant, conventionally associated with the infrared properties of the theory, and irrelevant, arising from the freedom in the choice of renormalisation scheme. We show that, under a axial reparametrisation of the fermion fields, the global axial symmetry can be promoted to a gauge redundancy. Requiring this gauge symmetry to be preserved at the quantum level eliminates the irrelevant anomalies, leaving a non-propagating pseudoscalar field that acts as a Lagrange multiplier enforcing the familiar axial anomaly. We further argue that, on topologically non-trivial spacetimes, in particular those with non-trivial second cohomology, this axial gauge symmetry can undergo a Higgs mechanism, rendering the pseudoscalar field an emergent propagating degree of freedom. Finally, we briefly point out an analogous emergent state associated with the conformal anomaly.
summary: 在电动力学中，更一般地在规范理论中，量化引入了模糊性，由此矢量电流、轴向电流或两者可能获得异常发散。这些异常可以分为相关的，通常与理论的红外特性相关，以及不相关的，由于重正化方案选择的自由而产生。我们证明，在费米子场的轴向重新参数化下，全局轴对称性可以提升为规范冗余。要求在量子水平上保留这种规范对称性可以消除不相关的异常，留下一个非传播的赝标量场，充当拉格朗日乘子，强制执行熟悉的轴向异常。我们进一步认为，在拓扑非平凡的时空上，特别是那些具有非平凡的第二上同调的时空，这种轴规范对称性可以经历希格斯机制，使赝标量场成为一种新兴的传播自由度。最后，我们简要指出与共形异常相关的类似紧急状态。

title: Graph-Based Algorithms for Worldline EFT Integrands
abstract: We present novel graph-centered algorithms for the construction and representation of worldline effective field theory (WEFT) integrands that separate the topological and algebraic structure of loop integrands into independent graph-numerator pairs. In this representation, the graph encodes all propagators, worldline source and sink vertices, momentum routing, i0 prescriptions, and proper-time dependence, while the numerator carries only the minimal algebraic, tensorial content. To construct integrands at fixed post-Minkowskian order we propose a generalized Berends-Giele construction that minimizes the number of expensive tensor contraction operations. We also discuss simplification and canonicalization strategies through "serialization" of worldline propagators and the application of "selfie"-subdiagram partial-fraction identities, yielding a minimal canonical topology basis. We further show that the graph-numerator representation naturally generalizes the notion of an integral family and its sectors, relevant for integration-by-parts (IBP) reduction: propagators are not constrained to a single master labeling, and each sector carries its own minimal set of independent scalar products, completing into an overcomplete global family. This setup minimizes the total number of required integral sectors through an optimal use of sector symmetries and enables independent optimization of propagator labeling for IBP reductions. The algorithms are implemented in the Rust crate FeynRIR, which is currently able to efficiently compute integrands for the variation of the effective WEFT action, the equations of motion for the worldlines and the (radiation-reacted) impulse.
summary:
我们提出了新颖的以图为中心的算法，用于构造和表示世界线有效场论（WEFT）被积函数，将循环被积函数的拓扑和代数结构分离成独立的图分子对。在这种表示中，图对所有传播器、世界线源和汇点顶点、动量路由、i0 处方和原时依赖性进行编码，而分子仅携带最小的代数、张量内容。为了以固定的后闵可夫斯基阶构造被积函数，我们提出了一种广义的 Berends-Giele 构造，可以最大限度地减少昂贵的张量收缩运算的数量。我们还讨论了通过世界线传播器的“序列化”和“自拍照”子图部分分数恒等式的应用来简化和规范化策略，从而产生最小的规范拓扑基础。

我们进一步表明，图分子表示自然地概括了积分族及其扇区的概念，与按部分积分（IBP）简化相关：传播器不受单个主标签的限制，每个扇区都带有自己的最小独立标量积集，从而形成一个超完备的全局族。该设置通过扇区对称性的最佳使用最大限度地减少了所需积分扇区的总数，并能够独立优化传播器标签以减少 IBP。这些算法在 Rust 箱 FeynRIR 中实现，该箱目前能够有效计算有效 WEFT 作用变化的被积函数、世界线的运动方程和（辐射反应）脉冲。

title: Relating Dark Dimension Size with Dark Energy via 5D Quintessence Potential and Casimir Energy
abstract: We explore effective field theory (EFT) realizations of the dark dimension (DD) scenario in which the size of the DD is determined by the competition between a 5D quintessence potential and the Casimir energy. When only contributions from massless fields are considered, the Casimir energy does not have a typical energy scale, and the 4D dark energy (DE) scale is set by the height of the 5D quintessence potential. The simple 5D model we first study has an attractive feature that the size of the DD is related to the 4D vacuum energy (VE), as outlined above. However, it turns out that the 4D VE thus obtained cannot work as the 4D DE in the standard cosmological setting. One of the discrepancies between the VE and the DE manifests in the radion dependence of the effective 4D Newton's gravitational constant. This leads us to explore a 5D model in which the 4D Einstein-Hilbert (EH) action is dominantly induced by quantum effects, leaving the radion dependence of the 4D Newton's constant subdominant. This model leads to an attractive cosmological model, realizing the mechanism explained in the beginning. We also explore a 6D model with the total internal volume fixed, to make the 4D Newton's constant independent of the radion. We first study a scenario in which the sizes of the 5th and the 6th dimensions are of the same order. In this scenario, the physical origin of the size of the DD is left to its UV completion. Next, we turn to a scenario in which there is a large hierarchy between the sizes of the 5th and the 6th dimensions. In this scenario, the energy scale of the 5D quintessence potential turns out to be much higher than the energy scale of the 4D DE as inferred from the cosmological observations, so we need to subtract a constant term in 4D to tune the 4D DE. This prevents us from obtaining the scaling relation for the DE expected in the dSDC.
summary:
我们探索暗维度 (DD) 场景的有效场论 (EFT) 实现，其中 DD 的大小由 5D 本质势和卡西米尔能量之间的竞争决定。当仅考虑无质量场的贡献时，卡西米尔能量没有典型的能量尺度，并且4D暗能量（DE）尺度由5D精髓势的高度设定。我们首先研究的简单 5D 模型有一个吸引人的特点，即 DD 的大小与 4D 真空能 (VE) 相关，如上所述。然而，事实证明，由此获得的4D VE不能用作标准宇宙学环境中的4D DE。 VE 和 DE 之间的差异之一体现在有效 4D 牛顿引力常数的放射依赖性上。这引导我们探索一个 5D 模型，其中 4D 爱因斯坦-希尔伯特 (EH) 作用主要由量子效应引起，而 4D 牛顿常数的辐射依赖性占主导地位。这个模型产生了一个有吸引力的宇宙学模型，实现了开头解释的机制。

我们还探索了总内部体积固定的 6D 模型，以使 4D 牛顿常数与放射性无关。我们首先研究第五维和第六维的大小具有相同数量级的场景。在这种情况下，DD 大小的物理起源留给其 UV 完成。接下来，我们转向第五维和第六维的大小之间存在较大层次结构的场景。在这种情况下，根据宇宙学观测推断，5D本质势的能量尺度远高于4D DE的能量尺度，因此我们需要减去4D中的常数项来调整4D DE。这使得我们无法获得 dSDC 中预期的 DE 的缩放关系。

title: Exact Stress Tensor Flows in Causal Electrodynamics: Auxiliary Field Formalism
abstract: Causal self-dual nonlinear electrodynamics admits a simple auxiliary-field description: the Lagrangian is linear in the two Lorentz invariants of the field strength, and the dynamics is encoded in a potential $W(\varphi)$ of a single auxiliary variable. We study non-perturbative $T\bar T$-like flows of these theories in this formalism. The irrelevant (stress-tensor) deformation acts on the potential by a rescaling, while the marginal ModMax-type deformation translates its vacuum. We derive the resulting flow equations exactly, show that the irrelevant exact $T\bar T$-like flow takes the autonomous form $\partial_\lambda\mathcal L=X\,F(r)$, where the closed form kernel $F$ depends only on the ratio $r=-T^\mu{}_\mu/\sqrt{4X-Y}$ of stress-tensor invariants. We also give an explicit reconstruction of the auxiliary potential from a given kernel. Causality imposes the differential inequality $D(r)>1/(1-r)$, while a globally single-valued kernel requires the ratio $r$ to be monotonic along the auxiliary branch. We examine the relation between the evenness of the exact $T\bar T$-like flow , the $\varphi$-parity of the potential, and the analyticity of the Lagrangian in the electromagnetic invariants, including the effect of a marginal ModMax parameter. We construct the linear auxiliary and Hamiltonian formulations and show that the Hamiltonian flow is governed by the same exact $T\bar T$-like flow with the opposite sign. We also express Born's Legendre self-duality, the two characteristic cones, and the energy conditions in terms of the kernel. In particular, $r=(\varepsilon-p_\perp)/(\varepsilon+p_\perp)$ has a direct physical interpretation. Exact $T\bar T$-like flow s are obtained for generalized Born-Infeld, logarithmic, q-deformed, and no-$\tau$-maximum electrodynamics.
summary:
因果自对偶非线性电动力学允许简单的辅助场描述：拉格朗日在场强的两个洛伦兹不变量中是线性的，并且动力学被编码在单个辅助变量的势$W(\varphi)$中。我们在这种形式主义中研究这些理论的非微扰$T\bar T$类流动。不相关（应力张量）变形通过重新缩放作用于势，而边际 ModMax 型变形则平移其真空。我们精确地推导了所得的流动方程，表明不相关的精确$T\bar T$类流动采用自治形式$\partial_\lambda\mathcal L=X\,F(r)$，其中封闭形式内核$F$仅取决于应力张量不变量的比率$r=-T^\mu{}_\mu/\sqrt{4X-Y}$。我们还给出了给定内核的辅助势的显式重构。因果关系施加微分不等式 $D(r)>1/(1-r)$，而全局单值内核要求比率 $r$ 沿辅助分支单调。

我们研究了精确 $T\bar T$ 类流的均匀性、势的 $\varphi$ 宇称以及电磁不变量中拉格朗日的解析性之间的关系，包括边际 ModMax 参数的影响。我们构造了线性辅助和哈密顿公式，并表明哈密顿流受完全相同的 $T\bar T$ 类流控制，但符号相反。我们还表达了玻恩勒让德自对偶性、两个特征锥体以及核的能量条件。特别是，$r=(\varepsilon-p_\perp)/(\varepsilon+p_\perp)$ 具有直接的物理解释。对于广义 Born-Infeld、对数、q 变形和无 $\tau$ 最大电动力学，可以获得精确的 $T\bar T$ 类流 s。

title: The one-loop QCD scale anomaly on ADE orbifolds as an index
abstract: We derive the one-loop scale anomaly of $\SU(N)$ Yang--Mills on the orbifold $\R^4/\Gamma$, with $\Gamma\subset \SU(2)$ a finite subgroup, from an equivariant index theorem on twistor space. The anomaly separates into the QCD $\beta$-function and a contribution localized at the orbifold fixed point. This localized term inherits the gravitational Weyl anomaly of the smooth ALE resolution, which concentrates under the singular degeneration, along with an additional unprotected heat-kernel coefficient.
summary: 我们根据扭量空间上的等变指数定理推导了轨道折叠 $\R^4/\Gamma$ 上 $\SU(N)$ Yang--Mills 的单环尺度异常，其中 $\Gamma\subset \SU(2)$ 是有限子群。异常分为 QCD $\beta$ 函数和位于轨道固定点的贡献。这个局部项继承了平滑 ALE 分辨率的引力 Weyl 异常，该异常集中在奇异简并下，以及附加的未受保护的热核系数。

title: On memory effects in odd spacetime dimensions
abstract: We establish the existence of a new electromagnetic memory effect in all odd spacetime dimensions. This effect is a universal property of electromagnetic fields sourced by charged particles of constant momenta, appears at the Coulombic order and is directly related to the Weinberg soft theorem. We provide a unified derivation of this effect in all higher dimensions by evaluating the Maxwell constraint on a null plane at large, finite distance. We observe that in odd spacetime dimensions, the lightray integral computing the memory effect does not commute with the large-$r$ expansion. Our results necessarily assume that the lightray integral is taken prior to the $r \rightarrow \infty$ limit. The effect vanishes in the opposite order of limits, in agreement with previous results. We compute the Coulombic order electromagnetic memory effect for both massless and massive sources in all higher dimensions, explain its relation to the Fourier transform of the leading soft photon theorem and present a protocol for its measurement in a finite time parametrically larger than the distance of a detector from the sources. We conclude with comments on the generalization to gravity.
summary: 我们确定在所有奇数时空维度中都存在新的电磁记忆效应。这种效应是由恒定动量的带电粒子产生的电磁场的普遍属性，出现在库仑级，并且与温伯格软定理直接相关。我们通过评估大的、有限距离的零平面上的麦克斯韦约束，在所有更高维度上提供了这种效应的统一推导。我们观察到，在奇数时空维度中，计算记忆效应的光线积分不会与大$r$展开交换。我们的结果必然假设光线积分是在 $r \rightarrow \infty$ 限制之前进行的。该效应以相反的限制顺序消失，与之前的结果一致。我们计算所有更高维度的无质量和大质量源的库仑阶电磁记忆效应，解释其与领先软光子定理的傅立叶变换的关系，并提出一种在参数大于探测器与源距离的有限时间内测量其测量的协议。最后我们对引力的推广进行评论。

title: Theory and Cosmology of Biverse Volume-Normalized Gravity
abstract: This dissertation expounds the biverse volume-normalized gravity, a novel theoretical framework of classical and quantum gravity that provides an unusual solution to the cosmological constant problem, the 60-degree-of-magnitude discrepancy between the value of the vacuum energy density in our universe predicted by particle physics and that implied by cosmological data. In the literature, there exist two interesting ideas: 1) to use the "volume-normalized" action functional, the usual action of the particle Standard Model and general relativity but divided by the spacetime volume, first proposed by Tseytlin; 2) to generate the vacuum energy density dynamically by assigning a ghost-free massive potential to the graviton. However, each has a problem: Tseytlin's attempt suffers from diverging quantum loops and the massive gravity theory has a second metric tensor with questionable origin and the quantum strong coupling problem. Inspired by these two ideas, as well as the AdS/CFT correspondence in string theory, the biverse volume-normalized gravity extends Tseytlin's idea by placing our (3+1)-dimensional universe on the boundary of a (4+1)-dimensional bulk space. This new adaptation controls the large quantum gravity loops in the limit of vanishing ratio of the spacetime volume of our universe to that of the other universe. The ghost-free massive gravity can then be seamlessly incorporated, not only that its otherwise nebulous second metric tensor appears naturally as the pullback of the bulk metric on the boundary, but its strong coupling problem also solved. The biverse volume-normalized gravity is also consistent with all tested models of particle cosmology and the evolution of the universe, and nontrivially predicts that the tensor-to-scalar ratio of our universe is exactly zero.
summary:
本论文阐述了双反体积归一化引力，这是一种新颖的经典和量子引力理论框架，为宇宙学常数问题（粒子物理预测的宇宙真空能量密度值与宇宙学数据暗示的值之间60度的差异）提供了一种不同寻常的解决方案。文献中存在两个有趣的想法：1）使用“体积归一化”作用泛函，即粒子标准模型和广义相对论的通常作用，但除以时空体积，由Tseytlin首先提出； 2）通过为引力子分配无重影的巨大势能动态地生成真空能量密度。然而，每个方法都有一个问题：Tseytlin 的尝试遇到了发散的量子环，而大质量引力理论的第二个度量张量的起源有问题，并且存在量子强耦合问题。受这两个想法以及弦理论中 AdS/CFT 对应关系的启发，双反体积归一化引力通过将我们的 (3+1) 维宇宙放置在 (4+1) 维体空间的边界上扩展了 Tseytlin 的想法。

这种新的适应将大量子引力环控制在我们宇宙的时空体积与其他宇宙的时空体积消失之比的极限内。然后，无幽灵的大质量引力就可以无缝地结合起来，不仅其原本模糊的第二度量张量自然地表现为边界上体积度量的拉回，而且其强耦合问题也得到解决。双宇宙体积归一化引力也与所有经过测试的粒子宇宙学和宇宙演化模型一致，并且不平凡地预测我们宇宙的张量与标量之比恰好为零。

title: The topological vertex is finitely generated
abstract: The topological vertex computes all genus amplitudes for the open topological A-model in $\mathbb{C}^3$ with branes on three toric Lagrangians and, via gluing, both open and closed string amplitudes on any toric Calabi-Yau threefold. In this note we show that the topological vertex is generated by boundary interactions of three disks and three annuli. A generalization of this result is shown to hold for the refined topological vertex.
summary: 拓扑顶点计算 $\mathbb{C}^3$ 中开放拓扑 A 模型的所有亏格振幅，其中三个复曲面拉格朗日上有膜，并通过粘合计算任何复曲面 Calabi-Yau 上三重的开弦和闭弦振幅。在这篇文章中，我们表明拓扑顶点是由三个圆盘和三个环的边界相互作用生成的。该结果的概括被证明适用于精炼的拓扑顶点。

title: Compositional Operational Rank, Smooth Realizability, and Dimensional Reduction
abstract: Higher-dimensional theories distinguish the dimensionality of a microscopic description from the number of directions accessible to a physical observer. Relating these notions requires not only dimensional reduction, but also a consistent preservation of operational independence across different levels of description. We establish sufficient conditions under which a compositional operational rank is preserved first as the dimension of a smooth integral leaf and then as an observable Fisher-information rank. The key requirement is closure-faithfulness: the smooth realization must preserve the dependency relations of the operational closure, rather than merely its total rank. Together with real representability, constant rank, involutivity, and observer/scale compatibility, this yields a local integral leaf whose dimension equals the operational rank. A further primary-identification condition is required at the measurement level. If an independently specified observer image coincides locally with the primary integral distribution and the admissible protocols provide local resolution, finite labeled-mixture closure, and locally constant outcome support, then the same rank can be realized by a finite composite Fisher-information protocol. The construction holds for arbitrary finite rank. At r = 4 it provides a conditional operational criterion for dimensional reduction in higher-dimensional theories: a viable reduction must preserve the relevant operational dependency structure, not merely produce four effective coordinates. Quantum-hardware negative controls further show that the same restricted Fisher rank can conceal different larger ranks under a broader pre-specified measurement protocol. The framework therefore constrains the operational outcome of dimensional reduction without imposing a universal four-dimensional bound on microscopic state spaces.
summary:
高维理论将微观描述的维度与物理观察者可访问的方向数量区分开来。将这些概念联系起来不仅需要降维，还需要在不同描述级别上一致地保留操作独立性。我们建立了充分的条件，在该条件下，组合运算等级首先被保留为平滑积分叶的维度，然后保留为可观察的费舍尔信息等级。关键要求是闭包忠实性：顺利实现必须保留操作闭包的依赖关系，而不仅仅是其总等级。与真实的可表示性、恒定等级、对合性和观察者/尺度兼容性一起，这产生了一个局部积分叶，其维度等于操作等级。在测量层面需要进一步的初级识别条件。

如果独立指定的观察者图像与初级积分分布局部一致，并且可接受的协议提供局部分辨率、有限标记混合闭包和局部恒定结果支持，则可以通过有限复合费希尔信息协议实现相同的等级。该结构适用于任意有限等级。当 r = 4 时，它为高维理论中的维数约简提供了条件操作准则：可行的约简必须保留相关的操作依赖结构，而不仅仅是产生四个有效坐标。量子硬件阴性对照进一步表明，相同的受限费舍尔等级可以在更广泛的预先指定的测量协议下隐藏不同的较大等级。因此，该框架限制了降维的操作结果，而不对微观状态空间施加通用的四维界限。

title: Quantum Field Theory on the Tangent Bundle
abstract: We develop a quantum-field-theoretical framework on the tangent bundle in which gravitational and internal gauge structures are associated with different sectors of an affine tangent-fiber geometry. The translational sector supplies the coframe and its relation to teleparallel gravity. A reduced vertical spectral problem is based on the centrally extended Euclidean group \(E^{c}(2)\), motivated by projective representations of the stabilizer of a nonzero null vector. Twofold multiplicities of equivalent vertical representations in selected left-chiral sectors admit weak \(SU(2)\) actions, while an assumed threefold quark multiplicity admits a locally gauged color \(SU(3)_c\) symmetry. A proposed global quotient correlates the color center with vertical rotations on a threefold rotation cover. Together with the selected chiral spectrum and anomaly conditions, this construction reproduces the observed fractional quark charge assignments. We formulate matter and gauge-field quantization, BRST symmetry, and anomaly constraints. Under the stated projection assumptions, the color sector has the standard local QCD structure, including its one-loop beta function and asymptotic freedom. Additional gauge bosons and dark-matter states are proposed as hypothetical sectors. We also formulate a structural action for possible couplings between teleparallel torsion and additional Lorentz-sector potentials. The framework relates selected structures of particle physics and gravity within a common geometric setting; their further dynamical and phenomenological development remains open.
summary:
我们在切丛上开发了一个量子场理论框架，其中引力和内部规范结构与仿射切线纤维几何形状的不同部分相关联。平移部分提供了坐标系及其与远程平行重力的关系。简化垂直谱问题基于中心扩展欧几里得群 \(E^{c}(2)\)，其动机是非零零向量稳定器的投影表示。选定的左手性扇区中等效垂直表示的双重多重性承认弱\(SU(2)\)作用，而假设的三重夸克多重性承认局部测量的颜色\(SU(3)_c\)对称性。提出的全局商将颜色中心与三重旋转盖上的垂直旋转相关联。与选定的手性光谱和异常条件一起，该结构再现了观察到的分数夸克电荷分配。我们制定了物质和规范场量化、BRST 对称性和异常约束。在所述投影假设下，颜色扇区具有标准的局部 QCD 结构，包括其单环 beta 函数和渐近自由度。

额外的规范玻色子和暗物质态被提议作为假设的部分。我们还为远程平行扭转和附加洛伦兹扇区势之间可能的耦合制定了结构作用。该框架将选定的粒子物理结构和重力在公共几何设置中联系起来；它们的进一步动力和现象学发展仍然是开放的。

title: How to get an attractive model
abstract: We give a fourth-order Calabi-Yau differential operator, which seems to have been missed by earlier tabulations. We draw attention to this operator because of its clear geometric interpretation and evidence that it possesses a rank-two attractor, conjecturally giving a new example of a Calabi-Yau threefold with modularity properties analogous to those of an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$.
summary: 我们给出了四阶 Calabi-Yau 微分算子，这似乎在早期的表格中被遗漏了。我们之所以注意到这个算子，是因为它有清晰的几何解释，并且有证据表明它拥有二阶吸引子，推测给出了一个具有类似于 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上椭圆曲线的模块化属性的 Calabi-Yau 三重的新例子。

title: On the Energy Minimizing Problem in Plasma Dynamics
abstract: A fundamental question in plasma physics and its applications to fusion theory is to find minimum energy stares of plasma.. Hong Qin has suggested the use of what he calls "Gromov ground states" which take into account the phenomenon of symplectic rigidity, as opposed to Gardner's classical approach which only use volume-preserving diffeomorphisms. Howev4er Qin's approach leads to topological difficulties because his constructions remain in the classical (Hamiltonian) domain. We circumvent these difficulties by introducing a quantum-mechanical formulation of the problem, based on the Wigner transform and the symplectic geometry of Gaussian state
summary: 等离子体物理及其在聚变理论中的应用的一个基本问题是找到等离子体的最小能量星。洪钦建议使用他所谓的“格罗莫夫基态”，该基态考虑了辛刚性现象，而不是加德纳的经典方法，仅使用保体积微分同胚。然而，秦的方法导致了拓扑困难，因为他的构造仍然停留在经典（哈密尔顿）领域。我们通过引入基于维格纳变换和高斯态辛几何的量子力学公式来解决这些困难

title: Dynamics of two-dimensional Bose gases in the focusing case
