abstract: We prove the propagation of Bose--Einstein condensation and a norm approximation for the dynamics of a Bose gas with localized initial data in two dimensions with singular interactions that may have a small attractive part. We allow the scaling of the interaction to be any polynomial scaling $N^\beta$ for $0<\beta<\infty$ and even exponential scaling $e^{N^\kappa}$ for $0<\kappa<1/4$. Our approach covers external potentials that are time-dependent, at most quadratic, and bounded below, including the situation without an external potential.
summary: 我们证明了玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的传播和玻色气体动力学的范数近似，其中二维局部初始数据具有奇异相互作用，可能具有较小的吸引力部分。我们允许交互的缩放为任意多项式缩放 $N^\beta$ ($0<\beta<\infty$)，甚至指数缩放 $e^{N^\kappa}$ ($0<\kappa<1/4$)。我们的方法涵盖了与时间相关的、至多二次的且有界的外部势，包括没有外部势的情况。

title: Ground-state spaces of generalized stabilizer codes
abstract: In this paper, we determine the complete ground-state spaces for a broad class of generalized stabilizer quantum models defined over CW-decompositions of non-compact manifolds of arbitrary dimensions and topological type. We introduce a $C^*$-algebraic framework in which the quantum spin algebra $\A$ is realized as the twisted group $C^*$-algebra of an infinite discrete Pauli module $P$ endowed with a symplectic structure. We establish a correspondence between stabilizer models and isotropic subgroups of $P$: Every Lagrangian extension of such a subgroup determines a $C^*$-diagonal of $\A$, whose Weyl groupoid encodes the dynamics through a continuous 1-cocycle. This realization yields an explicit family of extremal ground-states for every admissible Lagrangian model, together with their decomposition into sectors. When the sector space is $T_0$, this gives a complete characterization of the ground-state spaces. We also prove that every Lagrangian stabilizer model admits a unique frustration-free ground state with a spectral gap. Our framework applies in arbitrary dimension, including higher abelian quantum doubles, homological codes, and a broad class of stabilizer models.
summary: 在本文中，我们确定了通过任意维度和拓扑类型的非紧流形的 CW 分解定义的广泛广义稳定器量子模型的完整基态空间。我们引入了一个$C^*$-代数框架，其中量子自旋代数$\A$被实现为具有辛结构的无限离散泡利模块$P$的扭曲群$C^*$-代数。我们在稳定器模型和 $P$ 的各向同性子群之间建立了对应关系：此类子群的每个拉格朗日扩展都确定 $\A$ 的 $C^*$ 对角线，其 Weyl 群形通过连续的 1-cocycle 编码动力学。这种认识为每个可接受的拉格朗日模型产生了一个明确的极值基态族，以及它们分解成的扇区。当扇区空间为$T_0$时，这给出了基态空间的完整特征。我们还证明，每个拉格朗日稳定器模型都承认具有光谱间隙的独特无挫折基态。我们的框架适用于任意维度，包括更高的阿贝尔量子双精度数、同调码和广泛的稳定器模型。

title: Partial Airy ideals and coloured blobbed topological recursion
abstract: We define and study the notion of partial Airy ideals, which are certain linear systems of PDEs that may contain less equations than variables. We show that they admit a unique solution of exponential type (the partition function) modulo a choice of initial condition. We construct a large class of examples of partial Airy ideals attached to spectral curves using twisted free-field representations of $\mathcal{W}(\mathfrak{gl}_r)$-algebras at self-dual level. This generalizes the results of Bouchard- Borot-Chidambaram-Creutzig-Noshchenko by significantly enlarging the set of admissible spectral curves, provided they come with additional data that we call colour. We show that the differential constraints on the partition function are equivalent to a set of equations on the associated correlators, which we call coloured loop equations. We find a recursive residue formulation for the solutions of those equations, the coloured blobbed topological recursion}, which is a generalization of the currently known forms of topological recursion. It includes the blobbed topological recursion of Borot-Shadrin as a special case, giving it a natural interpretation within the formalism of partial Airy ideals.
summary:
我们定义并研究了部分艾里理想的概念，它是某些偏微分方程的线性系统，包含的方程可能少于变量。我们证明它们承认指数类型（配分函数）对初始条件的选择取模的唯一解。我们使用自对偶水平上 $\mathcal{W}(\mathfrak{gl}_r)$ 代数的扭曲自由场表示构建了一类附加到谱曲线的部分艾里理想的例子。这通过显着扩大可接受的光谱曲线集来概括 Bouchard-Borot-Chidambaram-Creutzig-Noshchenko 的结果，前提是它们带有我们称为颜色的附加数据。我们证明配分函数上的微分约束等效于相关相关器上的一组方程，我们将其称为彩色循环方程。我们找到了这些方程的解的递归留数公式，即彩色斑点拓扑递归}，它是当前已知的拓扑递归形式的概括。

它包括 Borot-Shadrin 的斑点拓扑递归作为特例，使其在部分艾里理想的形式主义中得到自然的解释。

title: A non-equilibrium thermodynamics formulation of shear set-points in adaptively remodeling vascular networks
abstract: Blood vessels remodel in response to wall shear stress while the network operates under a metabolic maintenance budget. For a power-law maintenance cost, minimizing dissipation at fixed budget yields a local shear set-point, and a purely local adaptation rule drives the network towards this optimum. Here we give this result a non-equilibrium thermodynamic formulation. Blood flow is an exactly linear Onsager system, and the slow remodeling of vessel radii is a gradient flow generated by a Rayleigh dissipation functional. This identifies the structural mobility, which scales inversely with the maintenance cost of each vessel and can be measured from radius fluctuations. Enforcing the budget exactly requires a time-dependent metabolic multiplier, which we obtain in closed form; with a fixed multiplier the budget is violated by up to one third during transients. The fluid displaced by remodeling vessels couples flow and structure through a symmetric, non-diagonal mobility, so that Onsager reciprocity becomes a testable statement: neighbouring vessels should show anticorrelated radius fluctuations. With noise, the structural sector obeys a second law and an integral fluctuation theorem. Non-reciprocal signaling between vessels, such as upstream conducted responses, then breaks the time-reversal symmetry of radius fluctuations and produces housekeeping entropy, detectable from time series of realistic length. Finally, we construct a partition function over network topologies with the number of loops as order parameter. Numerical tests show that loop counts do not collapse onto a single curve against an effective temperature, and that they depend strongly on the detection threshold.
summary:
血管响应壁剪切应力而重塑，而网络在代谢维持预算下运行。对于幂律维护成本，在固定预算下最小化耗散会产生局部剪切设定点，并且纯粹的局部适应规则驱动网络达到最佳状态。在这里，我们给这个结果一个非平衡热力学公式。血流是一个精确线性的 Onsager 系统，血管半径的缓慢重塑是瑞利耗散函数生成的梯度流。这确定了结构的移动性，其与每艘船的维护成本成反比，并且可以通过半径波动来测量。严格执行预算需要一个与时间相关的代谢乘数，我们以封闭形式获得该乘数；使用固定乘数时，在瞬态期间预算最多会被违反三分之一。重塑血管所排出的流体通过对称的非对角流动性耦合流动和结构，因此 Onsager 互易性成为可测试的陈述：相邻血管应表现出反相关的半径波动。对于噪声，结构扇形遵循第二定律和积分涨落定理。

船只之间的非互易信号（例如上游传导响应）会打破半径波动的时间反转对称性，并产生可从实际长度的时间序列中检测到的内务熵。最后，我们在网络拓扑上构造一个分区函数，以循环数作为顺序参数。数值测试表明，循环计数不会崩溃到有效温度的单一曲线上，并且它们强烈依赖于检测阈值。

title: A Twisted Affine Interpolation of the $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded Integrable Super-Liouville and super-Sinh-Gordon Equations
abstract: This paper is a third one in a series devoted to the construction of $2D$, $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded, integrable Toda field theories. The first paper introduced parabosonic models obtained from Rittenberg-Wyler color Lie algebras; the second paper explained how to deal with parafermions (the $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded super-Liouville theory) from finite Rittenberg-Wyler color Lie superalgebras. This new paper extends the construction to the infinite case of (twisted) affine color Lie superalgebras. A $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded extension of ${\widehat{\mathfrak{osp}(2|2)^{(2)}}}$ allows to interpolate the super-Liouville and the super-Sinh-Gordon models, recovered as special limits. The $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded extensions of three frameworks are here discussed: the Polyakov's soldering, the Leznov-Savel'ev Lax pair (zero-curvature) formulation and the Bäcklund transformations. As a byproduct of the construction, the Hamiltonian reduction from the $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded ${\widehat{\mathfrak{osp(2|2)}^{(2)}}}$ WZNW models induces a $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded color Lie superalgebra which admits three inequivalent superVirasoro subalgebras; they are the ${\cal N}=2$ superVirasoro, the $(1,\frac{3}{2},\frac{3}{2},2)$ $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded superVirasoro and the $(\frac{3}{2},\frac{3}{2},2,2)$ $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$-graded superVirasoro.
summary:
本文是致力于构造 $2D$、$\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级、可积的 Toda 场论系列文章中的第三篇。第一篇论文介绍了从Rittenberg-Wyler颜色李代数获得的抛物线模型；第二篇论文解释了如何从有限 Rittenberg-Wyler 颜色李超代数中处理拟费米子（$\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级的超刘维尔理论）。这篇新论文将构造扩展到（扭曲）仿射颜色李超代数的无限情况。 ${\widehat{\mathfrak{osp}(2|2)^{(2)}}}$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级扩展允许插值超刘维尔模型和超辛赫戈登模型，恢复为特殊极限。这里讨论了三个框架的 $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级扩展：Polyakov 焊接、Leznov-Savel'ev Lax 对（零曲率）公式和 Bäcklund 变换。

作为构造的副产品，$\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级的 ${\widehat{\mathfrak{osp(2|2)}^{(2)}}}$ WZNW 模型的哈密顿量约简得出 $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级的颜色李超代数，它承认三个不等价的 superVirasoro 子代数；它们是 ${\cal N}=2$ superVirasoro、$(1,\frac{3}{2},\frac{3}{2},2)$ $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级的 superVirasoro 和 $(\frac{3}{2},\frac{3}{2},2,2)$ $\mathbb{Z}_2^2$ 分级的 superVirasoro。

title: Admissible Subspaces for the Collective Haar Twirl: Schur-Weyl Classification and Heredity under Tensor-Factor Reduction
abstract: Quantum private broadcasting (\textsf{QPB}) asks whether a quantum message can be encrypted once, broadcast to several recipients, and decrypted locally while the joint ciphertext reveals no plaintext information. Broadbent, González-Guillén, and Schuknecht showed that the full tensor-power space \(\mathcal H_d^{\otimes t}\) is generally unsuitable for \textsf{QPB}, identified \(\mathrm{Sym}^t(\mathcal H_d)\) as a natural plaintext space, introduced symmetric unitary \(t\)-designs, and asked which other subspaces support private broadcast. Using Schur-Weyl duality, we classify all subspaces \(\mathcal S\subseteq\mathcal H_d^{\otimes t}\) on which the collective Haar twirl \(\mathcal T^{(t)}\) is a replacement channel. Precisely, every Schur-Weyl block weight must be independent of the encoded state, and in each active block \(V_\lambda\otimes W_\lambda\), the reduced state on the multiplicity space \(W_\lambda\) must be fixed. This yields explicit two-block and general multiblock constructions and realizes the classification as the Schur-Weyl form of the Knill-Laflamme conditions for a complementary channel of \(\mathcal T^{(t)}\). We also introduce a canonical reduction under deletion of a recipient and characterize privacy heredity, design heredity, and \textsf{QPB}-heredity for exact restricted designs. The symmetric tower is fully \textsf{QPB}-hereditary, whereas the antisymmetric tower is fully privacy-hereditary and is design-hereditary from level \(s\) to \(s-1\) exactly when \(s\leq(d+1)/2\). For canonical carriers in arbitrary Schur-Weyl blocks, hereditary reduction is governed by multiplicity-free branching along the Young graph and inclusion of the associated Peter-Weyl coefficient spaces.
summary:
量子私有广播（\textsf{QPB}）询问量子消息是否可以加密一次、广播给多个接收者并在本地解密，同时联合密文不会透露明文信息。 Broadbent、González-Guillén 和 Schuknecht 证明，完整的张量幂空间 \(\mathcal H_d^{\otimes t}\) 通常不适合 \textsf{QPB}，将 \(\mathrm{Sym}^t(\mathcal H_d)\) 识别为自然明文空间，引入对称酉 \(t\) 设计，并询问还有哪些其他子空间支持私播。使用 Schur-Weyl 对偶性，我们对所有子空间 \(\mathcal S\subseteq\mathcal H_d^{\otimes t}\) 进行分类，其中集体 Haar 旋转 \(\mathcal T^{(t)}\) 是替换通道。准确地说，每个 Schur-Weyl 块权重必须独立于编码状态，并且在每个活动块 \(V_\lambda\otimes W_\lambda\) 中，重数空间 \(W_\lambda\) 上的简化状态必须是固定的。这产生了显式的两块和一般多块结构，并实现了作为 \(\mathcal T^{(t)}\) 互补通道的 Knill-Laflamme 条件的 Schur-Weyl 形式的分类。

我们还引入了删除接收者时的规范约简，并描述了隐私遗传、设计遗传和精确受限设计的 \textsf{QPB} 遗传。对称塔是完全 \textsf{QPB} 遗传的，而反对称塔是完全隐私遗传的，并且恰好在 \(s\leq(d+1)/2\) 时从级别 \(s\) 到 \(s-1\) 是设计遗传的。对于任意 Schur-Weyl 块中的规范载流子，遗传约简由沿杨图的无多重分支和相关 Peter-Weyl 系数空间的包含控制。

title: Fractional reversible chemical kinetics: Time-Driven Monte Carlo method and application to enzyme conformational dynamics
abstract: In this work, we present a fractional framework for reversible two-state chemical kinetics derived from the Continuous-Time Random Walk (CTRW) formalism with Mittag-Leffler waiting-time distributions. This derivation provides a microscopic basis for the fractional kinetic equations governed by the Caputo derivative. An exact analytical solution is obtained, yielding closed-form expressions for the time evolution of the state populations. To the best of our knowledge, a time-driven Monte Carlo algorithm is developed for the first time to simulate the irreversible underlying non-Markovian stochastic dynamics governed by a system of Caputo fractional differential equations. The proposed framework is applied to the conformational dynamics of the TbQSOX enzyme, whose relaxation exhibits power-law behavior. The fractional model accurately reproduces the experimental kinetics, providing an estimate of the fractional order $\alpha = 0.22$, which is consistent with the observed anomalous dynamics.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个可逆两态化学动力学的分数框架，该框架源自具有 Mittag-Leffler 等待时间分布的连续时间随机游走 (CTRW) 形式。这一推导为卡普托导数控制的分数阶动力学方程提供了微观基础。获得精确的解析解，产生状态种群时间演化的闭合形式表达式。据我们所知，首次开发了时间驱动的蒙特卡罗算法来模拟由卡普托分数阶微分方程组控制的不可逆的基础非马尔可夫随机动力学。所提出的框架应用于 TbQSOX 酶的构象动力学，其弛豫表现出幂律行为。分数模型准确地再现了实验动力学，提供了分数阶 $\alpha = 0.22$ 的估计，这与观察到的异常动力学一致。

title: Linear statistics in the Coulomb gas: cumulants beyond rotational invariance
abstract: We consider a classical Coulomb gas of $N$ particles in dimension $d\geq2$, confined by a general external potential $U$ in the large-$N$ limit. In that limit the density of particles has a compact support called the droplet. We study smooth linear statistics ${\mathcal L}_N=\sum_{i=1}^N f({\bf x}_i)$ at large $N$. While the leading variance of ${\mathcal L}_N$ is by now well understood in many settings, much less is known about higher cumulants. When $f({\bf x})=f(|{\bf x}|)$ and the potential is rotationally invariant, these cumulants were computed recently at leading order. We derive explicit formulas for the leading third and fourth cumulants for general smooth droplets, without assuming that either the potential or the test function is radial. The answers are expressed as intrinsic boundary integrals over the equilibrium droplet. The third cumulant depends on the cube of the jump of the normal derivative of the harmonic extension of $f$, while the fourth cumulant also involves the exterior Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator, the mean curvature of the boundary, and normal derivatives of the background density. Our derivation uses the tilted potential $U_s=U+s f/\beta$, the associated deformation of the droplet, and shape derivatives of the Dirichlet energy. This deformation has a natural interpretation as the infinitesimal motion of the free boundary in the obstacle-problem formulation of the equilibrium measure. Our formulas extend previous studies by Wiegmann and Zabrodin in two dimensions for $\beta=2$. In their setting, we provide a rigorous proof of the limiting third and fourth cumulants, supporting the proposed formulas for general Coulomb gases. We specialize the general formulas to the disk, the half-plane and the sphere, and check them against exactly solvable non-radial deformations, including translated elliptic droplets in $d=2$ and spheroidal deformations in $d=3$.
summary:
我们考虑维度 $d\geq2$ 中由 $N$ 粒子组成的经典库仑气体，受到大 $N$ 极限中的一般外部势 $U$ 的限制。在该限制下，粒子的密度有一个称为液滴的紧凑支撑。我们研究大$N$处的平滑线性统计${\mathcal L}_N=\sum_{i=1}^N f({\bf x}_i)$。虽然目前在许多设置中 ${\mathcal L}_N$ 的主要方差已被很好地理解，但对更高累积量的了解却少之又少。当 $f({\bf x})=f(|{\bf x}|)$ 并且势旋转不变时，这些累积量最近是按前导顺序计算的。我们推导出一般光滑液滴的前第三和第四累积量的显式公式，而不假设势函数或测试函数是径向的。答案表示为平衡液滴上的固有边界积分。第三个累积量取决于 $f$ 的调和扩展的法向导数的跳跃立方，而第四个累积量还涉及外狄利克雷到诺依曼算子、边界的平均曲率和背景密度的法向导数。

我们的推导使用倾斜势 $U_s=U+s f/\beta$、相关的液滴变形以及狄利克雷能量的形状导数。这种变形有一个自然的解释：平衡测量的障碍问题公式中自由边界的无穷小运动。我们的公式扩展了 Wiegmann 和 Zabrodin 之前在二维 $\beta=2$ 上的研究。在他们的设置中，我们提供了限制第三和第四累积量的严格证明，支持一般库仑气体的拟议公式。我们将通用公式专门化为圆盘、半平面和球体，并根据精确可解的非径向变形检查它们，包括 $d=2$ 中的平移椭圆形液滴和 $d=3$ 中的球体变形。

title: V-Representability Beyond Singular Times in Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory: The Hubbard Dimer Case
abstract: We study the global $V$-representability problem in time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) for the two-particle Hubbard dimer model in the spin-singlet sector. In particular, we investigate whether the time-dependent density of the interacting system obtained for a given one-body external potential $u$ (the tunable control variable) can be reproduced by a non-interacting Kohn--Sham system beyond the singular times at which the usual inversion formulas break down. We deal with both the conventional formulation of TDDFT based on some time-dependent variational principle and the recently introduced geometric formulation of TDDFT (Phys. Rev. Lett. 136 (2026) 256401, Phys. Rev. A 113 (2026) 062222). For both principles, we prove global-in-time $V$-representability, show that singular times induce non-uniqueness of the time-dependent effective potential, and classify the set of solutions.
summary: 我们研究了自旋单线段中双粒子哈伯德二聚体模型的时间相关密度泛函理论 (TDDFT) 中的全局 $V$ 表示问题。特别是，我们研究了对于给定的单体外部势 $u$（可调控制变量）获得的相互作用系统的时间依赖性密度是否可以通过非相互作用 Kohn-Sham 系统再现，超出通常反演公式失效的奇异时间。我们处理基于某些时间相关变分原理的 TDDFT 传统公式和最近引入的 TDDFT 几何公式（Phys. Rev. Lett. 136 (2026) 256401，Phys. Rev. A 113 (2026) 062222）。对于这两个原理，我们证明了全局时间$V$-可表示性，表明奇异时间会导致时间相关有效势的非唯一性，并对解决方案集进行分类。

title: Matrix representations of ${\rm BC}_n$ associative Yang--Baxter equations and related long-range spin chains
abstract: We construct a matrix representation of the algebra defined by the associative Yang--Baxter equations of ${\rm BC}_n$ type. In the elliptic case, two sets of generators are represented in terms of the Baxter--Belavin quantum $R$-matrix in the fundamental representation of ${\rm GL}_N$, while the remaining generators are represented by the elliptic $K$-matrix found by Komori and Hikami. We revisit its derivation using the Felder--Pasquier procedure and correct the unitarity relation for odd $N$. We then use these matrix representations to construct examples of long-range quantum spin chains from $R$-matrix-valued Lax pairs for the classical Calogero--Inozemtsev system associated with the ${\rm BC}_n$ root system. We also construct $R$-matrix-valued Lax pairs for Calogero--Moser models in an external field, leading to Haldane--Shastry and Polychronakos--Frahm chains with modified spin positions.
summary: 我们构建由 ${\rm BC}_n$ 类型的关联 Yang--Baxter 方程定义的代数的矩阵表示。在椭圆情况下，两组生成元以 ${\rm GL}_N$ 基本表示中的 Baxter--Belavin 量子 $R$-矩阵表示，而其余生成元则由 Komori 和 Hikami 发现的椭圆 $K$-矩阵表示。我们使用 Felder--Pasquier 过程重新审视它的推导，并纠正奇数 $N$ 的幺正关系。然后，我们使用这些矩阵表示，从与 ${\rm BC}_n$ 根系统相关的经典 Calogero--Inozemtsev 系统的 $R$ 矩阵值 Lax 对构建长程量子自旋链的示例。我们还在外部场中为 Calogero-Moser 模型构建了 $R$ 矩阵值 Lax 对，从而产生了具有修改的自旋位置的 Haldane-Shastry 和 Polychronakos-Frahm 链。

title: The Genus-One B-Model Calabi-Yau/Landau-Ginzburg Correspondence
abstract: Let $f:\mathbb C^n\to\mathbb C$ be a homogeneous polynomial of degree $n$ with an isolated critical point at the origin. The Calabi--Yau/Landau--Ginzburg correspondence predicts a close relation between invariants of the Landau--Ginzburg orbifold $(\mathbb C^n/\mathbb Z_n,f)$ and those of the associated Calabi--Yau hypersurface $ X_f=\{[z_1:\cdots:z_n]\in\mathbb P^{n-1}:f(z_1,\ldots,z_n)=0\}. $ In this paper, we establish this correspondence for the genus-one B-model by constructing the Landau--Ginzburg genus-one B-model invariant intrinsically from the $f$-twisted Laplacian on $\mathbb{C}^n/\mathbb{Z}_n$ and proving that it agrees with the corresponding BCOV invariant of $X_f$ up to an additive constant depending only on the dimension.
summary: 令 $f:\mathbb C^n\to\mathbb C$ 为 $n$ 次齐次多项式，在原点处有一个孤立的临界点。 Calabi--Yau/Landau--Ginzburg 对应关系预测了 Landau--Ginzburg 轨道折叠 $(\mathbb C^n/\mathbb Z_n,f)$ 的不变量与相关的 Calabi--Yau 超曲面 $ X_f=\{[z_1:\cdots:z_n]\in\mathbb 的不变量之间的密切关系P^{n-1}:f(z_1,\ldots,z_n)=0\}。 $ 在本文中，我们通过在 $\mathbb{C}^n/\mathbb{Z}_n$ 上构造本质上来自 $f$-扭曲拉普拉斯算子的 Landau--Ginzburg 属一 B 模型不变量，建立属一 B 模型的这种对应关系，并证明它与 $X_f$ 的相应 BCOV 不变量一致，直至仅取决于维度的加性常数。

title: Stochastic quantization and Osterwalder-Schrader axioms for quantum field theory models
abstract: This PhD thesis constructs the $P(\Phi)_2$ Euclidean quantum field theory on $\mathscr{S}'(\mathbb{R}^2)$. We first construct the finite-volume measure of the $P(\Phi)_2$ model on $\mathscr{D}'(\mathbb{S}_R)$, where $\mathbb{S}_R$ is a two-dimensional sphere of radius $R\in\mathbb{N}_+$. To this end, we rely on Nelson's hypercontractivity estimate. We then use parabolic stochastic quantization and the energy method to construct the infinite-volume measure on $\mathscr{S}'(\mathbb{R}^2)$. This requires establishing the global-in-time existence of solutions to the corresponding stochastic partial differential equations with fixed cutoffs. The remainder of the thesis is devoted to verifying the Osterwalder-Schrader axioms: regularity, reflection positivity, and invariance under translations, rotations, and reflections. This combination of axioms, which is crucial for obtaining a non-trivial local relativistic quantum field theory on Minkowski spacetime, had not been established in earlier constructions based on stochastic quantization.
summary: 本博士论文在$\mathscr{S}'(\mathbb{R}^2)$上构建了$P(\Phi)_2$欧几里得量子场论。我们首先在 $\mathscr{D}'(\mathbb{S}_R)$ 上构建 $P(\Phi)_2$ 模型的有限体积测度，其中 $\mathbb{S}_R$ 是半径为 $R\in\mathbb{N}_+$ 的二维球体。为此，我们依赖尼尔森的超收缩性估计。然后，我们使用抛物线随机量化和能量法来构造$\mathscr{S}'(\mathbb{R}^2)$上的无限体积测度。这需要建立具有固定截止值的相应随机偏微分方程解的全局时间存在性。论文的其余部分致力于验证奥斯特瓦尔德-施拉德公理：正则性、反射正性以及平移、旋转和反射下的不变性。这种公理的组合对于获得闵可夫斯基时空的非平凡局域相对论量子场论至关重要，但在基于随机量子化的早期构造中尚未建立。

title: The sharp leading asymptotics of the self-energy of the spinless Pauli-Fierz model
abstract: We consider the ground state energy E_0(alpha, Lambda) of a single spinless non-relativistic electron coupled to the quantized radiation field with a sharp ultraviolet cutoff Lambda (the Pauli-Fierz model), with fine structure constant alpha = e^2/(4 pi). Lieb and Loss proved that C_1 alpha^(1/2) Lambda^(3/2) <= E_0 <= C_2 alpha^(2/7) Lambda^(12/7) for large Lambda and suggested that the upper bound, which comes from product states, gives the correct order. We prove that, for every fixed alpha > 0, E_0(alpha, Lambda) = (1+o(1)) c_alpha alpha^(2/7) Lambda^(12/7) as Lambda -> infinity, with an explicit constant c_alpha = 0.99338...; more generally, this holds uniformly in the joint limit Lambda/alpha -> infinity, alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> infinity, provided log(2+alpha) = o((Lambda/alpha)^(1/21)). Since our upper bound holds already for the infimum over product states, it follows that the ratio of E_0 to this infimum tends to one: electron-field correlations do not contribute to the leading term. The condition alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> infinity cannot be dropped, since for alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> 0 the vacuum trial state gives a smaller energy. The upper bound follows from a coherent state bound for the field energy in a fixed electron density. The lower bound combines a periodization of the field, a Born-Oppenheimer bound in which phase multiplication and a Hardy inequality in field space are applied block by block, and a lower bound on the magnetic Neumann Laplacian on a cube for band-limited fields; the key point of the last is that a band-limited field obeying a weighted gradient condition cannot concentrate its vorticity.
summary:
我们考虑单个无自旋非相对论电子的基态能量 E_0(alpha, Lambda)，该电子与具有锐紫外截止 Lambda（泡利-菲尔兹模型）的量子化辐射场耦合，精细结构常数 alpha = e^2/(4 pi)。 Lieb 和 Loss 证明了对于大 Lambda，C_1 alpha^(1/2) Lambda^(3/2) <= E_0 <= C_2 alpha^(2/7) Lambda^(12/7)，并表明来自乘积状态的上限给出了正确的顺序。我们证明，对于每个固定的 alpha > 0，E_0(alpha, Lambda) = (1+o(1)) c_alpha alpha^(2/7) Lambda^(12/7) 为 Lambda -> 无穷大，具有显式常量 c_alpha = 0.99338...；更一般地，这在联合极限 Lambda/alpha -> 无穷大、alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> 无穷大中一致成立，前提是 log(2+alpha) = o((Lambda/alpha)^(1/21))。由于我们的上限已经适用于乘积态的下确界，因此 E_0 与该下确界的比率趋向于 1：电子场相关性对首项没有贡献。不能放弃条件 alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> 无穷大，因为对于 alpha^(5/2) Lambda -> 0，真空试验状态给出的能量较小。

上限来自固定电子密度下场能的相干态界限。下界结合了场的周期化、玻恩-奥本海默界（其中逐块应用场空间中的相乘和哈代不等式）以及带限场立方体上的磁诺依曼拉普拉斯算子的下界；最后一个的关键点是服从加权梯度条件的带限场不能集中其涡度。

title: The effective mass of the Pauli-Fierz electron: a cutoff-independent lower bound and the breakdown of mass renormalization
abstract: We consider the Pauli-Fierz model of one spinless non-relativistic electron coupled to the quantized transverse electromagnetic field, without external potential, with a sharp ultraviolet cutoff Lambda and bare mass m. Let h = m_eff/m be the ratio of the effective mass, defined by the curvature of the fiber ground state energy at total momentum zero, to the bare mass; by scaling, h depends only on the fine structure constant alpha = e^2/(4 pi) and on lambda = Lambda/m. We prove two lower bounds. First, h >= 1 + 0.3441 alpha/(1 + 0.2985 sqrt(alpha) + 0.1252 alpha) for all alpha > 0 and all lambda >= 1; the bound does not depend on the cutoff, and with the band extended to the cutoff its first order coefficient in alpha is the perturbative one of Hiroshima and Spohn. The proof uses a coherent translation of the field applied to the ground state as a trial state; the term linear in the translation vanishes by minimality of the ground state. Second, for every fixed alpha, h grows faster than linearly: for every epsilon > 0, h >= lambda^(8/7 - epsilon) for all large lambda (8/7 is the limit of the method). Consequently iota_PF(alpha) := inf_{lambda > 0} h/lambda > 0, and for a fixed physical mass m_phys a bare mass reproducing it exists only if Lambda <= m_phys/iota_PF(alpha). This was expected, but not proved, by Lieb and Loss (2002). The proof of the second bound starts from the sharp self-energy asymptotics of a companion paper and uses a trial state obtained from the ground state by a phase depending on the field configuration. The new ingredients are an estimator for the position of the electron given by the local centre of a shallow level set of the photon cloud, the decoupling of a localized part of the field from the electron through a divergence-free external subspace, and a proof that shallow depressions near the edge of the localization window are rare.
summary:
我们考虑一个无自旋非相对论电子耦合到量化横向电磁场的泡利-菲尔兹模型，没有外部电势，具有尖锐的紫外线截止 Lambda 和裸质量 m。令 h = m_eff/m 为有效质量与裸质量的比率，有效质量由总动量为零时光纤基态能量的曲率定义；通过缩放，h 仅取决于精细结构常数 alpha = e^2/(4 pi) 和 lambda = Lambda/m。我们证明了两个下界。首先，对于所有 alpha > 0 且所有 lambda >= 1，h >= 1 + 0.3441 alpha/(1 + 0.2985 sqrt(alpha) + 0.1252 alpha)；界限不依赖于截止值，并且当频带延伸到截止值时，其 alpha 中的一阶系数是 Hiroshima 和 Spohn 的微扰系数。该证明使用应用于基态作为试验态的场的相干平移；平移中的线性项因基态的极小而消失。其次，对于每个固定的 alpha，h 的增长速度快于线性：对于每个 epsilon > 0，对于所有大 lambda，h >= lambda^(8/7 - epsilon)（8/7 是该方法的极限）。

因此 iota_PF(alpha) := inf_{lambda > 0} h/lambda > 0，并且对于固定物理质量 m_phys，仅当 Lambda <= m_phys/iota_PF(alpha) 时才存在复制它的裸质量。这是 Lieb 和 Loss (2002) 所预料到的，但没有得到证实。第二个界限的证明从配套论文的尖锐自能渐近开始，并使用由取决于场配置的相位从基态获得的试验状态。新的成分是由光子云的浅能级集的局部中心给出的电子位置的估计器，通过无散度外部子空间将场的局部部分与电子解耦，以及证明局部化窗口边缘附近的浅凹陷是罕见的。

title: Spectral localizer for unbounded topological Hamiltonians
abstract: In a series of joint papers with Loring, it was shown how index parings of $K$-theory classes with Fredholm modules can be computed as the half-signature of a suitably constructed finite-dimensional matrix, called the spectral localizer. After offering a novel perspective on earlier results, it is shown how the framework can be extended to unbounded gapped Hamiltonians given as second-order linear differential operators (in particular, matrix-valued Schrödinger and regularized Dirac operators). Important insights are the coercive phase space localization and discretizations by means of wavelets.
summary: 在与 Loring 的一系列联合论文中，展示了如何将 $K$ 理论类与 Fredholm 模块的索引配对计算为适当构造的有限维矩阵（称为谱定位器）的半签名。在提供了对早期结果的新颖视角之后，展示了如何将该框架扩展到以二阶线性微分算子（特别是矩阵值薛定谔算子和正则化狄拉克算子）给出的无界有隙哈密顿量。重要的见解是通过小波进行强制相空间定位和离散化。

title: Random-walk scaling without Bernoulli statistics: transport, persistence and resonances in the triangle map
abstract: The triangle map is an area-preserving, piecewise-parabolic map of the torus with vanishing Lyapunov exponent. We study the symbolic process $X_n=\pm1$ given by the two halves of the torus, whose partial sums $S_n$ are the transport of the lifted momentum, with an integrator free of accumulated rounding errors and exact computations on polygonal cylinder sets. We prove that the Koopman operator has no non-constant $H^1$ eigenfunctions, that the symbol is not an $H^1$ coboundary, and that runs of equal symbols are uniformly bounded. For generic parameters the walk is normally diffusive and Gaussian, but its diffusion coefficient is not that of a coin: away from the edges of the parameter square it varies between $0.2$ and $14$ times the Bernoulli value, and for a benchmark pair, with $D=3.09\pm0.01$, the excess is produced by the order of the bounded inter-event intervals, not by their distribution. The first-passage exponent is $1/2$ with a non-Bernoulli amplitude, and worst-case Birkhoff averages decay as for a uniquely ergodic system. For $\beta=0$ the Green-Kubo sum cancels, $D=0$, yet $\mathrm{Var}(S_n)$ keeps growing slowly, sign changes are rare and the correlations of Fourier modes decay as $n^{-0.2}$. We identify the zero-sum words, which become pure twists at $\beta=0$, as resonances that trap orbits with a computable $1/\ell$ law, set the crossover time $\beta^{-1/2}$ at small $\beta$, and, in an asymmetric deformation of the symbol, produce a logarithmic term in the variance whose coefficient we compute exactly. We formulate conjectures on unique ergodicity, mixing, the central limit theorem and the cohomology of the symbol.
summary:
三角形映射是具有消失李亚普诺夫指数的环面的面积保持的分段抛物线映射。我们研究由环面的两半给出的符号过程 $X_n=\pm1$ ，其部分和 $S_n$ 是提升动量的传输，积分器没有累积的舍入误差和多边形圆柱体集的精确计算。我们证明 Koopman 算子没有非常量 $H^1$ 特征函数，符号不是 $H^1$ 共界，并且相等符号的游程是一致有界的。对于通用参数，游走通常是扩散的和高斯的，但它的扩散系数不是硬币的扩散系数：远离参数平方的边缘，它在伯努利值的 $0.2$ 和 $14$ 倍之间变化，对于基准对，$D=3.09\pm0.01$，超出部分是由有界事件间间隔的顺序产生的，而不是由它们的分布产生的。第一段指数为 $1/2$，具有非伯努利振幅，最坏情况伯克霍夫平均值衰减为独特的遍历系统。

对于 $\beta=0$，Green-Kubo 和抵消，$D=0$，但 $\mathrm{Var}(S_n)$ 保持缓慢增长，符号变化很少，傅里叶模的相关性衰减为 $n^{-0.2}$。我们将在 $\beta=0$ 处变成纯扭曲的零和词识别为用可计算的 $1/\ell$ 定律捕获轨道的共振，将交叉时间 $\beta^{-1/2}$ 设置为较小的 $\beta$，并且在符号的不对称变形中，在方差中产生一个对数项，我们精确计算其系数。我们提出了关于独特遍历性、混合、中心极限定理和符号上同调的猜想。

title: Semantic burstiness across principal directions of textual variation
abstract: Long-range correlations in written texts extend over scales far beyond local syntax, but their relation to semantic organisation remains incompletely understood. Previous work has linked these correlations to the bursty recurrence of topically relevant words. Here we generalise that construction from individual lexical items to distributed semantic observables. We map a text token by token onto a trajectory of pre-trained word embeddings, use principal component analysis (PCA) to identify text-specific directions of semantic variation, and threshold the projected series to define inter-event times; their coefficients of variation form a component-resolved burstiness spectrum $\{B_k\}$. Across 28 literary and scientific texts and the first 20 components, the originals remain systematically above the geometric inter-event-time baseline and above two complementary controls: a word-shuffled null, which preserves the embedding covariance, the PCA eigensystem and the marginal projected distributions while destroying temporal order, and a fractional-Gaussian-noise surrogate, which preserves the Zipfian frequency structure and matches the detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) exponent of the original rank sequence. With events defined by the upper 5% tail of each projection, the original exceeds both controls in every text-component pair, while the two controls are statistically indistinguishable from each other. Autocorrelation and detrended fluctuation analysis of the semantic projections separate the originals from both controls in the same way. Global rank-level long-range correlations are therefore insufficient to generate the bursty recurrence observed along semantic directions. The results instead support an interpretation in terms of the ordered recurrence of semantically related material.
summary:
书面文本中的远程相关性远远超出了本地语法的范围，但它们与语义组织的关系仍然不完全被理解。先前的研究已将这些相关性与主题相关单词的突然重复联系起来。在这里，我们将这种构造从单个词汇项概括为分布式语义可观察量。我们将文本标记逐个映射到预先训练的词嵌入的轨迹上，使用主成分分析（PCA）来识别文本特定的语义变化方向，并对投影序列进行阈值来定义事件间时间；它们的变异系数形成了分量解析的突发谱$\{B_k\}$。

在 28 篇文学和科学文本以及前 20 个组件中，原始文本系统地保持在几何事件间时间基线之上，并高于两个互补控制：一个词洗牌零值，它保留嵌入协方差、PCA 特征系统和边际投影分布，同时破坏时间顺序；以及一个分数高斯噪声替代项，它保留 Zipfian 频率结构并匹配去趋势波动分析 (DFA)原始排序序列的指数。对于由每个投影的上 5% 尾部定义的事件，原始图像超出了每个文本组件对中的两个控件，而这两个控件在统计上无法区分。语义投影的自相关和去趋势波动分析以相同的方式将原始数据与两个控件分开。因此，全局排名级别的远程相关性不足以生成沿语义方向观察到的突发循环。相反，结果支持语义相关材料的有序重现的解释。

title: Boundary-condition independence of infinite-chain ground states in the $S=1$ $J$-$D$ antiferromagnetic chain
abstract: Extending the analytic machinery and using the numerical inputs from OpenAI's proofs of the Haldane gap, we study infinite-chain ground states of the $S=1$ $J$-$D$ antiferromagnetic model $H=\sum_j\{\boldsymbol S_j\cdot\boldsymbol S_{j+1}+D(S_j^{\mathrm z})^2\}$ for sufficiently small $|D|$. We consider two finite-volume settings: periodic chains with an even number of sites, and open chains with an odd number of sites and the same positive magnetic field in the $\mathrm z$ direction at both endpoints. We prove that the ground states in each setting have an infinite-chain limit along the full sequence, without passing to a subsequence, and that the two limiting states coincide. Convergence is uniform in $D$ on a fixed neighborhood of zero. The common limit is a symmetric locally-unique gapped ground state, and its local expectation values depend continuously on $D$. These conclusions concern the two specified constructions, not uniqueness among all infinite-chain ground states. They provide the input for the study of a topological phase transition in a forthcoming revision of our companion paper. The author formulated the problem and proposed the basic strategy. ChatGPT Astra made substantial contributions to the inductive estimates and to completing the proof.
summary:
扩展分析机制并使用 OpenAI 霍尔丹能隙证明中的数值输入，我们研究了 $S=1$ $J$-$D$ 反铁磁模型 $H=\sum_j\{\boldsymbol S_j\cdot\boldsymbol S_{j+1}+D(S_j^{\mathrm z})^2\}$ 的无限链基态（对于足够小的 $|D|$）。我们考虑两种有限体积设置：具有偶数个位点的周期链，以及具有奇数个位点且两个端点在 $\mathrm z$ 方向上具有相同正磁场的开链。我们证明，每个设置中的基态在整个序列上都有一个无限链限制，而无需传递到子序列，并且两个极限状态是一致的。在固定的零邻域上，$D$ 的收敛性是均匀的。共同极限是对称的局部唯一有隙基态，其局部期望值持续依赖于 $D$。这些结论涉及两种特定的结构，而不是所有无限链基态之间的唯一性。它们为我们的配套论文即将修订的拓扑相变研究提供了输入。作者阐述了问题并提出了基本策略。

ChatGPT Astra 对归纳估计和完成证明做出了重大贡献。

title: Rigorous Lower Bounds for Atomic and Ionic Ground-State Energies
abstract: We establish a new iterative method for computing rigorous lower bounds for the ground-state energies of all atoms and ions. The accuracy of the resulting bounds depends on two ingredients: the quality of the initial energy estimate and the quality of the used upper bound for the maximum number of bound electrons, $N_c(Z)$, as a function of the nuclear charge $Z>0$. In particular, this new method allows us to establish the explicit lower bound $E(N,Z) \geq -0.8710\,N^{1/3}Z^2$ for the ground-state energy $E(N,Z)$ of the atom/ion with $N \in \mathbb{N}$ electrons and nuclear charge $Z \in (0,N]$, thereby considerably improving the best known constant $A=(3/2)^{1/3} \approx 1.1447$ in the estimate $E(N,Z) \geq -A\,N^{1/3}Z^2$ for $0 < Z \leq N$ and coming much closer to the best possible constant given by the Thomas-Fermi asymptotics $\lim_{N \to \infty} |E(N,N)|N^{-7/3}= -E_{\text{TF}}(1)\approx 0.7687$ derived in Adv. Math., 23(1) by Lieb and Simon. To demonstrate the potential and the limits of our method, we also compute explicit lower bounds for the ground-state energies $E(N,N)$ of all atoms with $2 \leq N \leq 86$ and we compare them with the bounds obtained in J. Chem. Phys., 62(8) by Hertel, Lieb, Thirring and the bounds obtained by Seco in his dissertation. Finally, we also provide a uniqueness result for the expectation values of the kinetic, potential and interaction energies on the ground-state space.
summary:
我们建立了一种新的迭代方法来计算所有原子和离子的基态能量的严格下限。所得界限的准确性取决于两个因素：初始能量估计的质量和所使用的最大束缚电子数 $N_c(Z)$ 上限的质量，作为核电荷 $Z>0$ 的函数。特别是，这种新方法允许我们为具有 $N \in \mathbb{N}$ 电子和核电荷 $Z \in (0,N]$ 的原子/离子的基态能量 $E(N,Z)$ 建立显式下界 $E(N,Z) \geq -0.8710\,N^{1/3}Z^2$，从而显着改进最著名的常数 $A=(3/2)^{1/3} \approx $0 < Z \leq N$ 的估计值 $E(N,Z) \geq -A\,N^{1/3}Z^2$ 为 1.1447$，并且更接近 Thomas-Fermi 渐近方程 $\lim_{N \to \infty} |E(N,N)|N^{-7/3}= -E_{\text{TF}}(1)\approx 给出的最佳可能常数0.7687$ 在 Lieb 和 Simon 的 Adv. Math., 23(1) 中得出。

Phys.，62(8)，作者：Hertel、Lieb、Thirring，以及 Seco 在其论文中获得的界限。最后，我们还提供了基态空间上动能、势能和相互作用能的期望值的唯一性结果。

title: Gaussian $β$-Markov Path Spaces without a Spectral Gap and the Araki--Woods Representations
abstract: Dereziński and Gérard constructed the Gaussian $\beta$-Markov path space of a free Bose field in a form equivalent to the Araki--Woods representation, which suits nonequilibrium statistical mechanics with a quantum-field environment, but only for one-particle Hamiltonians with a spectral gap. We extend this construction, together with the equivalence to the Araki--Woods representation, to one-particle Hamiltonians without a spectral gap. The extension is intended for constructive quantum field theory at positive temperature and equilibrium statistical mechanics, for instance in the problem of the absence of Bose--Einstein condensation of quasiparticles whose number is not conserved.
summary: Dereziński 和 Gérard 以与 Araki-Woods 表示形式等效的形式构建了自由玻色场的高斯 $\beta$-马尔可夫路径空间，它适合具有量子场环境的非平衡统计力学，但仅适用于具有谱间隙的单粒子哈密顿量。我们将这种构造以及与 Araki-Woods 表示的等价性一起扩展到没有谱间隙的单粒子哈密顿量。该扩展旨在用于正温度和平衡统计力学下的建设性量子场论，例如在不存在数量不守恒的准粒子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的问题中。

title: On the types of quasiperiodic potentials and level surfaces of quasiperiodic functions
abstract: We examine the similarities and differences between two types of quasiperiodic functions: those obtained by restricting smooth periodic functions in $\mathbb{R}^N$ to lower-dimensional subspaces $\mathbb{R}^n \subset \mathbb{R}^N$, and those that arise as physical fields or potentials in quasicrystalline structures. Our analysis reveals that functions in these two classes share a number of common features while also exhibiting significant differences. As a key tool for investigating both classes of functions, we employ the Novikov problem - specifically, the problem of describing the global geometry of the level sets of quasiperiodic functions.
summary: 我们研究了两类准周期函数之间的异同：通过将 $\mathbb{R}^N$ 中的平滑周期函数限制到低维子空间 $\mathbb{R}^n \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ 获得的准周期函数，以及作为准晶体结构中的物理场或势产生的准周期函数。我们的分析表明，这两类函数具有许多共同特征，同时也表现出显着差异。作为研究这两类函数的关键工具，我们采用诺维科夫问题 - 具体来说，是描述准周期函数水平集的全局几何的问题。

title: General Relativity for Mathematicians - Part I
abstract: These notes cover the first part of a course of the same title taught by Filippo Fila-Robattino and Manuel Tecchiolli at the University of Zurich in the Winter Semester of 2025. Topics include variational principles in classical mechanics, special relativity, smooth manifolds and tensor calculus, connections and curvature, geodesic motion, and the derivation of Einstein's equations from the Einstein-Hilbert action. The treatment is aimed at a mathematical audience, combining physical motivation with precise definitions, detailed proofs, and explicit calculations.
summary: 这些笔记涵盖了苏黎世大学 Filippo Fila-Robattino 和 Manuel Tecchiolli 于 2025 年冬季学期教授的同名课程的第一部分。主题包括经典力学中的变分原理、狭义相对论、光滑流形和张量微积分、连接和曲率、测地运动以及从爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用推导爱因斯坦方程。该治疗针对的是数学受众，将物理动机与精确的定义、详细的证明和明确的计算相结合。

title: Measurement-dependent reduction of open dynamics in the quantum phase estimation algorithm: the visible subspace and the damped Fejér kernel
abstract: For the quantum phase estimation (QPE) algorithm we study the minimal space of observables that is sufficient to predict the entire output distribution under open dynamics of the counting register. Building on the general Krylov theory of reduction, we compute the structure of this space explicitly for the full Fourier measurement. The outcome probabilities are determined by cyclic sums of the state matrix. If the adjoint generator is diagonal on the matrix units, the spectral classes inside the residue classes of the index difference modulo the register dimension $M$ give a constructive basis, an exact dimension formula, and attainable bounds: the dimension of the visible space lies between $M$ and $M^2-M+1$. The class includes independent qubit dephasing, and an analytically solvable reference model of Gorini--Kossakowski--Lindblad--Sudarshan (GKLS) type yields a damped Fejér kernel; two random-unitary channels with the same Ramsey contrast show that higher harmonics are distinguishable in the QPE distribution. For approximate reduction we use a finite-time Gramian and an a posteriori residual estimate, with a quadratic error order for a reducing unperturbed subspace and a compatible initial state. Numerical calculations check the consistency of the representations and the behaviour of the error under non-Toeplitz perturbations.
summary:
对于量子相位估计（QPE）算法，我们研究足以预测计数寄存器的开放动态下的整个输出分布的最小可观测量空间。基于一般克雷洛夫归约理论，我们为完整的傅立叶测量明确地计算了该空间的结构。结果概率由状态矩阵的循环和确定。如果伴随生成器在矩阵单元上是对角的，则索引差的残差类内的光谱类以寄存器维度 $M$ 为模给出构造基础、精确的维度公式和可达到的边界：可见空间的维度位于 $M$ 和 $M^2-M+1$ 之间。该类包括独立的量子位相移，以及 Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan (GKLS) 类型的分析可解参考模型，产生阻尼 Fejér 核；具有相同 Ramsey 对比度的两个随机单一通道表明，QPE 分布中的高次谐波是可区分的。

对于近似约简，我们使用有限时间格拉米亚和后验残差估计，并使用二次误差阶来减少未受扰动的子空间和兼容的初始状态。数值计算检查非托普利茨扰动下表示的一致性和误差的行为。

title: Existence of a weak solution to the Navier-Stokes equations enjoying the energy equality
abstract: To date, a Leray's weak solution to the Navier-Stokes equations enjoys an energy inequality. We prove the existence of a weak solution that enjoys the energy equality. The existence of the weak solution is achieved as limit of solutions to the mollified Navier-Stokes system (Leray's approach). Since no uniqueness result is known for weak solutions we are not able to claim that any weak solution in the sense of Leray-Hopf enjoys the energy equality.
summary: 迄今为止，纳维-斯托克斯方程的勒雷弱解存在能量不等式。我们证明了存在能量相等的弱解。弱解的存在是作为安抚的纳维-斯托克斯系统（Leray 方法）的解的极限而实现的。由于弱解没有唯一性结果，我们不能断言 Leray-Hopf 意义上的任何弱解都享有能量相等。

title: Finite-step projective dynamics of Schrödinger cocycles: non-degeneracy, regularity, and rigidity
abstract: We study the no deterministic images condition (NDI) for Schrödinger cocycles, which excludes a common image of a fixed probability measure under almost all projective transfer transformations. We prove two-step NDI at every energy for nonconstant measurable potentials over mixing systems and ergodic potentials with infinite essential range, and classify persistence for finite-state locally constant potentials. For bounded Markov and hidden Markov potentials on general state spaces under a one-step $L^2$ norm gap condition on the Markov operator, we prove Hölder bounds for solution-direction distributions above an exponential cutoff and Hölder conditional stationary measures. Counterexamples show the essential sharpness of both assumptions. For nonconstant real trigonometric potentials, including the almost Mathieu operator, we prove NDI and Hölder bounds for distributions of solution directions at all steps $k\ge2$ and all frequencies (rational or irrational). The exponent depends on the step, while the constant is uniform in steps, frequency and energy on compact intervals. For every irrational frequency and every energy with positive Lyapunov exponent, we prove non-atomicity of both Oseledets direction distributions and convergence to the unstable distribution from every phase-independent initial probability. This gives a new criterion for a zero Lyapunov exponent: a subsequential limit with an atom for one fixed initial direction suffices. All these results extend to an analytic class, with step-dependent regularity bounds.
summary:
我们研究了薛定谔循环的非确定性图像条件（NDI），它排除了几乎所有投影传递变换下固定概率测量的常见图像。我们证明了混合系统上的非恒定可测量势和具有无限基本范围的遍历势在每种能量下的两步 NDI，并对有限状态局部恒定势的持久性进行了分类。对于马尔可夫算子上的一步 $L^2$ 范数间隙条件下一般状态空间上的有界马尔可夫和隐马尔可夫势，我们证明了高于指数截止和 Hölder 条件平稳测度的解方向分布的 Hölder 界限。反例显示了这两个假设的本质尖锐性。对于非恒定实三角势，包括近似 Mathieu 算子，我们证明了所有步骤 $k\ge2$ 和所有频率（有理或无理）解方向分布的 NDI 和 Hölder 界。指数取决于步长，而常数在紧凑间隔上的步长、频率和能量是一致的。

对于每个无理频率和每个具有正 Lyapunov 指数的能量，我们证明了 Oseledets 方向分布的非原子性以及从每个与相位无关的初始概率收敛到不稳定分布。这给出了零李雅普诺夫指数的新标准：一个固定初始方向的原子的后续极限就足够了。所有这些结果都扩展到具有依赖于步长的正则性界限的分析类。

title: Curvature-induced fracture mode coupling in doubly curved shells
abstract: Classical shell fracture theories predominantly consider cracks aligned with principal curvature directions in cylindrical and spherical shells under tensile mode or pressure loading, leaving the fracture behavior of arbitrarily oriented cracks in doubly curved shells under general loading poorly understood. Here, we introduce a semi-analytical framework based on Reissner shallow-shell theory to investigate isotropic shells with positive, zero, and negative Gaussian curvature. The formulation computes stress intensity factors, energy release rates, and crack-lip displacements for arbitrarily inclined through-thickness cracks in spheres, ellipsoids, cylinders, hyperboloids, and minimal surfaces under general mechanical loading. We show that shell curvature couples opening, sliding, and tearing, allowing a single loading component to activate multiple fracture modes, unlike in flat plates. This coupling depends strongly on crack orientation and the normal, parallel, and torsional components of the shell curvature. Ellipsoids exhibit weak coupling, hyperboloids generally exhibit the strongest coupling, and cylinders display the most complex orientation-dependent responses. Moreover, in-plane shear can induce crack closure in hyperboloidal shells, suggesting a potential geometric mechanism for enhanced damage resistance. These findings elucidate the role of local curvature in fracture-mode coupling and provide a mechanistic foundation for the analysis of shellular (meta-)structures with engineered curvature distributions.
summary:
经典壳断裂理论主要考虑拉伸模式或压力载荷下圆柱壳和球壳中与主曲率方向对齐的裂纹，而对一般载荷下双曲壳中任意方向裂纹的断裂行为知之甚少。在这里，我们引入基于赖斯纳浅壳理论的半解析框架来研究具有正、零和负高斯曲率的各向同性壳。该公式计算球体、椭球体、圆柱体、双曲面和最小表面在一般机械载荷下任意倾斜的全厚度裂纹的应力强度因子、能量释放速率和裂纹唇位移。我们证明，与平板不同，壳曲率与张开、滑动和撕裂耦合，允许单个加载组件激活多种断裂模式。这种耦合在很大程度上取决于裂纹方向以及壳曲率的法向、平行和扭转分量。椭球体表现出弱耦合，双曲面通常表现出最强的耦合，而圆柱体表现出最复杂的方向相关响应。

此外，面内剪切可以引起双曲面壳中的裂纹闭合，这表明了增强抗损伤能力的潜在几何机制。这些发现阐明了局部曲率在断裂模式耦合中的作用，并为分析具有工程曲率分布的壳（元）结构提供了机械基础。

title: Simplifying 2-Bundle Descriptions of Invariants and Local Dynamics
abstract: A string couples to a two-form gauge potential whose local descriptions need not fit together as a single global form. Principal 2-bundles provide a geometric description of this gluing. However, we recover surface amplitudes and quantum partition functions, as well as local classical field dynamics, without the 2-bundle formalism. For global phases, topological and index invariants, and twisted-sheaf moduli, established equivalences give alternative descriptions through cocycles, bundles, operators, or modules, with the required global compatibility data. For three-dimensional finite gauge theories with cohomological actions, Fourier transformation expresses the partition function as a sum of partition functions of ordinary finite-group gauge theories. An invertible local substitution reduces invariant classical actions for a class of 2-bundle connections represented by finite-dimensional crossed modules to ordinary gauge and tensor dynamics. These finite and local reductions explicitly eliminate field variables. A four-dimensional quadratic example instead admits a direct cochain evaluation even when an ordinary gauge-theory reduction fails. These results therefore do not require the additional 2-bundle presentation.
summary:
字符串耦合到两种形式的规范势，其局部描述不需要组合在一起作为单个全局形式。主要 2 束提供了这种粘合的几何描述。然而，我们恢复了表面振幅和量子配分函数，以及局部经典场动力学，而没有 2 束形式主义。对于全局相、拓扑和索引不变量以及扭束模量，已建立的等价通过余环、束、运算符或模块以及所需的全局兼容性数据给出替代描述。对于具有上同调作用的三维有限规范理论，傅立叶变换将配分函数表示为普通有限群规范理论的配分函数之和。可逆局部替换将由有限维交叉模表示的一类 2 束连接的不变经典作用减少到普通规范和张量动力学。这些有限和局部的缩减明确地消除了场变量。相反，即使普通的规范理论约简失败，四维二次示例也允许直接的协链评估。

因此，这些结果不需要额外的 2 束演示。

title: Entropic hypocoercivity via the Polchinski flow: an application to the lattice sine-Gordon model
abstract: We develop a multiscale criterion for exponential decay of relative entropy in the canonical stochastic quantization of lattice field theories, the underdamped Langevin dynamics of the field and its momentum. For smooth bounded perturbations of Gaussian fields, the criterion requires the uniform operator-norm bound on the smoothed interaction Hessian along the Polchinski flow of Bauerschmidt and Bodineau to have a small $L^2$ norm in the scale variable. The decay constants depend only on this $L^2$ norm and the friction. The proof measures the transfer of momentum dissipation to position on the same scales that decompose entropy. A phase-space extension of the Polchinski flow gives Gaussian coarse-graining that commutes with free kinetic evolution. Integrating position--momentum cross terms over these scales yields a corrector bounded by entropy. A force defect accounts for changes in the averaged interaction force away from equilibrium; its evolution in scale controls the errors in the kinetic estimate. For the massive two-dimensional lattice sine--Gordon model with $0<\beta<4\pi$ and small dimensionless local coupling, the criterion gives entropy decay for all finite-entropy initial laws, uniformly in the lattice spacing and the volume. For friction proportional to the mass $m$, the rate has optimal order $m$.
summary:
我们开发了晶格场论正则随机量子化中相对熵指数衰减的多尺度准则、场及其动量的欠阻尼朗之万动力学。对于高斯场的平滑有界扰动，该准则要求沿着 Bauerschmidt 和 Bodineau 的 Polchinski 流的平滑交互 Hessian 上的统一算子范数界，在尺度变量中具有较小的 $L^2$ 范数。衰减常数仅取决于 $L^2$ 范数和摩擦力。该证明测量了动量耗散到分解熵的相同尺度上的位置的转移。波尔钦斯基流的相空间扩展提供了与自由动力学演化相通的高斯粗粒度。对这些尺度上的位置动量交叉项进行积分会产生一个由熵限制的校正器。力缺陷导致平均相互作用力偏离平衡的变化；它的尺度演变控制着动力学估计的误差。

对于具有 $0<\beta<4\pi$ 和小无量纲局部耦合的大规模二维晶格正弦--Gordon 模型，该准则给出了所有有限熵初始定律的熵衰减，在晶格间距和体积中一致。对于与质量 $m$ 成正比的摩擦力，速率具有最优阶 $m$。

title: Hidden Singularity and Fractal Dimensions for Extended Harper Operators
abstract: We prove that, for every irrational frequency, the spectra of the extended Harper family throughout the zero-measure regime have finite $1/2$-dimensional Hausdorff measure and lower box dimension at most $1/2$. Both numbers improve to $1/3$ on the isotropic critical boundary. The proof is based on a family of unitary transformations, that specializes to the chiral transform of [BJK] for the case of the critical almost Mathieu. This family allows to make every operator in this regime spectrally equivalent to a singular Jacobi operator. Using these singular representatives, we apply the method of [BJK] to construct covers by $O(q_n)$ intervals of total length $O(q_n^{-1})$, improving to $O(q_n^{-2})$ on the isotropic boundary, where $q_n$ is the denominator of a canonical approximant to $\alpha$. The covers give upper box bounds and, with packing estimates, examples where the box-counting dimension fails to exist.
summary: 我们证明，对于每个无理频率，整个零测度范围内扩展哈珀族的谱具有有限的 $1/2$ 维豪斯多夫测度和至多 $1/2$ 的下框维数。在各向同性临界边界上，这两个数字都提高到 $1/3$。该证明基于一系列酉变换，专门用于临界几乎马蒂厄情况下的 [BJK] 手征变换。该族允许使该区域中的每个算子在光谱上等价于单个雅可比算子。使用这些奇异代表，我们应用[BJK]的方法来构造总长度为$O(q_n^{-1})$的$O(q_n)$区间的覆盖，在各向同性边界上改进为$O(q_n^{-2})$，其中$q_n$是$\alpha$的规范近似值的分母。封面给出了盒子的上限，并通过包装估计，给出了盒子计数维度不存在的示例。

title: Quantum dynamics on the sparse Erdős-Rényi graph
abstract: We analyse the large-time asymptotics of the Schrödinger time evolution of a free quantum particle on the Erdős-Rényi graph $\mathbb{G}(N,d/N)$, where the quantum Hamiltonian is given by the adjacency matrix of $\mathbb{G}$. Starting from a state localized at a vertex, the wave function is approximately radial, and we characterize precisely its asymptotic form. Our results in particular cover vertices whose degree is close to $2d$, hence probing the emergence of bound states from a dynamical perspective. This provides a dynamical counterpart of the coexistence of localized and delocalized states established in [ arXiv:1905.03243 , arXiv:2005.14180 , arXiv:2106.12519 , arXiv:2109.03227 , arXiv:2305.16294 ], with the former giving rise to a localized mode and the latter to a dispersive wave. Our results hold in the regime $\sqrt{\log N} \ll d \ll N^{o(1)}$, which is the full region in which such dynamical phenomena may exist, and for times $1 \ll t \ll T_N$ for some explicit $T_N \gg 1$.
summary: 我们在 Erdős-Rényi 图 $\mathbb{G}(N,d/N)$ 上分析自由量子粒子的薛定谔时间演化的大时间渐近性，其中量子哈密顿量由 $\mathbb{G}$ 的邻接矩阵给出。从位于顶点的局域态开始，波函数近似径向，并且我们精确地描述了其渐近形式。我们的结果特别涵盖了度数接近 $2d$ 的顶点，因此从动力学角度探讨了束缚态的出现。这提供了在[ arXiv:1905.03243 , arXiv:2005.14180 , arXiv:2106.12519 , arXiv:2109.03227 , arXiv:2305.16294 ]中建立的本地化和非本地化状态共存的动态对应物，前者产生了局域波，后者为色散波。我们的结果保持在 $\sqrt{\log N} \ll d \ll N^{o(1)}$ 范围内，这是可能存在这种动态现象的完整区域，并且对于某些显式 $T_N \gg 1$ 来说，对于时间 $1 \ll t \ll T_N$ 。

title: Fully quantum training of parametric circuits with Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
abstract: Parametric quantum circuits are usually trained by classical, local optimizers, which use the quantum computer only to evaluate the cost function, or its gradient, one point at a time. Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) takes a different route: in this quantum algorithm for continuous optimization, the parameters become the position of a quantum particle, with the cost function as its potential, and two time schedules control kinetic and potential energy so that the wavefunction explores the whole landscape and tunnels towards the global minimum. QHD, however, assumes a classically computable cost function, and its digital implementation is poorly understood: standard error bounds grow exponentially with the number of qubits per parameter, and the schedules are borrowed from classical optimization. Here we propose to train parametric circuits with QHD entirely on the quantum computer, through an online step in which the qubits encoding the parameters coherently control the circuit on a second register. We prove that, for cost functions with a smooth periodic extension, including those of parametric circuits, the simulation error admits a bound independent of the grid resolution, and that for circuits the bound grows at most linearly with the number of parameters. We also show that the ideal dynamics depends on the two schedules only through a single curve, which controls the adiabaticity of the search, and that the remaining freedom can be used to minimize the gate count. Simulations on benchmark functions and parametric circuits show that, at equal cost, schedules designed in this way markedly increase the probability of finding the global minimum.
summary:
参数量子电路通常由经典的局部优化器进行训练，这些优化器仅使用量子计算机一次评估一个点的成本函数或其梯度。量子哈密顿下降（QHD）则采取了不同的路线：在这种连续优化的量子算法中，参数成为量子粒子的位置，以成本函数为其势，两个时间计划控制动能和势能，使波函数探索整个景观并通向全局最小值。然而，QHD 假设了一个经典的可计算成本函数，并且人们对它的数字实现知之甚少：标准误差界限随着每个参数的量子位数量呈指数增长，并且时间表是从经典优化中借用的。在这里，我们建议完全在量子计算机上训练具有 QHD 的参数电路，通过在线步骤，其中编码参数的量子位连贯地控制第二个寄存器上的电路。

我们证明，对于具有平滑周期扩展的成本函数（包括参数电路的成本函数），模拟误差允许与网格分辨率无关的界限，并且对于电路，界限最多与参数数量呈线性增长。我们还表明，理想的动态仅通过一条曲线取决于两个调度，该曲线控制搜索的绝热性，并且剩余的自由度可用于最小化门数。对基准函数和参数电路的仿真表明，在同等成本下，以这种方式设计的调度显着增加了找到全局最小值的概率。

title: Genuinely multipartite entangled qudits: one rule to link them all
abstract: Links of rings offer an intuitive picture of multipartite entanglement. Cutting one ring can free some of the others, just as losing a particle, i.e. tracing it out, can disentangle some of the remaining ones. This analogy classifies multipartite entanglement according to which groups of particles stay entangled when others are lost, a question at the heart of robust quantum networks. However, pure states realizing a given link class were known only in special cases. Here, we close this gap. Recasting link polynomials as hypergraphs, we give an explicit formula for pure qudit states and prove that, for every link class, their entanglement under any pattern of particle loss matches the link exactly. The same construction also controls genuine multipartite entanglement, determining exactly which of the groups that stay entangled are genuinely multipartite entangled, and all of them can be made so. As a consequence, we prove the conjecture that $m$-resistant pure qudit states, which stay entangled after the loss of any $m$ particles but become fully separable after the loss of $m+1$, exist for any number of particles and any $m$.
summary: 环的链接提供了多部分纠缠的直观图像。切割一个环可以释放其他一些环，就像失去一个粒子（即追踪它）可以解开剩余的一些粒子一样。这个类比根据哪些粒子组在其他粒子丢失时保持纠缠来对多部分纠缠进行分类，这是鲁棒量子网络的核心问题。然而，仅在特殊情况下才知道实现给定链接类的纯状态。在这里，我们缩小了这一差距。将链接多项式重铸为超图，我们给出了纯 qudit 状态的显式公式，并证明，对于每个链接类别，它​​们在任何粒子损失模式下的纠缠都与链接完全匹配。同样的结构还可以控制真正的多部分纠缠，准确确定哪些保持纠缠的基团是真正的多部分纠缠，并且所有这些都可以如此。因此，我们证明了这样的猜想：对于任何数量的粒子和任何 $m$，存在抗 $m$ 的纯 Qudit 态，这种纯量子态在失去任何 $m$ 粒子后保持纠缠，但在失去 $m+1$ 后变得完全可分离。

title: Post-Quantum Perfect Zero-Knowledge Arguments for NP From Any One-Way Permutation
abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time that post-quantum one-way permutations are sufficient for perfect zero-knowledge classical arguments for all of NP with security guaranteed against quantum adversaries. We first establish that Naor, Ostrovsky,Venkatesen, and Yung's bit commitment scheme built from any permutation using interactive hashing, called the NOVY scheme, is sum-binding and collapse-binding against quantum polynomial-time committers provided the permutation is post-quantum one-way. We then show that the collapse-binding property of the NOVY scheme allows for Blum's perfect zero-knowledge argument for HAMCYCLE to remain so exactly as it stands against quantum adversaries.
summary: 在本文中，我们首次证明后量子单向排列足以实现所有 NP 的完美零知识经典论证，并保证针对量子对手的安全性。我们首先确定 Naor、Ostrovsky、Venkatesen 和 Yung 的位承诺方案（称为 NOVY 方案）使用交互式散列从任何排列构建，只要排列是后量子单向，就可以针对量子多项式时间提交者进行和绑定和塌陷绑定。然后，我们证明 NOVY 方案的塌缩约束特性允许 Blum 针对 HAMCYCLE 的完美零知识论点保持与量子对手对抗时的精确性。

title: Quantum Heuristic Separation of Comb Inequalities for the Travelling Salesman Problem
abstract: Comb inequalities are essential cutting planes for the travelling salesman problem, yet their separation remains computationally challenging. We propose a quantum heuristic separation algorithm for this family of inequalities. The algorithm uses a procedure that prepares a uniform superposition of all combs with a fixed number of teeth using polynomially many gates and qubits. As part of this procedure, we present a circuit that coherently encodes the Hamming weight of a data register in one-hot form in an auxiliary register. The separation algorithm then searches for violated inequalities using the Grover-Mixer Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz. Its running time is polynomial under prescribed polynomial budgets for the number of QAOA rounds, parameter optimization steps and samples gathered, although we provide no evidence that such budgets suffice to find a violated comb with constant probability when one exists. We provide an explicit circuit construction for the mixer unitary, the full problem Hamiltonian and a resource analysis.
summary: 梳状不等式是解决旅行商问题的重要切面，但它们的分离在计算上仍然具有挑战性。我们针对这组不等式提出了一种量子启发式分离算法。该算法使用的程序使用多项式门和量子位来准备具有固定齿数的所有梳的均匀叠加。作为该过程的一部分，我们提出了一种电路，该电路可以在辅助寄存器中以单热形式对数据寄存器的汉明权重进行连贯编码。然后，分离算法使用 Grover-Mixer 量子交替算子 Ansatz 搜索违反的不等式。在 QAOA 轮数、参数优化步骤和收集的样本的规定多项式预算下，它的运行时间是多项式的，尽管我们没有提供证据表明这样的预算足以在存在时以恒定概率找到违规梳。我们为混合器酉式、完整问题哈密顿量和资源分析提供了显式电路构造。

title: Study of localization properties under subsystem periodic driving
abstract: Periodic driving provides a powerful route for controlling localization and engineering effective Hamiltonians in quantum systems. A localized one-dimensional Aubry-André chain can be driven into a fully delocalized phase when the entire system is driven below a critical frequency. Here, we ask whether such delocalization can be achieved by driving only a part of the system. We address this question using a two-leg ladder comprising an Aubry-André chain coupled to a periodically driven clean tight-binding chain. Exact numerical calculations show that, starting from a localized static ladder, subsystem driving below a critical frequency cannot achieve complete delocalization. Instead, a mixed phase emerges, with localized and delocalized states coexisting and the fraction of delocalized states varying nonmonotonically with the driving frequency. This behavior can be understood using local effective Hamiltonians. Although these effective Hamiltonians are derived analytically in the high-frequency regime, they can nevertheless predict the localization transition occurring in the moderate-frequency regime. In fact, by quantifying the emergent nonlocality of the Floquet Hamiltonian, we show that these effective Hamiltonians provide a valid description up to a crossover frequency that is lower than the critical frequency associated with the localization transition. Our results demonstrate an alternative route to Floquet engineering, in which the transport properties of a quantum lattice system can be modified by driving only a subsystem.
summary:
周期性驱动为控制量子系统中的局域化和设计有效的哈密顿量提供了强大的途径。当整个系统被驱动到低于临界频率时，局域一维奥布里-安德烈链可以被驱动进入完全离域阶段。在这里，我们询问是否可以通过仅驱动系统的一部分来实现这种离域化。我们使用两腿梯子来解决这个问题，该梯子包括奥布里-安德烈链和周期性驱动的清洁紧束缚链。精确的数值计算表明，从局部静态阶梯开始，低于临界频率驱动的子系统无法实现完全离域。相反，出现了混合相，局域和离域状态共存，并且离域状态的比例随驱动频率非单调变化。这种行为可以使用局部有效哈密顿量来理解。尽管这些有效的哈密顿量是在高频区域中分析得出的，但它们仍然可以预测在中频率区域中发生的局域化转变。

事实上，通过量化 Floquet 哈密顿量的新兴非定域性，我们表明这些有效的哈密顿量提供了低于与局域化转变相关的临界频率的交叉频率的有效描述。我们的结果展示了 Floquet 工程的另一种途径，其中量子晶格系统的传输特性可以通过仅驱动子系统来修改。

title: A New Non-Affine Family in the Karlsson-Szollosi Intersection
abstract: We show that $K_6^{(2)} \cap X_6^{(2)} = D_6^{(1)} \cup C_6^{(1)}$ up to standard Hadamard equivalence, where $C_6^{(1)}$ is a new non-affine one-parameter family of complex Hadamard matrices. This demonstrates that the intersection of the two-parameter Hadamard families of Karlsson and Szöllősi is strictly larger than the known affine Diţă curve $D_6^{(1)}$. Our new parametrisation of the Szöllősi family $X_6^{(2)}$ in Karlsson coordinates and our constructive classification of the Karlsson-Szöllősi intersection shed light on the intersection of block-reducible forms and hypocycloid constraints. This may support the search for mutually unbiased bases in six dimensions.
summary: 我们证明 $K_6^{(2)} \cap X_6^{(2)} = D_6^{(1)} \cup C_6^{(1)}$ 达到标准 Hadamard 等价，其中 $C_6^{(1)}$ 是复杂 Hadamard 矩阵的新非仿射单参数族。这表明 Karlsson 和 Szöllősi 的双参数 Hadamard 族的交集严格大于已知的仿射 Diţă 曲线 $D_6^{(1)}$。我们在卡尔森坐标中对 Szöllősi 系列 $X_6^{(2)}$ 的新参数化以及对 Karlsson-Szöllősi 交集的构造性分类揭示了块可约形式和内摆线约束的交集。这可能支持在六个维度上寻找相互公正的基础。

title: Twirled and swirled worlds: a compositional approach
abstract: Twirled and swirled worlds describe generalised probabilistic theories (GPTs) restricted by symmetry-imposed superselection rules. We extend these constructions to a fully compositional setting for finite-dimensional GPTs and compact groups, treating states, effects, and multipartite transformations uniformly as processes. We distinguish system actions from process-space actions. We define actions on a theory as a whole by requiring the corresponding process-space actions to respect sequential and parallel composition. Averaging physical theory actions defines twirling, while averaging nonphysical theory actions defines swirling. We show that invariant subtheories might not satisfy process tomography, and establish conditions under which they do, involving invariant dynamically faithful states or internal classical reference frames. For locally tomographic parent theories, we prove that every theory symmetry admits a representation by linear system actions and that the invariant subtheory satisfies process tomography. An invariant multipartite process space fails local tomography if and only if some bipartition has sides sharing a non-trivial irreducible representation. We characterise when ancillary systems are necessary, which representations they must carry, and when entanglement is required for ancilla-free process tomography. We develop a framework for unifying twirled subtheories and extend incoherent simulations to compact groups. Finally, we recover bilocal classical theory as a twirled subtheory of classical theory and real quantum theory as a swirled subtheory of complex quantum theory, deriving their tomographic properties from their representation structure.
summary:
旋转和旋转的世界描述了受对称性强加的超级选择规则限制的广义概率理论（GPT）。我们将这些构造扩展到有限维 GPT 和紧群的完全组合设置，将状态、效果和多部分变换统一视为过程。我们将系统操作与进程空间操作区分开来。我们通过要求相应的过程空间动作尊重顺序和并行组合来将理论的动作定义为一个整体。平均物理理论作用定义旋转，而平均非物理理论作用定义旋转。我们证明不变子理论可能无法满足过程层析成像，并建立了满足过程层析成像的条件，包括不变的动态忠实状态或内部经典参考系。对于局部断层扫描父理论，我们证明每个理论对称性都允许线性系统行为的表示，并且不变子理论满足过程断层扫描。当且仅当某些二分具有共享非平凡不可约表示的边时，不变的多部分过程空间才会失败局部层析成像。

我们描述了何时需要辅助系统、它们必须携带哪些表示，以及何时需要无辅助过程断层扫描的纠缠。我们开发了一个框架来统一旋转子理论，并将不相干的模拟扩展到紧凑群。最后，我们将双局域经典理论恢复为经典理论的旋转子理论，并将实量子理论恢复为复杂量子理论的旋转子理论，从其表示结构中推导出它们的层析性质。

title: A new analytical finding for the Born-Infeld integral potential
abstract: A new finding regarding the Born-Infeld potential for short range distances from the charge revealed that its integral form can be almost exact written as the difference between a Coulomb-type potential and a Yukawa-type potential. This allowed for an immediate physical interpretation in terms of classical vacuum polarization and an effective mass. Subsequently, a new U(r) is proposed to cover the entire space. This formulation is then applied to calculate, in a closed manner, the first-order energy shifts in hydrogen-like atoms; a comparison of these shifts with high-precision spectroscopic data provides a model-dependent lower bound for the maximum field intensity parameter b.
summary: 关于距电荷短距离的玻恩-因费尔德势的一项新发现表明，其积分形式几乎可以精确地写为库仑型势和汤川型势之间的差异。这使得可以根据经典真空极化和有效质量进行直接的物理解释。随后，提出了一个新的 U(r) 来覆盖整个空间。然后应用该公式以封闭的方式计算类氢原子中的一阶能量变化；这些偏移与高精度光谱数据的比较提供了最大场强参数 b 的模型相关下限。

title: Junction Hook Errors in the Color Code
abstract: Color-dependent syndrome extraction schedules have been proposed to mitigate hook errors in the triangular color code. Recent work by Kishony and Fowler ( arXiv:2603.28852 ) identifies distance-reducing hook errors by the type of anyon for which they provide a shortcut and chooses the CNOT ordering for stabilizers of each color to avoid these errors. We identify an additional class of distance-reducing hooks, which we call junction hook errors, that is not captured by this classification. The two data qubits of a junction hook error terminate anyon strings of two different colors at the point where the three colored strings of a logical operator meet, which we call the junction. As such, the hook error does not correspond to a single type of anyon, yet it still reduces the distance. For distances $d=7,9,11$, we verify that every non-corner plaquette admits a scheduled hook error that, together with $d-2$ single data qubit faults, produces an undetectable logical error using $d-1$ faults. Each of these is a junction hook error. Because of this, every stabilizer, including those in the bulk, still requires additional protection from hook errors (such as flag qubits) to restore the full circuit-level distance with this schedule. A minimum weight logical operator has at most one junction, however, so junction hook errors cannot accumulate on one minimum weight logical operator in the way that single-color malign hook errors can. This helps explain why the schedule still improves the circuit-level distance to $d-\lfloor (d+3)/6\rfloor$, rather than the $d/2$ distance associated with spatially uniform color code scheduling.
summary:
已经提出了颜色相关的综合症提取方案来减轻三角形颜色代码中的钩子错误。 Kishony 和 Fowler 最近的工作 (arXiv:2603.28852) 通过为其提供快捷方式的任意子类型来识别距离减少的钩子错误，并为每种颜色的稳定器选择 CNOT 排序以避免这些错误。我们确定了另一类减少距离的钩子，我们将其称为连接钩子错误，该分类未捕获它。连接钩子错误的两个数据量子位在逻辑运算符的三个颜色字符串相遇的点处终止两种不同颜色的任意子字符串，我们将其称为连接点。因此，钩子误差并不对应于单一类型的任意子，但它仍然会减少距离。对于距离 $d=7,9,11$，我们验证每个非角斑块都承认预定的钩子错误，该错误与 $d-2$ 单数据量子位故障一起，使用 $d-1$ 故障产生不可检测的逻辑错误。其中每一个都是连接钩子错误。

因此，每个稳定器，包括散装稳定器，仍然需要额外的保护以防止钩子错误（例如标志量子位），以恢复此时间表的完整电路级距离。然而，最小权重逻辑运算符至多有一个结点，因此结点钩子错误不能像单色恶性钩子错误那样累积在一个最小权值逻辑运算符上。这有助于解释为什么调度仍然将电路级距离改进为 $d-\lfloor (d+3)/6\rfloor$，而不是与空间统一颜色代码调度相关的 $d/2$ 距离。

title: Semiclassical dynamics of higher-order squeezing: self-adjoint extensions and coherent returns
abstract: Higher-order squeezing Hamiltonians have several self-adjoint realizations, while their classical trajectories reach infinity in finite time. We relate these extension problems through boundary amplitudes and the semiclassical propagation of coherent states. A discrete Fourier transformation gives the sink-to-source ray matrix of each quantum realization. After the first passage through infinity, the full Husimi probability measure converges to point masses on outgoing classical branches, with weights equal to the squared moduli of the matrix entries. The proof combines finite-order approximate tail solutions satisfying the exact extension boundary condition with full-norm Gaussian matching and a square-summable residual estimate. For positive energy, we determine the limit after any fixed number of passages: amplitudes evolve by powers of the unitary ray matrix, not by iterations of its squared-modulus matrix. We also realize these limits by concentrated complex amplitudes for an energy-preserving Liouville extension, distinguishing deterministic classical gluings from coherent boundary mixing.
summary: 高阶压缩哈密顿量有几个自伴实现，而它们的经典轨迹在有限时间内达到无穷大。我们通过边界振幅和相干态的半经典传播来联系这些扩展问题。离散傅立叶变换给出了每个量子实现的从接收器到源的光线矩阵。在第一次穿过无穷大之后，完整的 Husimi 概率度量收敛到传出经典分支上的点质量，其权重等于矩阵条目的平方模。该证明将满足精确扩展边界条件的有限阶近似尾部解与全范数高斯匹配和平方可和残差估计相结合。对于正能量，我们在任何固定数量的通道后确定极限：振幅通过酉射线矩阵的幂演化，而不是通过其平方模矩阵的迭代演化。我们还通过集中复振幅来实现能量守恒刘维尔扩展，从而区分确定性经典粘合和相干边界混合，从而实现这些限制。

title: Decision-aware validation of zero-noise extrapolation in QAOA optimization landscapes
abstract: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) is usually validated by the accuracy of mitigated observables, yet variational quantum optimization uses those observables to select parameters. We ask whether, and by how much, an accuracy gain from ZNE coincides with a worse decision. In depth-one simulations of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for MaxCut on four to six qubits, each sampled $120\times120$ landscape yields both its mean-squared error (MSE) and the ideal regret of its selected grid minimum, comparing Richardson orders one to three with unmitigated estimation at the same total shot budget per grid point. In an exploratory screen of 675 conditions, whose per-point random seeds collide, a familywise (Holm) analysis retains only four of 540 replication conditions as showing both directional MSE improvement and regret increase. A frozen confirmation with 100 fresh paired repetitions per condition reproduces all four: median MSE improvements of 7.65-73.09% accompany median normalized regret increases of only 0.0031-0.0073. We distinguish a bias route, in which residual bias reorders the mean landscape, from a variance route, in which Richardson weights amplify finite-shot noise. Exact first and second moments on a bounded control grid find no bias-route reversal: mitigated mean landscapes preserve the ideal minima, and ZNE can more than halve expected MSE, yet finite-shot selections incur higher mean regret. Decision losses that survive strict testing are few and small in this benchmark, but reproducible and not revealed by aggregate MSE. We present a paired benchmark and recommend reporting decision regret alongside estimation error when mitigation is assessed for optimization. Results concern simulated exhaustive grids, not hardware or optimizer loops.
summary:
零噪声外推 (ZNE) 通常通过减轻的可观测量的准确性来验证，而变分量子优化则使用这些可观测量来选择参数。我们询问 ZNE 的准确度增益是否与更糟糕的决策一致，以及增益有多大。在四到六个量子位上对 MaxCut 的量子近似优化算法 (QAOA) 进行深度一模拟时，每个采样 $120\times120$ 的景观都会产生其均方误差 (MSE) 和其所选网格最小值的理想遗憾，将理查森阶一到三与每个网格点相同总射击预算下的未缓解估计进行比较。在 675 个条件的探索性筛选中，每点随机种子发生碰撞，全族 (Holm) 分析仅保留 540 个复制条件中的 4 个，显示定向 MSE 改善和遗憾增加。每个条件 100 次新鲜配对重复的冻结确认再现了所有四种情况：MSE 中位数提高了 7.65-73.09%，而标准化后悔中位数仅增加了 0.0031-0.0073。

我们区分偏差路线和方差路线，其中残余偏差对平均景观进行重新排序，其中理查森权重放大有限样本噪声。有界控制网格上的精确第一和第二时刻没有发现偏差路线反转：减轻的平均景观保留了理想的最小值，并且 ZNE 可以将预期 MSE 减少一半以上，但有限镜头选择会导致更高的平均遗憾。在此基准测试中，经过严格测试的决策损失很少且很小，但可以重现并且不会被总体 MSE 揭示。我们提出了一个配对基准，并建议在评估缓解措施以进行优化时报告决策遗憾和估计错误。结果涉及模拟的详尽网格，而不是硬件或优化器循环。

title: When is a bosonic operator a Hamiltonian?
abstract: Hermitian polynomials in the quadrature operators $x$ and $p$ are the basic ingredients of continuous-variable quantum information, and increasingly exotic ones are now routinely engineered in superconducting circuits and trapped ions. However, such a polynomial need not define unique quantum dynamics: it may define exactly one, none, or an infinite family of physically distinct ones. Such obstructions are invisible to algebraic arguments and can compromise finite-dimensional truncations, which may fail to converge or silently converge to the wrong dynamics. We develop a method, implemented as an algorithm, which decides which case occurs, and how large the family is, from the coefficients alone, with no functional-analytic input from the user. For Gaussian operators the answer is always one; for non-Gaussian ones, a regime continuous-variable quantum computing cannot do without, the other outcomes occur already for simple and physically natural Hamiltonians. We apply the algorithm to operators drawn from the recent literature.
summary: 求积算子 $x$ 和 $p$ 中的埃尔米特多项式是连续可变量子信息的基本成分，并且现在在超导电路和捕获离子中经常设计越来越奇特的多项式。然而，这样的多项式不需要定义唯一的量子动力学：它可以精确地定义一个、没有或无限个物理上不同的多项式。这些障碍对于代数论证来说是不可见的，并且可能会损害有限维截断，从而可能无法收敛或默默地收敛到错误的动态。我们开发了一种方法，以算法的形式实现，它仅根据系数来决定发生哪种情况以及族的大小，而无需用户进行功能分析输入。对于高斯算子来说，答案总是一；对于非高斯量子计算来说，连续变量量子计算离不开制度，对于简单且物理上自然的哈密顿量来说，其他结果已经出现。我们将该算法应用于从最近文献中提取的运算符。

title: The Coherent State Projection Eigenvalue Theorem
abstract: Recent papers have developed a cyclic symmetry projected extension for coherent state representations of bosonic Hilbert space. This extension can greatly reduce sampling errors in phase-space simulations of bosonic quantum systems that have symmetries. Here we prove an eigenvalue theorem for the continuum limit of the projected coherent states. Our intuitively appealing result is that in the continuum limit the projected coherent states are eigenstates of the symmetry generating operator. This result gives a differential identity in phase-space that includes the conserved eigenvalues. Detailed applications of these differential identities to obtaining improved Fokker-Planck and stochastic equations in many-body physics will be given elsewhere.
summary: 最近的论文开发了玻色希尔伯特空间的相干态表示的循环对称投影扩展。这种扩展可以大大减少具有对称性的玻色子量子系统的相空间模拟中的采样误差。在这里，我们证明了投影相干态的连续极限的特征值定理。我们直观上吸引人的结果是，在连续极限中，投影相干态是对称生成算子的本征态。该结果给出了相空间中的微分恒等式，其中包括保守的特征值。这些微分恒等式在多体物理学中获得改进的福克-普朗克方程和随机方程的详细应用将在别处给出。

title: Path-Distinguishability Gaps at Fixed Visibility in Noisy Qubit Interferometers
abstract: The wave--particle duality relation bounds visibility and path distinguishability but does not determine their attainable values in a fixed noisy interferometer. We characterize the complete attainable region for a two-path interferometer with a qubit marker, varying the marker input while fixing the source, preparation channel, path-dependent interaction, and subsequent marker channel. At each feasible fringe visibility, the Helstrom-optimal distinguishabilities form at most two closed intervals, which can be separated by a gap. The intervals arise from opposite axial marker polarizations with the same fringe-amplitude modulus. Fixing the complex fringe amplitude instead gives a connected interval; for balanced original-path discrimination, a gap requires nonunital marker preparation. For a balanced pure source, relative $\pi$ rotations, and no subsequent marker noise, we obtain a necessary and sufficient geometric criterion for a gap under some rotation axis perpendicular to the preparation displacement. Explicit channels and a time-independent Lindblad realization show how the gap depends on preparation geometry and evolution, with exact onset and optimization formulas at fixed fractional visibility. We also give sufficient bounds for excluding distinguishability intervals under calibrated finite-resolution errors.
summary:
波粒二象性关系限制了可见性和路径可区分性，但并不能确定它们在固定噪声干涉仪中可达到的值。我们描述了带有量子位标记的两路干涉仪的完整可达到区域，在固定源、制备通道、路径相关的相互作用和后续标记通道的同时改变标记输入。在每个可行的条纹可见度处，赫尔斯特罗姆最优区分度最多形成两个闭合区间，这两个区间可以由间隙分隔开。这些间隔由具有相同条纹幅度模量的相反轴向标记偏振产生。固定复数条纹幅度，而是给出一个连通区间；为了平衡原始路径区分，间隙需要非单位标记准备。对于平衡的纯源、相对 $\pi$ 旋转以及没有后续标记噪声，我们获得了垂直于制备位移的某个旋转轴下的间隙的必要且充分的几何标准。

显式通道和与时间无关的 Lindblad 实现显示了间隙如何取决于制备几何形状和演化，并在固定分数可见性下具有精确的起始和优化公式。我们还给出了足够的界限来排除校准有限分辨率误差下的可区分区间。

title: Efficient Block Encodings of Vibrational Hamiltonians
abstract: Simulation of molecular vibrations is emerging as a promising application of quantum computing in quantum chemistry. In this work, we develop new strategies for block-encoding the second-quantized $n$-mode representation of the vibrational Hamiltonian, whose algebraic structure closely parallels that of the second-quantized electronic Hamiltonian. We derive linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) representations of this Hamiltonian based on Pauli decomposition and tensor hypercontraction (THC) and construct efficient circuits for the corresponding block encodings. We also extend the Block-Invariant Symmetry Shift (BLISS) technique to vibrational Hamiltonians, yielding a lower LCU 1-norm and, consequently, a lower overall circuit cost. For the molecules considered here, BLISS-THC reduces the Toffoli cost of quantum phase estimation by more than two orders of magnitude relative to existing block-encoding approaches. In comparison with recent Trotter-based methods, it shows up to a ninefold reduction in the T-gate count, with the relative savings tending to increase with system size. Asymptotically, and up to polylogarithmic factors, both the Pauli and THC LCUs trade additional ancillas for a quadratic improvement in scaling with the number of modes, while THC provides an additional quadratic improvement in scaling with the number of modals. These results highlight the importance of Hamiltonian factorizations and Toffoli-qubit tradeoffs for reducing the computational cost of quantum simulations of molecular vibrations.
summary:
分子振动模拟正在成为量子计算在量子化学中的一个有前途的应用。在这项工作中，我们开发了对振动哈密顿量的第二量化 $n$ 模式表示进行块编码的新策略，其代数结构与第二量化电子哈密顿量的代数结构非常相似。我们基于泡利分解和张量超收缩（THC）推导了该哈密顿量的线性组合酉（LCU）表示，并为相应的块编码构建了有效的电路。我们还将块不变对称移位 (BLISS) 技术扩展到振动哈密顿量，产生更低的 LCU 1-范数，从而降低总体电路成本。对于这里考虑的分子，BLISS-THC 相对于现有的块编码方法将量子相位估计的 Toffoli 成本降低了两个数量级以上。与最近基于 Trotter 的方法相比，它的 T 门数量减少了九倍，而且相对节省量往往随着系统规模的增加而增加。

渐近地，直到多对数因子，Pauli 和 THC LCU 都用额外的辅助来换取模态数量缩放方面的二次改进，而 THC 提供了模态数量缩放方面的额外二次改进。这些结果凸显了哈密顿因式分解和 Toffoli 量子位权衡对于降低分子振动量子模拟的计算成本的重要性。

title: Initial-State Preparation for Strongly Correlated Molecules from Matrix Product States: Benchmarking and Environment-Aware Divide-and-Conquer Compilation
abstract: Compiling classically optimized matrix product states (MPSs) into quantum circuits is a promising route to initial-state preparation for strongly correlated molecules, but the accuracy, gate cost, and classical scalability of existing MPS compilation methods have not been systematically assessed. Here, we benchmark representative analytical, variational, and hybrid MPS compilation methods for strongly correlated systems including hydrogen chains and iron-sulfur clusters. We compare state infidelity, CNOT gate count, classical runtime, and parallel scalability across different system sizes and bond dimensions. We also introduce a divide-and-conquer environment-aware compilation algorithm (DCE), which optimizes each local isometry approximation according to its contribution to the prepared-state fidelity. The results reveal complementary operating regimes: direct variational compilation methods are gate-efficient for some smaller molecular systems with $O(10)$ qubits and $O(10)$ bond dimensions or moderate accuracy targets with infidelity of order $10^{-1}$, whereas divide-and-conquer methods scale more favorably for larger systems and relatively higher bond dimensions of $O(10\text{-}10^2)$, particularly when target infidelities below $10^{-1}$ are required. Within the latter family, environment-aware optimization improves accuracy over unitary-distance-based compilation while retaining task-level parallelism. For the FeMo-cofactor (FeMoco), we find the DCE algorithm together with the MPS obtained in the entanglement-minimized orbitals (EMOs) provides a resource-efficient route to initial-state preparation. Our results provide practical guidance for selecting and developing MPS compilation methods for strongly correlated molecular simulations.
summary:
将经典优化的矩阵乘积态 (MPS) 编译到量子电路中是强相关分子初始态制备的一条有前途的途径，但现有 MPS 编译方法的准确性、门成本和经典可扩展性尚未得到系统评估。在这里，我们对强相关系统（包括氢链和铁硫簇）的代表性分析、变分和混合 MPS 编译方法进行了基准测试。我们比较了不同系统规模和键维度的状态不忠、CNOT 门数、经典运行时间和并行可扩展性。我们还引入了分而治之的环境感知编译算法（DCE），该算法根据每个局部等距近似对准备状态保真度的贡献来优化它。

结果揭示了互补的操作机制：直接变分编译方法对于具有 $O(10)$ 量子位和 $O(10)$ 键维度或不忠度为 $10^{-1}$ 的中等精度目标的较小分子系统具有门效率，而分而治之方法对于较大系统和 $O(10\text{-}10^2)$ 相对较高的键维度更有利，特别是当目标不忠度低于以下时需要 10^{-1}$。在后一个系列中，环境感知优化提高了基于单一距离的编译的准确性，同时保留了任务级并行性。对于 FeMo 辅因子 (FeMoco)，我们发现 DCE 算法与在纠缠最小化轨道 (EMO) 中获得的 MPS 一起提供了一条资源高效的初始状态准备途径。我们的结果为选择和开发强相关分子模拟的 MPS 编译方法提供了实用指导。

title: Helstrom geometry with time-dependent spectral calibration
