abstract: In a recent work we introduced a finite scalar-qubit-scalar spectral triple whose Connes distance reproduces the Bloch-ball trace metric up to a factor $2/\Lambda$, where $\Lambda^2=\mu_L^2+\mu_R^2$ for isotropic link strengths $\mu_L,\mu_R$ appearing in the proposed Dirac operator. Here we analyse time-dependent variation of these links, independent of the qubit dynamics. In doing so, we separate the distinguishability and calibration contributions to the spectral rate. A depolarizing example demonstrates spectral growth despite a monotonic contraction of the trace-distance. More generally, we characterize the admissible trace-distance histories compatible with a given positive spectral record and exhibit contracting and reviving realizations. At fixed $\Lambda$, we also study a sinusoidal link imbalance that preserves the Dirac spectrum and qubit metric, while the scalar-scalar distance oscillates with half the period of the imbalance.
summary: 在最近的一项工作中，我们引入了一种有限标量-量子位-标量谱三元组，其 Connes 距离将布洛赫球迹度量再现为 $2/\Lambda$ 因子，其中 $\Lambda^2=\mu_L^2+\mu_R^2$ 表示提出的狄拉克算子中出现的各向同性链接强度 $\mu_L,\mu_R$。在这里，我们分析这些链接随时间变化的变化，与量子位动态无关。在此过程中，我们将可区分性和校准对光谱率的贡献分开。去极化示例表明，尽管迹线距离单调收缩，光谱仍会增长。更一般地说，我们描述了与给定的正光谱记录兼容的可接受的迹线距离历史，并展示了收缩和恢复的实现。在固定的 $\Lambda$ 下，我们还研究了一种正弦链路不平衡，它保留了狄拉克谱和量子位度量，而标量-标量距离以不平衡周期的一半振荡。

title: Quantum neuroplastic learning for time-series processing
abstract: Quantum machine learning uses quantum states and dynamics to represent and process data. In quantum reservoir computing, the physical system is typically fixed and a classical readout is trained. Inspired by the formation, strengthening and pruning of synapses during biological learning, we propose quantum neuroplastic learning (QNL), which reorganizes the couplings among the qubits of a quantum reservoir, much as experience rewires connections among neurons. Eligibility traces guide local edits to couplings, fields, gate angles and evolution time, and an edit is retained when a statistical bound on its improvement exceeds a complexity cost. We evaluate QNL under restarting and online monitored protocols on short- and long-term memory, nonlinear autoregressive processing and forecasting, and channel equalization tasks. In simulation, QNL enhances memory capacity, develops long-term recall and sustains adaptation across multiple tasks, with the largest benefit for tasks that require extended memory. On the IBM superconducting processor \texttt{ibm\_fez}, with six seven-qubit reservoirs running in parallel on 42 qubits (1.28 million shots in total), configurations learned in simulation and frozen before execution reduced the channel-equalization symbol error rate from 9.7\% to 2.2\% and achieved a lower error rate than a matched-budget tuned baseline.
summary:
量子机器学习使用量子态和动力学来表示和处理数据。在量子储层计算中，物理系统通常是固定的，并且训练经典读数。受到生物学习过程中突触形成、强化和修剪的启发，我们提出了量子神经可塑性学习（QNL），它可以重新组织量子库的量子位之间的耦合，就像经验重新连接神经元之间的连接一样。资格跟踪指导对耦合、场、门角度和演化时间进行本地编辑，并且当其改进的统计界限超过复杂性成本时，编辑将被保留。我们在短期和长期记忆、非线性自回归处理和预测以及通道均衡任务的重启和在线监控协议下评估 QNL。在模拟中，QNL 增强了记忆容量，发展了长期回忆并维持了跨多个任务的适应，其中对于需要扩展记忆的任务来说效果最大。

在 IBM 超导处理器 \texttt{ibm\_fez} 上，有 6 个七量子位存储库在 42 个量子位上并行运行（总共 128 万次发射），在模拟中学习并在执行前冻结的配置将通道均衡符号错误率从 9.7% 降低到 2.2%，并且实现了比匹配预算调整基线更低的错误率。

title: Two exact quantum queries use at most six variables
abstract: We give a direct analytic proof that every total Boolean function computable exactly with at most two quantum queries depends on at most six input variables. This bound is sharp. A previous derivation relied on a numerical classification of Boolean functions on at most four variables; to the best of our knowledge, ours is the first unconditional proof. The main difficulty beyond the one-query case is that query-path vectors need not be mutually orthogonal, so interference prevents the scalar weight-counting argument from applying. We overcome this difficulty by establishing a rigid support-and-branch decomposition: after the coordinates in the first-query support are fixed, the second query induces a family of exact one-query branches. This structural description may be of independent interest.
summary: 我们给出了一个直接的分析证明，即每个可通过最多两个量子查询精确计算的总布尔函数取决于最多六个输入变量。这个界限是尖锐的。先前的推导依赖于最多四个变量的布尔函数的数值分类；据我们所知，我们的这是第一个无条件的证据。超出单查询情况的主要困难是查询路径向量不需要相互正交，因此干扰会阻止标量权重计数参数的应用。我们通过建立严格的支持和分支分解来克服这个困难：在第一个查询支持中的坐标固定后，第二个查询产生一系列精确的单查询分支。该结构描述可能具有独立的意义。

title: A Reduction Bound for Entanglement Detection by Positive Free Maps
abstract: Collins, Hayden, and Nechita used free probability to construct families of $k$-positive but not $(k+1)$-positive maps and applied them to entanglement detection. We prove that positive free maps associated with compactly supported freely infinitely divisible distributions are no stronger than the reduction criterion in every ancillary dimension. In particular, these maps cannot detect positive partial transpose entanglement. The proof combines a joint Fock realization with an operator positivity certificate derived from free Lévy data.
summary: Collins、Hayden 和 Nechita 使用自由概率构建了 $k$-正图族，但不是 $(k+1)$-正图，并将其应用于纠缠检测。我们证明与紧支撑的自由无限可分分布相关的正自由映射并不强于每个辅助维度的简化标准。特别是，这些图无法检测正部分转置纠缠。该证明结合了 Fock 的联合实现和源自免费 Lévy 数据的操作员积极性证书。

title: Pauli-ball discrepancy and stability of quantum codes
abstract: The Pauli-ball discrepancy, a quadratic discrepancy summed over all error radii, measures how uniformly the Pauli error images of a $K$-dimensional quantum code cover the $d$-dimensional Hilbert space. At parameters attaining equality in the quantum Singleton bound with minimum code distance $\geq3$, or in the one-error Hamming bound with prime-power local dimension, the discrepancy of every projector of the prescribed rank equals an explicit benchmark plus an exact nonnegative remainder, which vanishes precisely for pure quantum maximum-distance-separable codes and nondegenerate perfect codes, respectively. For a Pauli ball of radius $e$ below half the target distance and size $V_e$, this remainder linearly bounds the squared Hilbert--Schmidt distance of the error-image Gram matrix from the identity. When $KV_e\leq d$, it linearly bounds the diamond error and entanglement infidelity of a noise-independent polar recovery under any noise in that ball's span. For five qubits, we obtain the sharp rank-two Gram constant and exact logical channels of rotated codes attaining this linear order in diamond error. For pure states, the discrepancy equals a pure-state benchmark plus a positive weighted sum of marginal-purity defects, so absolutely maximally entangled states, when they exist, are exactly the minimizers.
summary:
泡利球差异是所有误差半径求和的二次差异，衡量 $K$ 维量子代码的泡利误差图像覆盖 $d$ 维希尔伯特空间的均匀程度。当参数在具有最小码距 $\geq3$ 的量子单例界中或在具有素数幂局部维数的一错误汉明界中达到相等时，规定秩的每个投影仪的差异等于一个显式基准加上一个精确的非负余数，对于纯量子最大距离可分离码和非简并完美码来说，该余数分别精确地消失。对于半径 $e$ 低于目标距离一半且大小 $V_e$ 的泡利球，该余数线性限制误差图像 Gram 矩阵与恒等式的平方希尔伯特-施密特距离。当 $KV_e\leq d$ 时，它线性限制了在该球跨度内的任何噪声下与噪声无关的极性恢复的菱形误差和纠缠不保真度。对于五个量子位，我们获得了尖锐的二阶格拉姆常数和旋转代码的精确逻辑通道，以达到菱形误差的线性顺序。

对于纯态，差异等于纯态基准加上边际纯度缺陷的正加权和，因此绝对最大纠缠态（当它们存在时）恰好是最小化器。

title: Bosonic Loss Codes with Bounded Occupation
abstract: We study Fock-state codes on $q$ bosonic modes, with total excitation $N$ and at most $B$ excitations per mode, that exactly correct every pattern of at most $\delta N$ photon losses, for $q$ proportional to $N$. For every fixed cap $B$ and every ratio $q/N>1/B$, we prove explicit achievable rates, positive for all sufficiently small $\delta>0$, in logical qubits per excitation. At $B=2$ and $q=N$, the rate is positive for every $\delta<0.1355$ and is about $0.281$ at $\delta=0.1$, compared with the previously established exact-code qutrit rate of about $0.275$. We also give an explicit upper bound on the dimension of every such exact code, including degenerate codes. For the pure-loss channel truncated to at most $\delta N$ losses and renormalized, we obtain approximate codes with exponentially small worst-case error. When the loss probability is positive and at most $1/(B+1)$, they improve our positive exact-code rate bounds; at $B=2$, $q=N$, and loss probability $0.1$, they remain positive up to $\delta\approx0.158$.
summary: 我们研究了 $q$ 玻色子模式的福克状态码，每个模式的总激励为 $N$，最多为 $B$ 激励，这完全纠正了最多 $\delta N$ 光子损失的每种模式，其中 $q$ 与 $N$ 成正比。对于每个固定上限 $B$ 和每个比率 $q/N>1/B$，我们证明了明确的可实现速率，对于所有足够小的 $\delta>0$ 为正，以每次激励的逻辑量子位为单位。在 $B=2$ 和 $q=N$ 时，每 $\delta<0.1355$ 的利率都是正值，在 $\delta=0.1$ 时利率约为 $0.281$，而之前建立的精确代码 qutrit 利率约为 $0.275$。我们还为每个此类精确代码（包括简并代码）的维度给出了明确的上限。对于截断至至多 $\delta N$ 损失并重新归一化的纯损失通道，我们获得了最坏情况误差指数较小的近似代码。当损失概率为正且至多 $1/(B+1)$ 时，它们会提高我们的正精确码率界限；在 $B=2$、$q=N$ 和损失概率为 $0.1$ 时，它们在 $\delta\approx0.158$ 之前保持正值。

title: Emergent Recursive Kernels in Quantum Reservoir Computing
abstract: Learning with a quantum reservoir can be far simpler than simulating its dynamics. We show that a quantum reservoir governed by a fixed evolution, consisting of an input coupling followed by an independently sampled Haar unitary, admits an exact recursive kernel in the large-dimension limit at fixed history length. Memory orthogonality and factorization of propagated overlaps reduce each kernel evaluation to a scalar recurrence, linear in history length and independent of reservoir size. We establish self-averaging around this limit and connect the kernel coefficients to out-of-time-ordered correlators. Our analysis of finite-dimensional effects shows that the computational simplicity of the Haar kernel does not come at the expense of expressive power. Moreover, we demonstrate how the kernel can be tuned for different learning tasks by adjusting properties such as memory retention and temporal interaction order. On the NARMA10 benchmark, the tuned kernel achieves lower prediction error than the tested Ising and Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev reservoirs.
summary: 使用量子库进行学习比模拟其动力学要简单得多。我们证明了由固定演化控制的量子库，由输入耦合和独立采样的哈尔酉组成，在固定历史长度的大维极限中允许精确的递归核。内存正交性和传播重叠的因式分解将每个内核评估减少为标量递归，历史长度呈线性且与储层大小无关。我们围绕这个限制建立自平均，并将内核系数连接到乱序相关器。我们对有限维效应的分析表明，Haar 核的计算简单性并不以牺牲表达能力为代价。此外，我们还演示了如何通过调整记忆保留和时间交互顺序等属性来调整内核以适应不同的学习任务。在 NARMA10 基准上，调整后的内核比测试的 Ising 和 Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 水库实现了更低的预测误差。

title: Ancilla-free optimal quantum adder
abstract: We construct an exact $n$-bit quantum adder with $O(n)$ gates and $O(\log n)$ depth that requires no ancillary qubits. The circuit uses only $X$, CNOT, and Toffoli gates under all-to-all connectivity and is classically reversible. Our construction accelerates the controlled ladder underlying addition. Grouping the data into blocks and use existing control qubits as conditional workspace gives a recursive construction with $O(n\log\log n)$ gates and $O(\log n)$ depth. We then coordinate inter-block propagation via two short-path forest operations to cut the per-block workspace requirement, yielding a nonrecursive implementation with $O(n)$ gates. Both the gate count and circuit depth are asymptotically optimal.
summary: 我们构造了一个精确的 $n$ 位量子加法器，具有 $O(n)$ 门和 $O(\log n)$ 深度，不需要辅助量子位。该电路在全对全连接下仅使用 $X$、CNOT 和 Toffoli 门，并且是经典可逆的。我们的构造加速了底层添加的受控梯子。将数据分组为块并使用现有的控制量子位作为条件工作区，提供具有 $O(n\log\log n)$ 门和 $O(\log n)$ 深度的递归构造。然后，我们通过两个短路径森林操作来协调块间传播，以减少每个块的工作空间要求，从而产生具有 $O(n)$ 门的非递归实现。门数和电路深度都是渐近最优的。

title: Path integral control in the complex plane
abstract: Path integral control is a stochastic optimal control framework that computes optimal policies as weighted averages over state trajectories. It was recently shown that, combined with stochastic quantum trajectories, the path integral control approach constitutes a promising alternative for quantum optimal control. In this work, we propose an extension of path integral control to the complex plane using circular complex Wiener processes. The change of measure is defined on the driving noise space under an exact control-noise matching condition, which also accommodates rank-deficient state diffusions. Applied to stochastic Schrödinger equations, the resulting formalism gives a compact treatment of paired non-Hermitian jump channels with unequal positive dissipation rates and yields cross-entropy-optimal feedback and open-loop control formulas.
summary: 路径积分控制是一种随机最优控制框架，它将最优策略计算为状态轨迹的加权平均值。最近的研究表明，与随机量子轨迹相结合，路径积分控制方法构成了量子最优控制的一种有前途的替代方法。在这项工作中，我们提出使用圆形复维纳过程将路径积分控制扩展到复平面。测量的变化是在精确的控制噪声匹配条件下在驱动噪声空间上定义的，这也适应了秩亏状态扩散。应用于随机薛定谔方程，由此产生的形式给出了具有不等正耗散率的成对非厄米跳跃通道的紧凑处理，并产生交叉熵最优反馈和开环控制公式。

title: Model-Uncertainty-Aware Digital Twins for Non-Markovian Quantum Repeater Memories
abstract: Quantum-repeater controllers need reliable estimates of stored entanglement as adjacent links are generated. Fixed exponential lifetimes miss non-Markovian revivals, while complex surrogates are unnecessary when the microscopic family is known. We present QMemTwin, a physics-constrained digital twin that accounts for model uncertainty. It calibrates a bank of contractive passive state-space models, combines their amplitudes with finite-sample-corrected Akaike weights, and abstains when temporal-holdout data indicate unsupported dynamics. Passivity guarantees a completely positive, trace-preserving amplitude-damping channel for each candidate and their convex amplitude average. We evaluate [N cases] synthetic memories: [N supported] supported passive time-invariant cases and [N structural] nonstationary structural-shift cases. In the matched one-pseudomode regime, the correctly specified one-pseudomode fit performs best. Across [N unknown] supported cases with uncertain families, QMemTwin reduces population RMSE by [population reduction]% and Bell-fidelity RMSE by [Bell reduction]% relative to the two-pseudomode model; both paired effects remain significant after Holm correction. The flexible passive model has a slightly lower mean error for unknown families but is statistically indistinguishable from QMemTwin and loses accuracy in the matched regime. The temporal-holdout gate detects [detection]% of structural shifts, with [false alarm]% false alarms on supported families and AUROC [AUC]. In 2-, 4-, and 8-link repeater chains, the mixed cohort shows no significant 8-link goodput gain. A predeclared high-backflow stress cohort yields an 8-link goodput gain of [goodput gain]% over the two-pseudomode model, with paired p = [p value]. These results favor using a known family when available, accounting for model uncertainty otherwise and abstaining on unsupported dynamics.
summary:
量子中继器控制器需要在生成相邻链路时对存储的纠缠进行可靠的估计。固定指数寿命会错过非马尔可夫复兴，而当微观家族已知时，复杂的替代物是不必要的。我们推出了 QMemTwin，一种物理约束的数字孪生，可以解释模型的不确定性。它校准一系列收缩被动状态空间模型，将其幅度与有限样本校正的 Akaike 权重相结合，并在时间保留数据表明不受支持的动态时放弃。无源性保证每个候选者及其凸振幅平均值具有完全正的、保留迹线的振幅阻尼通道。我们评估[N个案例]合成记忆：[N个支持]支持被动时不变案例和[N个结构]非平稳结构转变案例。在匹配的一伪模态中，正确指定的一伪模拟合表现最好。在具有不确定家庭的 [N 个未知] 支持案例中，相对于二伪模模型，QMemTwin 将总体 RMSE 降低了 [总体减少]%，将贝尔保真 RMSE 降低了 [贝尔减少]%；霍尔姆校正后，这两种配对效应仍然显着。

灵活的被动模型对于未知族的平均误差略低，但在统计上与 QMemTwin 无法区分，并且在匹配机制中失去了准确性。时间保留门检测[检测]％的结构变化，对受支持的家庭和AUROC [AUC]有[错误警报]％的错误警报。在 2、4 和 8 链路中继器链中，混合队列没有显示出显着的 8 链路吞吐量增益。预先声明的高回流压力队列产生的 8 链路有效输出增益超过两伪模模型的 [有效输出增益]%，其中配对 p = [p 值]。这些结果倾向于使用已知的族（如果可用），否则会考虑模型的不确定性，并放弃不受支持的动态。

title: Quantum ordinal selection with two comparisons
abstract: We study the optimal probability of selecting an object within a prescribed rank threshold using at most two noiseless coherent pairwise comparisons of an unknown strict order. Polynomial degree bounds alone can overestimate the success attainable with two comparisons. We develop a comparison-specific semidefinite model that completely characterizes attainable success. Computer-assisted proofs establish the exact optimum for every rank threshold at seven objects and for minimum selection at eight. For minimum selection, we construct an explicit algorithm family and determine its exact optimum. Bounds for all admissible two-comparison algorithms show that the family's asymptotic success is within 0.016% of the unrestricted optimum. We also prove that this relative gap has a strictly positive limit. The optimal quantum-to-classical success ratio for minimum selection converges to approximately 2.48 under the same two-comparison budget.
summary: 我们使用最多两个未知严格顺序的无噪声相干成对比较来研究在规定的等级阈值内选择对象的最佳概率。仅多项式次数界限就可能高估两次比较所能取得的成功。我们开发了一个特定于比较的半定模型，该模型完全描述了可达到的成功。计算机辅助证明为七个对象的每个等级阈值和八个对象的最小选择建立了精确的最佳值。对于最小选择，我们构建了一个显式算法族并确定其确切的最优值。所有可接受的两次比较算法的界限表明，该系列的渐近成功率在无限制最优值的 0.016% 以内。我们还证明了这种相对差距有一个严格的正极限。在相同的两次比较预算下，最小选择的最佳量子与经典成功率收敛到大约 2.48。

title: Modulation and protection of entanglement in a two-qubit system via two interacting oscillator control
abstract: We investigate the control and protection of two-qubit entanglement through engineered interactions between two auxiliary harmonic oscillators. Each qubit is coupled to a local oscillator via a dephasing interaction, while the oscillators interact through independently tunable position-position and momentum-momentum couplings. Employing the characteristic-function representation, we obtain analytical solutions for the composite-system dynamics and examine how the stability properties of the coupled oscillators determine the evolution of two-qubit concurrence. Our analysis reveals distinct dynamical regimes exhibiting entanglement revivals, suppression, or decay, and identifies configurations in which oscillator interactions effectively reduce entanglement degradation. We further investigate the influence of thermal dissipation using local and global master-equation descriptions, demonstrating that suitable oscillator couplings can preserve substantial two-qubit entanglement under the dissipative conditions considered. These results establish a connection between the dynamical stability of auxiliary bosonic modes and the controllability of entanglement in discrete-variable quantum systems, providing a potential strategy for entanglement protection through engineered oscillator interactions.
summary:
我们通过两个辅助谐振子之间的工程相互作用研究了两个量子位纠缠的控制和保护。每个量子位通过相移相互作用耦合到本地振荡器，而振荡器通过独立可调的位置-位置和动量-动量耦合相互作用。利用特征函数表示，我们获得了复合系统动力学的解析解，并研究了耦合振荡器的稳定性特性如何决定两个量子位并发的演化。我们的分析揭示了表现出纠缠复兴、抑制或衰减的不同动力学机制，并确定了振荡器相互作用有效减少纠缠退化的配置。我们使用局部和全局主方程描述进一步研究热耗散的影响，证明合适的振荡器耦合可以在考虑的耗散条件下保持大量的两个量子位纠缠。

这些结果在离散变量量子系统中辅助玻色子模式的动态稳定性与纠缠的可控性之间建立了联系，为通过工程振荡器相互作用进行纠缠保护提供了潜在的策略。

title: Membership in the cone of quantum states over time is NP-hard
abstract: A state over time (stote) pairs a state $\rho$ with a channel $\mathcal{E}$ as the Hermitian, generally non-positive operator $(\rho\otimes\mathbf{1})\star J_\mathcal{E}$. Characterizing the convex cone $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$ these operators generate was posed as an open problem in~\cite{HoogstederCalsamigliaWinter2025}. We exhibit a linear copy of the bipartite separable cone as an exposed face of $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$: for output systems of the form $B = A'R$ with $A'$ a copy of the input, there is an explicit witness $W_0\in\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}^*$ and an explicit injective linear map $L$ with $\sigma\in \mathrm{SEP}_{+}(A{:}R)\iff L(\sigma)\in\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}(A{:}A'R)$. Composing with the NP-hardness of separability shows that exact membership, weak membership, and weak optimization are NP-hard for $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$ and its dual. A quantitative stability bound makes the weak-membership reduction valid at inverse-polynomial accuracy. Thus polynomial-time membership tests do not exist unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$. Independently of this complexity assumption, Fawzi's theorem implies that $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}(A{:}A'R)$ admits no finite semidefinite representation when $d=\dim A\ge2$, $r=\dim R\ge2$, and $d+r>5$.
summary:
随时间变化的状态 (stote) 将状态 $\rho$ 与通道 $\mathcal{E}$ 配对作为 Hermitian，通常为非正运算符 $(\rho\otimes\mathbf{1})\star J_\mathcal{E}$。表征这些算子生成的凸锥 $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$ 被作为~\cite{HoogstederCalsamigliaWinter2025} 中的一个开放问题提出。我们将二分可分离锥体的线性副本展示为 $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$ 的暴露面：对于 $B = A'R$ 形式的输出系统，其中 $A'$ 是输入的副本，有一个显式见证 $W_0\in\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}^*$ 和一个显式单射线性映射 $L$ 与 $\sigma\in \mathrm{SEP}_{+}(A{:}R)\iff L(\sigma)\in\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}(A{:}A'R)$。与可分离性的 NP 难度相结合表明，对于 $\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}$ 及其对偶来说，精确隶属度、弱隶属度和弱优化都是 NP 困难的。定量稳定性界限使得弱隶属度约简在逆多项式精度下有效。因此，除非 $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$，否则多项式时间隶属度检验不存在。

独立于这种复杂性假设，Fawzi 定理意味着当 $d=\dim A\ge2$、$r=\dim R\ge2$ 和 $d+r>5$ 时，$\widehat{\mathcal{Q}}(A{:}A'R)$ 不承认有限半定表示。

title: Complete characterization of internal-external entanglement trade-offs in two-mode Gaussian states
abstract: We characterize the exact trade-off between internal and external entanglement in asymmetric two-mode Gaussian states at fixed local symplectic eigenvalues. Internal entanglement is quantified by the negativity $\mathcal{N}_{A:B}$ between the two modes, while external entanglement is quantified by the negativity $\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD}$ across a Gaussian purification. Numerical sampling suggests the boundary structure of the attainable region in the $(\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD},\mathcal{N}_{A:B})$ plane, which we then determine analytically. Parametrizing the global symplectic spectrum yields a closed admissible interval for the remaining spectral parameter at fixed $\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD}$. We prove constructively that every point in this interval corresponds to a physical covariance matrix, implying that all intermediate values of $\mathcal{N}_{A:B}$ between the resulting sharp bounds are achievable. The upper bound is attained for opposite-sign correlations of equal magnitude, while the positive branch of the lower bound occurs when one global symplectic eigenvalue equals unity. We also identify two external-entanglement thresholds, derive a saturated monogamy-type inequality, and recover the symmetric-state limit.
summary:
我们描述了固定局部辛特征值下非对称二模高斯态的内部和外部纠缠之间的精确权衡。内部纠缠由两种模式之间的负性 $\mathcal{N}_{A:B}$ 量化，而外部纠缠由高斯纯化过程中的负性 $\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD}$ 量化。数值采样建议 $(\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD},\mathcal{N}_{A:B})$ 平面中可达到区域的边界结构，然后我们通过分析确定该边界结构。参数化全局辛谱会在固定的 $\mathcal{N}_{AB:CD}$ 处产生剩余谱参数的闭合容许区间。我们建设性地证明，该区间中的每个点都对应于一个物理协方差矩阵，这意味着所得到的尖锐边界之间的 $\mathcal{N}_{A:B}$ 的所有中间值都是可以实现的。上界是在等量级的相反符号相关性下获得的，而下界的正分支是在一个全局辛特征值等于 1 时出现的。

我们还确定了两个外部纠缠阈值，推导饱和一夫一妻型不等式，并恢复对称状态极限。

title: Basis-set error bounds for first-quantised quantum simulation of chemistry
abstract: In quantum simulation of electronic structure it is often expected that the estimate of the ground energy converges to the continuum basis limit at a rate of $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ for a basis of size $N$. This has been found in analytical and numerical studies, but without a rigorous treatment of the error in the quantities considered in quantum algorithms. Here we show the $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ scaling of the error for a wide range of cases needed for quantum simulation of chemistry. We show the error in the ground energy scales as $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ for plane-wave as well as spatial grid bases. For the spatial grid we consider both a periodic system and a non-periodic system with open boundaries. For time evolution, our bound on the error in the state itself is weaker than $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$, but we show that the error in observables scales as $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1})$ in important cases. In particular, we may consider a smoothed observable that describes the position of particles. We show that this error scales as $\mathcal O(N^{-5/3}+tN^{-1})$ for time $t$, again both for plane-wave and spatial grid bases. For the non-periodic grid case we use a condition that the true evolution would not result in significant leakage past the boundaries, which introduces basis error unrelated to the resolution of the discretisation. We also show the error in the kinetic energy of a particle scales as $\mathcal O((t+\log N)/N)$ for the plane-wave and grid bases. Together, these results show that $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ scaling of the error holds for many of the relevant cases for quantum algorithms (with a trivial log factor for kinetic energy).
summary:
在电子结构的量子模拟中，通常期望对于大小为 $N$ 的基础，地面能量的估计以 $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ 的速率收敛到连续介质基础极限。这已经在分析和数值研究中发现，但没有对量子算法中考虑的数量误差进行严格处理。在这里，我们展示了化学量子模拟所需的各种情况下的 $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ 误差缩放。我们将平面波和空间网格基础的地面能量尺度误差显示为 $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$。对于空间网格，我们考虑具有开放边界的周期系统和非周期系统。对于时间演化，我们对状态本身误差的界限弱于 $\mathcal O(N^{-1})$，但我们表明，在重要情况下，可观测值的误差按 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1})$ 缩放。特别是，我们可以考虑描述粒子位置的平滑可观测量。我们表明，对于时间 $t$，该误差的缩放比例为 $\mathcal O(N^{-5/3}+tN^{-1})$，同样适用于平面波和空间网格基。

对于非周期性网格情况，我们使用的条件是真实演化不会导致超出边界的显着泄漏，这会引入与离散化分辨率无关的基础误差。我们还将平面波和网格基础上的粒子动能误差表示为 $\mathcal O((t+\log N)/N)$。总之，这些结果表明，$\mathcal O(N^{-1})$ 误差缩放对于量子算法的许多相关情况都成立（动能的对数因子很小）。

title: Quantum-Classical Framework for the Joint Optimization of Bidirectional EV Charging and Trip Assignment
abstract: The integration of bidirectional (V2G) charging allows electric vehicle (EV) fleets to operate as distributed energy assets. However, the joint optimization of charging schedules and trip assignments is NP-hard. Moreover, bidirectional power flows create non-monotonic state-of-charge (SoC) dynamics that weaken standard dual-based Benders cuts. We propose a hybrid quantum-classical Benders decomposition framework. To overcome the qubit overhead associated with encoding feasibility cuts, we introduce logic-based conflict cuts, which require near-zero auxiliary qubits. Furthermore, we develop a sparse recursive SoC formulation that reduces the constraint-matrix density by a factor of T/3 in the horizon length T. We demonstrate that our framework recovers MILP-optimal solutions on benchmark instances with a low auxiliary-qubit budget, and, as a minimal proof of concept, we execute a small instance end-to-end on IBM quantum hardware.
summary: 双向 (V2G) 充电的集成使电动汽车 (EV) 车队能够作为分布式能源资产运行。然而，充电计划和行程分配的联合优化是NP困难的。此外，双向功率流会产生非单调的充电状态 (SoC) 动态，从而削弱标准双基 Benders 削减。我们提出了一种混合量子经典 Benders 分解框架。为了克服与编码可行性削减相关的量子位开销，我们引入了基于逻辑的冲突削减，这需要接近零的辅助量子位。此外，我们开发了一种稀疏递归 SoC 公式，可将水平长度 T 中的约束矩阵密度降低 T/3 倍。我们证明，我们的框架可以在辅助量子位预算较低的基准实例上恢复 MILP 最优解决方案，并且作为最小的概念证明，我们在 IBM 量子硬件上端到端执行一个小型实例。

title: Sublinear thermal state and ground state preparation for free fermions via system-bath interaction
abstract: Dissipative algorithms for preparing thermal and ground states typically require a total Hamiltonian simulation time that grows at least linearly with system size $N$, even when their mixing time grows only polylogarithmically. We achieve sublinear simulation time for free fermions by engineering local interactions with a bath whose size grows in proportion to the system size. Starting from arbitrary initial states, our thermal state preparation algorithm achieves trace-norm error $\epsilon$ in total simulation time $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{N}/\epsilon)$ at fixed inverse temperature and bounded single-particle bandwidth, while ground state preparation of gapped systems requires only $\mathrm{polylog}(N/\epsilon)$ time. We further establish lower bounds for thermal state preparation within the bath protocols considered, identifying two obstacles to faster preparation, namely fourth-order deviations from the target thermal state and fluctuations induced by a random frequency shared by all bath qubits. Our results demonstrate that the linear simulation time barrier in dissipative state preparation can be overcome and clarify the bath and filter-design constraints that govern further complexity improvements.
summary:
用于准备热态和基态的耗散算法通常需要总哈密顿模拟时间，该时间至少随系统大小 $N$ 线性增长，即使它们的混合时间仅以多对数增长。我们通过设计与浴槽的局部相互作用来实现自由费米子的亚线性模拟时间，浴槽的尺寸与系统尺寸成比例增长。从任意初始状态开始，我们的热态准备算法在固定逆温度和有界单粒子带宽下，在总模拟时间 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{N}/\epsilon)$ 内实现迹范数误差 $\epsilon$，而带隙系统的基态准备仅需要 $\mathrm{polylog}(N/\epsilon)$ 时间。我们进一步在所考虑的浴协议中建立了热状态准备的下限，确定了更快准备的两个障碍，即与目标热状态的四阶偏差和所有浴量子位共享的随机频率引起的波动。

我们的结果表明，耗散态制备中的线性模拟时间障碍可以克服，并阐明了控制进一步复杂性改进的浴和滤波器设计约束。

title: Multipartite dynamics beyond bipartite entanglement equilibration
abstract: Entanglement equilibration need not mark the end of quantum-information dynamics in quantum thermalization. We show that the complete Schmidt spectra of a fixed tripartition can become stationary while its multipartite correlation structure, distinguished by local-unitary invariants, continues to evolve. This separation occurs exactly within a finite window in self-dual kicked-Ising dynamics and asymptotically in Haar-random circuits. We further demonstrate an independently tunable timescale for multipartite dynamics using quantum-error-correcting codes. When coupled to a locally scrambling bath, ordinary entanglement approaches equilibrium through rapid local scrambling, while weak logical--bath coupling drives a slower reorganization of multipartite correlations. These results reveal a deeper distinction than the ordering of equilibration times: bipartite entanglement and multipartite correlation structure can probe distinct physical channels of quantum-information dynamics, rather than merely different stages of the same relaxation process.
summary: 纠缠平衡不一定标志着量子热化中量子信息动力学的终结。我们证明，固定三部分的完整施密特谱可以变得静止，而其以局部酉不变量为特征的多部分相关结构继续演化。这种分离恰好发生在自对偶踢伊辛动力学的有限窗口内，并且在哈尔随机电路中渐近发生。我们进一步展示了使用量子纠错码的多部分动力学的独立可调时间尺度。当耦合到局部扰乱浴时，普通纠缠通过快速局部扰乱接近平衡，而弱逻辑浴耦合则驱动多部分相关性的较慢重组。这些结果揭示了比平衡时间排序更深层次的区别：二分纠缠和多分相关结构可以探测量子信息动力学的不同物理通道，而不仅仅是同一弛豫过程的不同阶段。

title: Multimode continuous-variable quantum key distribution with CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic integration
abstract: Multiplexing and photonic-electronic integration offer a route to scalable and high-throughput quantum key distribution (QKD) networks through parallel transmission and compact hardware suited to volume manufacturing. Realizing this route requires multichannel transmitters and receivers, and a security analysis accounting for mode coupling. Here we present a CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic multimode continuous-variable QKD architecture, using polarization multiplexing as a two-mode example. Silicon-photonic transmitter and receiver chips prepare and detect two polarization modes in parallel. The receiver is co-integrated with a dual-channel 28-nm CMOS transimpedance amplifier, providing shot-noise clearances exceeding 20 dB in both channels. Pilot-assisted unitary digital recovery removes the need for active optical polarization control, while a multimode security analysis accounts for the mode crosstalk. At 2 percent residual crosstalk, the multimode analysis extends the simulated secure distance from 39 to 84 km, near the crosstalk-free limit of 89 km. Over 10 km of deployed fibre, the mean total finite-size secret-key rate estimate is 6.69 Mbit/s, 12 percent above the single-mode analysis from the same digitally recovered data. These results establish a route to scalable multimode quantum-secured networks built on technology suited to mass production.
summary:
多路复用和光子电子集成通过并行传输和适合批量制造的紧凑硬件，为可扩展和高吞吐量的量子密钥分发 (QKD) 网络提供了一条途径。实现这条路线需要多通道发射器和接收器，以及考虑模式耦合的安全分析。在这里，我们提出了一种 CMOS 兼容的光子电子多模连续可变 QKD 架构，使用偏振复用作为双模示例。硅光子发射器和接收器芯片并行准备和检测两种偏振模式。该接收器与双通道 28 nm CMOS 跨阻放大器共同集成，在两个通道中提供超过 20 dB 的散粒噪声间隙。导频辅助单一数字恢复消除了主动光偏振控制的需要，而多模安全分析则考虑了模式串扰。在残余串扰为 2% 的情况下，多模分析将模拟安全距离从 39 公里延长至 84 公里，接近无串扰限制 89 公里。

在超过 10 公里的已部署光纤中，有限大小密钥总速率的平均估计值为 6.69 Mbit/s，比来自相同数字恢复数据的单模分析高出 12%。这些结果建立了一条基于适合大规模生产的技术构建的可扩展多模量子安全网络的途径。

title: Multistability and Critical Frustrated Superradiance in Open Anisotropic Quantum Rabi Trimer
abstract: We study the nonequilibrium steady states of an open anisotropic quantum Rabi trimer. Combining semiclassical and quantum mechanical treatments, we map out the system's phase diagram and elucidate the critical phenomena induced by anisotropic light-matter coupling, cavity dissipation, and complex photon hopping, which give rise to abundant multistable phases. Counterintuitively, the frustrated superradiant phase (FSP) can be stabilized by both positive and negative photon hopping, a feature absent in closed Rabi and Dicke trimers. We further uncover two independent dissipation thresholds for the normal superradiant phase and the FSP. Unlike isotropic open quantum Rabi trimers, both phases are suppressed once the dissipation exceeds their respective critical values. The rotating and counter-rotating interaction terms exhibit mutually reciprocal effects on the quantum phase transitions. By analyzing universal scaling behaviors with quantum fluctuations incorporated, we reveal an unprecedented finite-fluctuation critical exponent for the FSP. Moreover, the critical exponents of individual phases are coupling-strength dependent. The multistability and FSP can be tuned by anisotropy and dissipation. Our results broaden the scope of nonequilibrium quantum phase physics in few-body systems and hold promising applications for quantum state engineering and cavity/circuit quantum electrodynamics.
summary:
我们研究了开放各向异性量子拉比三聚体的非平衡稳态。结合半经典和量子力学处理，我们绘制了系统的相图，并阐明了由各向异性光-物质耦合、腔耗散和复杂光子跳跃引起的关键现象，这些现象产生了丰富的多稳态相。与直觉相反，受挫超辐射相（FSP）可以通过正光子跳跃和负光子跳跃来稳定，这是封闭的拉比和迪克三聚体所不具备的特征。我们进一步揭示了正常超辐射相位和 FSP 的两个独立的耗散阈值。与各向同性开放量子拉比三聚体不同，一旦耗散超过各自的临界值，两个相都会受到抑制。旋转和反向旋转相互作用项对量子相变表现出相互影响。通过分析结合量子涨落的通用标度行为，我们揭示了 FSP 前所未有的有限涨落临界指数。此外，各个相的临界指数取决于耦合强度。

多稳定性和 FSP 可以通过各向异性和耗散进行调整。我们的研究结果拓宽了少体系统中非平衡量子相物理的范围，并在量子态工程和腔/电路量子电动力学方面具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Electron-photon entanglement in real space from quantum electrodynamics
abstract: We study the entanglement between an electron and the photon it scatters, resolved in real space and time. Starting from nonrelativistic QED in Fermi's oscillator representation, we write Fock's coupled equations for components with fixed photon number in the photon configuration space, in the length gauge, where the photon is created around the atom through a nonlocal kernel. Truncated at one photon, the equations are solved numerically without the rotating-wave approximation for a one-dimensional model atom in a waveguide with a single transverse mode and enhanced coupling. The atom is driven by a short, off-resonant laser pulse, with the electron and photon represented on real-space grids. The global electron-photon entanglement is largely transient. It peaks during the pulse and decreases as the polarized electron cloud returns to the core, leaving a state close to a product of the electron state and a superposition of the field vacuum with a single scattered photon. Local entanglement, obtained from walkers sampled across both photon-number components, exhibits opposite spatial patterns for the two particles. The electron entropy is smallest at the nucleus and maps the local strength of the dipole coupling, whereas the photon entropy is largest near the atom, where photons are created and absorbed, and smaller in the outgoing wave packets.
summary:
我们研究电子与其散射的光子之间的纠缠，并在真实的空间和时间中解决。从费米振子表示中的非相对论 QED 开始，我们在长度规中为光子配置空间中具有固定光子数的分量编写福克耦合方程，其中光子是通过非局域核在原子周围创建的。在一个光子处截断后，可以对方程进行数值求解，无需对具有单横模和增强耦合的波导中的一维模型原子进行旋转波近似。原子由短的非共振激光脉冲驱动，电子和光子在真实空间网格上表示。全球电子-光子纠缠在很大程度上是瞬态的。它在脉冲期间达到峰值，并随着极化电子云返回核心而减小，留下接近电子态和场真空与单个散射光子的叠加的乘积的状态。从跨两个光子数分量采样的步行者获得的局部纠缠，表现出两个粒子相反的空间模式。

电子熵在原子核处最小，映射偶极子耦合的局部强度，而光子熵在原子附近最大，光子在原子处产生和吸收，并且在出射波包中较小。

title: Benchmarking quantum-annealing-based approaches for factory layout planning
abstract: The earlystage of factory layout planning has a direct effect on the operating costs, efficiency, and productivity of manufacturing systems. Conventional automated planning approaches often face a trade-off between solution quality and computational effort. Recent studies have investigated the potential of quantum annealing (QA) for solving factory layout planning problems. However, existing studies have mainly focused on individual QA-based formulations, whereas current hybrid QA solvers support multiple model types that combine QA and classical methods. To explore the potential of QA for factory layout planning, this paper benchmarks four QA based approaches implemented with the corresponding solvers, including an iterative binary quadratic model (IBQM), a hybrid discrete quadratic model (HDQM), a hybrid constrained quadratic model (HCQM), and a hybrid nonlinear model (HNLM). To improve scalability, an iterative decomposition strategy is developed for IBQM, while a candidate selection procedure is introduced for HDQM. The approaches are benchmarked against genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization, and a hybrid tabu search and simulated annealing approach on 14 layout instances with different layout sizes, geometric complexity, spatial restrictions, and transport route configurations. The comparative analysis considers solution quality, computation time, and scalability. The results show that QA-based approaches achieve competitive solution quality and substantial computational advantages, reducing computation time by up to 94.51% relative to the classical reference methods. Among them, IBQM obtains the best solution quality in 78.6% of the instances, with a maximum improvement of 17.41% associated with an 81.34% reduction in computation time. These findings provide a basis for their further application in industrial layout planning.
summary:
工厂布局规划的早期阶段直接影响制造系统的运营成本、效率和生产率。传统的自动化规划方法通常面临解决方案质量和计算工作量之间的权衡。最近的研究调查了量子退火 (QA) 在解决工厂布局规划问题方面的潜力。然而，现有的研究主要集中在基于单独 QA 的公式，而当前的混合 QA 求解器支持结合 QA 和经典方法的多种模型类型。为了探索质量保证在工厂布局规划中的潜力，本文对使用相应求解器实现的四种基于质量保证的方法进行了基准测试，包括迭代二元二次模型（IBQM）、混合离散二次模型（HDQM）、混合约束二次模型（HCQM）和混合非线性模型（HNLM）。为了提高可扩展性，为 IBQM 开发了迭代分解策略，同时为 HDQM 引入了候选选择过程。

这些方法以遗传算法、粒子群优化以及混合禁忌搜索和模拟退火方法为基准，对具有不同布局尺寸、几何复杂性、空间限制和运输路线配置的 14 个布局实例进行测试。比较分析考虑了解决方案质量、计算时间和可扩展性。结果表明，基于 QA 的方法实现了具有竞争力的解决方案质量和显着的计算优势，相对于经典参考方法，计算时间减少了 94.51%。其中，IBQM 在 78.6% 的实例中获得了最佳解质量，最大提高了 17.41%，计算时间减少了 81.34%。这些研究结果为其在产业布局规划中的进一步应用提供了基础。

title: Fast and accurate rare-event simulation by Markov chain Monte Carlo for general quantum codes
abstract: The splitting method estimates logical error rates of quantum error-correcting codes deep in the rare-event regime, where direct Monte Carlo sampling is prohibitively expensive. It relies on a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampler of faulty configurations, usually driven by one-bit-flip proposals. However, one-bit flips have been reported to be trapped on some codes, which biases the estimate. To address this issue, we propose a new kernel that combines locally balanced one-bit-flip proposals with a cluster-exchange move. We benchmark both kernels and direct Monte Carlo on twelve codes under code-capacity bit-flip noise in two ways, by comparing the mean fault weight with an MCMC-independent reference and by measuring the computation time to reach a fixed accuracy. In the first, our kernel agrees with the reference on every code, including those where one-bit flips are trapped. In the second, it is faster than one-bit flips wherever they are trapped, by orders of magnitude on some codes. Furthermore, at the lowest error rate, it is faster than direct Monte Carlo on every code, by more than four orders of magnitude on some.
summary: 分裂方法估计了罕见事件区域深处量子纠错码的逻辑错误率，其中直接蒙特卡洛采样的成本极其昂贵。它依赖于错误配置的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗 (MCMC) 采样器，通常由一位翻转提案驱动。然而，据报道，一些代码中存在一位翻转，这使估计产生了偏差。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个新的内核，它将本地平衡的一位翻转提案与集群交换移动相结合。我们以两种方式对两个内核进行基准测试，并在代码容量位翻转噪声下对 12 个代码进行直接蒙特卡罗测试：将平均故障权重与独立于 MCMC 的参考进行比较，以及测量达到固定精度的计算时间。在第一个中，我们的内核同意每个代码的参考，包括那些陷入一位翻转的代码。在第二种情况下，无论在何处被捕获，它都比一位翻转要快，在某些代码上要快几个数量级。此外，在错误率最低的情况下，它在每个代码上都比直接蒙特卡罗快，在某些代码上快了四个数量级以上。

title: Geometric aspects of fault tolerance
abstract: We highlight three geometric aspects of fault tolerance. First, we construct an operator-algebraic formulation of the fiber bundle framework for fault tolerance, and show that a generalization of the Knill-Laflamme conditions implies a flat connection for this framework. Next, we develop this framework for Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes. We show that, for each polarization type, their moduli space embeds smoothly into a Grassmannian of finite-dimensional subspaces of a regularized distribution space. Finally, we explain how GKP codes associated with Jacobians give rise to magic states that can be obtained by code space projections of Gaussian states and identify a $\rm CCZ$-type magic state arising this way.
summary: 我们强调容错的三个几何方面。首先，我们构建了用于容错的纤维丛框架的算子代数公式，并表明 Knill-Laflamme 条件的推广意味着该框架的平坦连接。接下来，我们为 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 代码开发这个框架。我们证明，对于每种偏振类型，它们的模空间平滑地嵌入到正则化分布空间的有限维子空间的格拉斯曼矩阵中。最后，我们解释与雅可比行列式相关的 GKP 代码如何产生可以通过高斯状态的代码空间投影获得的魔法状态，并识别以这种方式产生的 $\rm CCZ$ 型魔法状态。

title: Quantum state revivals, time quasicrystals, and entanglement steering in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model
abstract: Motivated by the search for non-equilibrium phases of matter beyond the Floquet paradigm, we propose a route to realize perfect revivals and time quasicrystals (TQCs) in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model with Ising interactions between the central and satellite spins in the absence of disorder. We analytically demonstrate that when the interaction strength, $\lambda$ is tuned to $2 m \pi$, no entanglement is generated between the central and satellite spins at stroboscopic times, independent of the strength of the transverse driving field and the drive sequence. This leads to indefinitely long-lived quasiperiodic oscillations in satellite spin magnetization. Furthermore, for initial states with a definite bath magnetization, no entanglement is generated when the transverse driving field, $\theta$ is tuned to $\pi$ for any value of $ \lambda$, and the satellite spin magnetization oscillations exhibit period-3 revivals at Fibonacci times. Examining the robustness of these oscillations away from this fine-tuned limit, we identify a parameter regime where the quasiperiodic response does not decay over the timescales probed, giving rise to a long-lived $\pi$-pulse-proximate TQC regime. We further show that at special Clifford points, the system exhibits perfect quasiperiodic oscillations of the satellite spin magnetization, with a parity-dependent Fourier response. This response persists over the timescales probed, even away from the Clifford points for an even number of satellite spins, leading to the formation of a Clifford-proximate TQC. Finally, we demonstrate that at this Clifford points, the system is steered along an entangled trajectory, leading to the dynamical generation of Bell-cat and spin-cat states. These states exhibit magnetization of collective spin fluctuates quadratically with the number of satellite spins, thereby enabling Heisenberg-limited metrology.
summary:
出于寻找超越 Floquet 范式的物质非平衡相的动机，我们提出了一种在斐波那契驱动的中心自旋模型中实现完美复兴和时间准晶体（TQC）的途径，在没有无序的情况下，中心自旋和卫星自旋之间存在伊辛相互作用。我们分析证明，当相互作用强度 $\lambda$ 调整为 $2 m \pi$ 时，在频闪时间中心自旋和卫星自旋之间不会产生纠缠，与横向驱动场的强度和驱动序列无关。这导致卫星自旋磁化强度无限长的准周期振荡。此外，对于具有确定浴磁化强度的初始状态，当横向驱动场$\theta$对于$\lambda$的任何值调谐到$\pi$时，不会产生纠缠，并且卫星自旋磁化振荡在斐波那契时间呈现周期3复兴。

检查这些振荡远离这个微调极限的鲁棒性，我们确定了一个参数状态，其中准周期响应不会在探测的时间尺度上衰减，从而产生一个长寿命的 $\pi$-脉冲近似 TQC 状态。我们进一步表明，在特殊的克利福德点，系统表现出卫星自旋磁化的完美准周期振荡，并具有依赖于奇偶校验的傅里叶响应。这种响应在探测的时间尺度上持续存在，甚至在偶数次卫星自转中远离克利福德点，从而形成接近克利福德的 TQC。最后，我们证明，在这个克利福德点，系统沿着纠缠轨迹行驶，导致贝尔猫和自旋猫状态的动态生成。这些状态表现出集体自旋的磁化强度随卫星自旋数量呈二次方波动，从而实现海森堡极限计量学。

title: Quantum-Inspired and Optimization-Based CT Reconstruction Through Spin-Error
abstract: Quantum-optimization-based computed tomography (CT) reconstruction has demonstrated quantum supremacy in reconstruction accuracy over conventional classical methods under sparse-view and corrupted-sinogram conditions. However, scaling this approach remains challenging because larger images require increasingly many binary variables and interactions in the underlying quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. Even with iterative region-of-interest (ROI) refinement, a 60 by 60 ROI with three X-ray mass attenuation coefficients requires 10,800 binary variables under our encoding. As an initial step toward larger quantum CT images, we investigate simulated annealing (SA) followed by spin-error mitigation for optimisation (SEMO), without altering the CT-QUBO objective. We evaluate three 54-view ROI reconstruction instances and nine-view reconstruction with detector-row corruption, comparing SA and SEMO with selected hybrid quantum-classical solver results. For the ROI cases, SEMO reduced the numbers of incorrectly reconstructed pixels in low-budget SA outputs from 13 to 1, 38 to 0, and 54 to 15. With 20 percent detector-row corruption, three of four selected SA and SEMO pairs achieved exact reconstruction. Applying SEMO to one hybrid-solver output reduced its ROI error from 78 to 1 pixel. Improvements were instance-dependent: in one corrupted-sinogram case, QUBO energy decreased while image-domain error increased slightly; in one ROI case, the refined image retained 15 incorrect pixels despite having lower QUBO energy than ground truth. At the evaluated problem sizes, SA and SEMO attained reconstruction accuracy comparable to or better than selected unmitigated hybrid-solver results, providing an initial solution-quality benchmark for future larger-scale, parallelized quantum CT image reconstruction.
summary:
基于量子优化的计算机断层扫描（CT）重建在稀疏视图和损坏的正弦图条件下证明了其重建精度优于传统经典方法的量子优势。然而，扩展这种方法仍然具有挑战性，因为更大的图像在底层二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）模型中需要越来越多的二元变量和交互。即使采用迭代感兴趣区域 (ROI) 细化，具有三个 X 射线质量衰减系数的 60 x 60 ROI 在我们的编码下也需要 10,800 个二进制变量。作为实现更大量子 CT 图像的第一步，我们研究了模拟退火 (SA)，然后是自旋误差减轻优化 (SEMO)，而不改变 CT-QUBO 目标。我们评估了三个 54 视图 ROI 重建实例和具有检测器行损坏的九视图重建，将 SA 和 SEMO 与选定的混合量子经典求解器结果进行比较。对于 ROI 情况，SEMO 将低预算 SA 输出中错误重建的像素数量从 13 个减少到 1 个，从 38 个减少到 0 个，从 54 个减少到 15 个。

在检测器行损坏率为 20% 的情况下，选定的四个 SA 和 SEMO 对中的三个实现了精确重建。将 SEMO 应用于一个混合求解器输出，将其 ROI 误差从 78 像素减少到 1 像素。改进与实例相关：在一种正弦图损坏的情况下，QUBO 能量下降，而图像域误差略有增加；在一种 ROI 情况下，尽管 QUBO 能量低于真实图像，但细化后的图像保留了 15 个不正确的像素。在评估的问题规模上，SA 和 SEMO 获得的重建精度与选定的未缓解混合求解器结果相当或更好，为未来更大规模、并行化量子 CT 图像重建提供了初始解决方案质量基准。

title: Quantum computation of energy level degeneracy and thermodynamical properties of spin systems
abstract: We propose a hybrid quantum-classical method for reconstructing energy-level degeneracies and thermodynamic properties of spin systems. A single ancilla qubit is used to measure the partition function at imaginary inverse temperatures. For spectra lying on a known equally spaced energy grid, the inverse discrete Fourier transform allows exact reconstruction of degeneracies in the absence of noise, without spectral leakage. The quantum circuits are optimized using commuting interactions and Eulerian ordering. We demonstrate the method for frustrated Ising antiferromagnets on periodic Kagome graphs with up to 36 spins, using the ibm_kingston quantum processor. Despite substantial circuit depth and hardware noise, the reconstructed spectra retain their dominant features, and the calculated heat capacities reproduce the main temperature dependence of the exact results. Keywords: partition function, imaginary temperature, Ising model, heat capacity, ancilla qubit, quantum computing.
summary: 我们提出了一种混合量子经典方法来重建自旋系统的能级简并性和热力学性质。单个辅助量子位用于测量虚数逆温度下的配分函数。对于位于已知等距能量网格上的光谱，离散傅里叶逆变换允许在没有噪声的情况下精确重建简并，而不会出现光谱泄漏。使用交换相互作用和欧拉排序来优化量子电路。我们使用 ibm_kingston 量子处理器在最多 36 个自旋的周期 Kagome 图上演示了受挫伊辛反铁磁体的方法。尽管电路深度和硬件噪声很大，重建的光谱仍保留其主要特征，并且计算的热容再现了精确结果的主要温度依赖性。关键词：配分函数、虚温度、伊辛模型、热容量、辅助量子位、量子计算。

title: $κ$-Parametrized Boltzmann Distribution Sampling on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
abstract: Generative models use training data to produce new samples that resemble the original, with applications in classification and recommendation systems. Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) are at the core of generative models but suffer from the computational intractability of training, which relies on sampling an unknown Boltzmann Distribution (BD). The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) can assist RBM training, potentially providing benefits over strictly classical strategies. One particular problem is determining the quantum circuit depth for an arbitrary problem size that yields the expected sampling results. In this study, we evaluate QAOA-assisted sampling of BDs using Qiskit's Aer Simulator by analysing the inverse effective temperature of the distribution, $\kappa$, for tractable problem sizes. The results provide numerical evidence, based on Qiskit Aer simulations, that parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) can approximate RBM Boltzmann sampling for the tractable instances considered, while hardware performance and scaling remain open questions.
summary: 生成模型使用训练数据生成与原始样本相似的新样本，并应用于分类和推荐系统。受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 是生成模型的核心，但受到训练计算困难性的困扰，训练依赖于对未知玻尔兹曼分布 (BD) 进行采样。量子近似优化算法 (QAOA) 可以协助 RBM 训练，可能比严格的经典策略带来好处。一个特殊的问题是确定任意问题大小的量子电路深度，从而产生预期的采样结果。在本研究中，我们通过分析分布的逆有效温度 $\kappa$，使用 Qiskit 的 Aer Simulator 来评估 QAOA 辅助的 BD 采样，以解决可处理的问题大小。结果提供了基于 Qiskit Aer 模拟的数值证据，表明参数化退火调度 QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) 可以针对所考虑的易处理实例近似 RBM Boltzmann 采样，而硬件性能和扩展仍然是悬而未决的问题。

title: Distillable entanglement is continuous
abstract: We prove continuity of distillable entanglement, the optimal asymptotic rate at which copies of a bipartite state can be converted into maximally entangled pairs by local operations and classical communication (LOCC) with vanishing error. We establish an explicit asymptotic continuity bound that holds for arbitrary bipartite states and depends logarithmically on the system dimension. This bound has the same structure as known continuity bounds for conditional entropy, entanglement cost, and relative entropy of entanglement. Our proof constructs an explicit LOCC protocol that converts either of two arbitrary bipartite states into the other at an ebit cost that vanishes as their trace distance tends to zero.
summary: 我们证明了可蒸馏纠缠的连续性，即通过局部操作和误差消失的经典通信（LOCC）将二分状态的副本转换为最大纠缠对的最佳渐近速率。我们建立了一个明确的渐近连续性界限，该界限适用于任意二分状态，并且对数依赖于系统维数。该界限与已知的条件熵、纠缠成本和纠缠相对熵的连续性界限具有相同的结构。我们的证明构建了一个显式的 LOCC 协议，该协议将两个任意二分状态中的一个转换为另一个，其成本随着跟踪距离趋于零而消失。

title: Decoding with alternating weighted graph sparsification for quantum low-density parity-check codes
abstract: Real-time decoding is a fundamental necessity for building fault-tolerant quantum computers. In this work, we introduce decoding with alternating weighted graph sparsification (DAWG), an ensemble based approach that combines Tanner graph sparsification with ensembling belief-propagation (BP) decoders. The DAWG decoder runs BP decoders over the full detector error model Tanner graph for certain iterations to then transfer the posteriors to a sparsified graph in which additional rounds of BP are run. Each of the decoders in the ensemble uses a different transfer matrix to map the posterior information to the sparsified graph. We use the serial schedule for the minimum-sum BP decoders and, thus, employ Vibe decoding ideas by randomizing the schedules of each of them. The performance of the DAWG decoder is then numerically studied for bivariate bicycle codes and superdense color code circuits to be compared with other state-of-the-art decoding approaches. Importantly, the DAWG decoder shows a similar performance to Relay belief-propagation and Vibe decoding when combined with an order-$0$ Localized Statistics Decoding (LSD-$0$) post-processor. Crucially, the post-processor is called an order of magnitude less times than for Vibe with the same ensemble size, indicating that the introduced latency tail will be minimal. Furthermore, LSD-$0$ operates on a sparsified decoding graph of a fraction of the size of the full detector error model, which simplifies the resources required by specialized hardware to support it. Overall, the DAWG+LSD-$0$ decoder represents a viable low-cost BP-based decoding algorithm for quantum error correction codes.
summary:
实时解码是构建容错量子计算机的基本必要条件。在这项工作中，我们引入了交替加权图稀疏化（DAWG）解码，这是一种基于集成的方法，将 Tanner 图稀疏化与集成置信传播（BP）解码器相结合。 DAWG 解码器在完整检测器误差模型 Tanner 图上运行 BP 解码器进行某些迭代，然后将后验转移到稀疏图，在该图中运行额外的 BP 轮。集成中的每个解码器使用不同的传输矩阵将后验信息映射到稀疏图。我们对最小和 BP 解码器使用串行调度，因此通过随机化每个解码器的调度来采用 Vibe 解码思想。然后，对双变量自行车代码和超密集颜色代码电路的 DAWG 解码器的性能进行数值研究，以便与其他最先进的解码方法进行比较。重要的是，当与 order-$0$ 本地化统计解码 (LSD-$0$) 后处理器结合使用时，DAWG 解码器表现出与中继置信传播和 Vibe 解码类似的性能。

至关重要的是，后处理器的调用次数比具有相同整体大小的 Vibe 少一个数量级，这表明引入的延迟尾部将是最小的。此外，LSD-$0$ 在稀疏解码图上运行，其大小仅为完整检测器错误模型的一小部分，这简化了专用硬件支持它所需的资源。总体而言，DAWG+LSD-$0$ 解码器代表了一种可行的低成本基于 BP 的量子纠错码解码算法。

title: Competing coherence geometries in positive maps: positivity hierarchies, atomicity, and optimal entanglement witnesses
abstract: We introduce a family of positive maps on qudits whose Choi operators combine two competing coherence patterns: independent exchange couplings and a collective set of diagonal couplings. For every mixed member of the family, we derive exact conditions for positivity, complete positivity, and all intermediate levels of k-positivity, and we determine the complete phase structure of decomposability and atomicity. The higher-positivity thresholds depend on the channel multiplicities, whereas the exact decomposability boundary is universal in scale-free coordinates. Its proof combines an explicit positive-plus-copositive decomposition with a matching family of positive-partial-transpose (PPT) states. The latter form PPT edge states whose detection region is an ellipse, or a disk after collective rescaling. An embedded-qutrit certificate shows that indecomposability and atomicity coincide throughout the mixed family. In contrast, the purely collective endpoint is decomposable over its entire positive interval. Finally, at maximal coherence, an explicit positive subtraction produces an atomic optimal entanglement witness with the spanning property and a strictly larger PPT- detection set. The study thus provides an exactly solvable setting in which k-positivity, decomposability, atomicity, PPT-edge-state geometry, and witness optimality can be compared in arbitrary local dimension.
summary:
我们在量子上引入了一系列正映射，其 Choi 算子结合了两种相互竞争的相干模式：独立的交换耦合和一组对角耦合的集合。对于该家族的每个混合成员，我们推导出正性、完全正性和所有中间水平的 k 正性的精确条件，并确定可分解性和原子性的完整相结构。较高的正阈值取决于通道的多重性，而精确的可分解性边界在无标度坐标中是通用的。它的证明结合了显式的正加共正分解和匹配的正部分转置（PPT）状态族。后者形成PPT边缘态，其检测区域是椭圆形，或者集体缩放后的圆盘。嵌入式 qutrit 证书表明不可分解性和原子性在整个混合系列中是一致的。相反，纯粹的集体端点在其整个正区间上是可分解的。最后，在最大相干性下，显式正减法产生具有跨越特性的原子最佳纠缠见证和严格更大的 PPT 检测集。

因此，该研究提供了一个完全可解的设置，其中 k 正性、可分解性、原子性、PPT 边缘状态几何和见证最优性可以在任意局部维度进行比较。

title: Twist-controlled imaginary-time Mpemba effect in quantum spin systems
abstract: We construct a controllable imaginary-time Mpemba effect in quantum spin systems using spatially modulated local rotations without changing initial bipartite entanglement spectra and correlation magnitudes. This feature unambiguously isolates the redistribution of spectral weights as the sole driver of the anomalous relaxation. Using the compact-boson description, we reveal that these twists act as precise mode selectors: higher-harmonic twists exclusively populate high-energy standing waves, structurally bypassing slow-decaying infrared modes to accelerate convergence. We derive exact analytical crossing times for these reversals and demonstrate that intentionally reintroducing the slow-mode population systematically delays the ITME. This exact mechanism is validated beyond the fixed-point theory via calculations on interacting XXZ chains and ladders. Furthermore, a twelve-qubit simulation of variational quantum imaginary-time evolution reproduces the reversals and their controlled delay, providing a concrete route to realize this protocol in realistic quantum circuits. Ultimately, these results provide a strictly controllable and exact starting point for realizing and investigating the imaginary-time Mpemba effect, establishing a foundational paradigm to harness anomalous non-equilibrium relaxation in quantum ground-state preparations.
summary:
我们使用空间调制局部旋转在量子自旋系统中构建了可控虚时间 Mpemba 效应，而不改变初始二分纠缠谱和相关幅度。这一特征明确地将谱权重的重新分布隔离为异常弛豫的唯一驱动因素。使用紧凑玻色子描述，我们揭示了这些扭曲充当精确的模式选择器：高次谐波扭曲专门填充高能驻波，在结构上绕过缓慢衰减的红外模式以加速收敛。我们得出了这些逆转的精确分析交叉时间，并证明有意重新引入慢模式群体会系统地延迟 ITME。通过对相互作用的 XXZ 链和梯子的计算，这种精确的机制在定点理论之外得到了验证。此外，变分量子虚时间演化的十二量子位模拟再现了反转及其受控延迟，为在现实量子电路中实现该协议提供了具体途径。

最终，这些结果为实现和研究虚时间 Mpemba 效应提供了严格可控且准确的起点，建立了在量子基态制备中利用反常非平衡弛豫的基础范式。

title: The $\varepsilon$-smoothed Entanglement of Formation and its relation to the Moreau-Yosida approximation
abstract: We describe a family of convex continuous functions $E_{F,\varepsilon}$, $\varepsilon\in(0,1]$, on the set of states of a bipartite quantum system (consisting of finite-dimensional or infinite-dimensional subsystems) obtained by applying the Mora-Piani-Briegel construction of $\varepsilon$-measure (proposed in [Phys. Rev. A 109, 052413]) to the Entanglement of Formation (EoF) with the use of the trace norm distance in the role of basic metric. These functions are non-increasing in $\varepsilon$ and converge pointwise to the EoF as $\varepsilon\to0^+$. We conducted a detailed analysis of properties of the functions $E_{F,\varepsilon}$, using (among others) the relationship between the family $\{E_{F,\varepsilon}\}_{\varepsilon\in[0,1]}$ and the family $\{E^\lambda_F(\rho)\}_{\lambda>0}$ of Moreau-Yosida approximations of the EoF explored in [ arXiv:2609.30246 ]. We obtain a variational expression for the functions $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ (which for $\varepsilon=0$ turns into the standard variational expression for the EoF). We also describe the weak subadditivity property of the functions $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ and analyse their continuity properties. The semicontinuity bounds for the EoF (presented in [ this http URL ., 46, 2632-2658],[ arXiv:2404.07978 ]) allow us to obtain easily computable upper bounds on the rate of uniform convergence of the function $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ to the EoF as $\varepsilon\to0^+$ on the sets of states with bounded rank/energy of one of the marginal states. Applicability of the obtained results to other entanglement measures, in particular, to the relative entropy of entanglement, is discussed. As an auxiliary result, it is shown that for any state of an infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system, there exists a nearest separable state w.r.t. the trace norm distance. The non-uniqueness of such a state is also shown.
summary:
我们在二分量子系统（由有限维或无限维子系统组成）的状态集上描述了一系列凸连续函数 $E_{F,\varepsilon}$、$\varepsilon\in(0,1]$，通过将 $\varepsilon$-measure 的 Mora-Piani-Briegel 构造（在 [Phys. Rev. A 109, 052413] 中提出）应用于使用迹范数距离作为基本度量的纠缠这些函数在 $\varepsilon$ 中不增加，并且逐点收敛到 EoF 作为 $\varepsilon\to0^+$，我们使用（除其他外）族之间的关系对函数 $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ 的属性进行了详细分析。 $\{E_{F,\varepsilon}\}_{\varepsilon\in[0,1]}$ 和 [ arXiv:2609.30246 ] 中探索的 EoF 的 Moreau-Yosida 近似家族 $\{E^\lambda_F(\rho)\}_{\lambda>0}$ 我们获得了函数 $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ 的变分表达式。 （对于 $\varepsilon=0$ 变成 EoF 的标准变分表达式）。我们还描述了函数 $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ 的弱次可加性，并分析了它们的连续性。

EoF 的半连续界限（在 [ this http URL ., 46, 2632-2658],[ arXiv:2404.07978 ] 中呈现）使我们能够轻松计算函数 $E_{F,\varepsilon}$ 到 EoF 的均匀收敛速率的上限，即 $\varepsilon\to0^+$ 在有界状态集上边缘状态之一的等级/能量。讨论了所获得的结果对其他纠缠测量的适用性，特别是对纠缠相对熵的适用性。作为辅助结果，表明对于无限维二分量子系统的任何状态，都存在一个最近的可分离状态。轨迹范数距离。还显示了这种状态的非唯一性。

title: Interference-induced dynamical crossovers in quantum walks on disordered square lattices
abstract: We study discrete-time quantum walks with Fourier, Grover, and Hadamard coin operators on disordered square lattices, alongside classical random walks. Edges in the lattice are absent with a probability, $p$. In this case, both classical and quantum walks exhibit an essentially identical degradation of transport. We then study a general version of this model, in which the existing edges are retained. However, the absent edges are no longer absent, but now become partially transmitting, with a transmission coefficient $f$. We find that the response is now quite sensitive to the walk protocol and coin symmetry. The classical walk exhibits asymptotic stability of the anomalous diffusion exponent, $\beta(t)$. In comparison, quantum walks exhibit a monotonically decaying $\beta(t)$ beyond the initial transient regime, leading to the absence of quantum diffusion in two dimensions. We map the transport regimes in the $(f,p)$ plane and identify the contour for $\beta=1$, which separates the subdiffusive and superdiffusive regimes. We also examine the effective diffusion coefficient, the inverse participation ratio, and the first two moments of edge transmission. We restrict ourselves to analyzing bulk propagation prior to finite-size boundary reflections. The results indicate that quantum transport depends significantly on coin-specific interference and cannot be fully described by transmission statistics alone.
summary:
我们使用傅里叶、格罗弗和阿达玛硬币算子在无序方格上研究离散时间量子游走，以及经典随机游走。晶格中不存在边的概率为 $p$。在这种情况下，经典行走和量子行走都表现出本质上相同的传输退化。然后我们研究该模型的通用版本，其中保留现有边缘。然而，缺失的边缘不再缺失，而是部分传输，传输系数为 $f$。我们发现响应现在对步行协议和硬币对称性非常敏感。经典游走表现出反常扩散指数 $\beta(t)$ 的渐近稳定性。相比之下，量子行走表现出超出初始瞬态状态的单调衰减 $\beta(t)$，导致二维中不存在量子扩散。我们在 $(f,p)$ 平面上绘制传输机制，并确定 $\beta=1$ 的轮廓，该轮廓区分了次扩散和超扩散机制。我们还检查了有效扩散系数、逆参与比和边缘传输的前两个矩。

我们限制自己在有限尺寸边界反射之前分析体传播。结果表明，量子传输在很大程度上取决于硬币特定的干扰，并且不能仅通过传输统计来完全描述。

title: Complete entropy contraction from conditional hyperboundedness
abstract: For finite-dimensional quantum channels compatible with a faithful conditional expectation, we show that conditional hyperboundedness and strict GNS contraction together yield a relative entropy contraction. For KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroups, a conditional $2\to q$ hyperboundedness at time $t_0>0$ combined with a GNS gap $\lambda>0$ implies a modified logarithmic Sobolev constant \[ \alpha=\frac{\lambda(1-2/q)} {12(\lambda t_0+\log M+1-2/q)},\] where $M$ is the hyperboundedness constant. As a consequence, completely bounded hyperboundedness over auxiliary systems gives complete versions of entropy contraction with the same rates.
summary: 对于与忠实条件期望兼容的有限维量子通道，我们证明条件超有界性和严格的 GNS 收缩共同产生相对熵收缩。对于 KMS 对称量子马尔可夫半群，$t_0>0$ 时刻的条件 $2\to q$ 超有界性与 GNS 间隙 $\lambda>0$ 相结合意味着修改的对数 Sobolev 常数 \[ \alpha=\frac{\lambda(1-2/q)} {12(\lambda t_0+\log M+1-2/q)},\] 其中 $M$ 是超有界常数。因此，辅助系统上的完全有界超有界性给出了具有相同速率的完整版本的熵收缩。
